哇啊!
[BUF01]拒绝了我…\l这…这真是难得的经历啊!\p求求你,[BUF01]!这次我想
得到肯定的答复!\p求求你指导一下我!
en: Whoa! [BUF01] turned me down... Wh-what a rare experience!\pPlease, [BUF01]! This time I want a yes!\pPlease give me your guidance!

zh:
耶![BUF01]同意了!
[BUF01]同意了!\p今晚我肯定睡不着觉了…
太感谢你了!\p那我就开始提问了!\p在对战塔,哪一个
适合我,50级还是自由级?
en: Yes! [BUF01] said yes! [BUF01] said yes!\pI won't sleep a wink tonight... Thank you so much!\pThen let me start asking!\pAt the Battle Tower, which suits me: Level 50 or Open Level?

zh:
[BUF02]!明白了!
我完全明白!\l我真是有些欣喜若狂了!\p希望您以后还能
教导教导我。
en: [BUF02]! Got it! I totally get it! I'm practically beside myself with joy!\pI hope you'll keep teaching me in the future.

zh:
哇!你该不会是…
你真的是…[BUF01][BUF05]?!\l那个天下无敌的训练师?\l啊,你好,我真是个幸运儿!\p我叫[BUF02]!\p我一直在寻找一个
宝可梦老师。\p就在我毫无头绪的时候,
你出现了,[BUF01][BUF05]!\p你知道的,[BUF01][BUF05]!
收我做徒弟吧!
en: Whoa! Could you be... Are you really... [BUF01][BUF05]?! The unbeatable Trainer? Oh, hello! Am I ever lucky!\pI'm [BUF02]!\pI've been searching for a Pokémon teacher.\pAnd just when I was at a total loss, you appeared, [BUF01][BUF05]!\pYou know what to do, [BUF01][BUF05]! Take me on as your apprentice!

zh:
啊!
你真的是很酷很强…\p请不要这样。
我求你了!
en: Ah! You really are so cool and so strong...\pDon't be like that. I'm begging you!

zh:
哦,耶!真是爽快!
不得不承认,你太优秀了!\p那就先讲一讲
对战塔吧?\p如果我去的话,哪一个更适合我?
50级还是自由级?
en: Oh, yeah! That was quick! I have to admit, you're outstanding!\pThen let's start with the Battle Tower, shall we?\pIf I go, which suits me better? Level 50 or Open Level?

zh:
哦,是[BUF02]啊!
好的,啊-好的!\l那我去奋斗了!\p以后我还会找你指导我的!
再见!
en: Oh, [BUF02]! Okay, o-okay! Then I'm off to give it my all!\pI'll come to you for guidance again! Bye!

zh:
哦,嘿,[BUF01][BUF05],对吧?
警察正找你呢!\p… … …
当然是开玩笑了!\p是我,[BUF02]。别看我长成这样,
我可是宝可梦冠军!\l…当然这也是个玩笑!\p不过这次是认真的。
我不擅长对战。\p因此我能不能拜你为师
向你学习宝可梦的知识?
en: Oh, hey, [BUF01][BUF05], right? The police are looking for you!\p... ... ...Just kidding, of course!\pIt's me, [BUF02]. I may not look it, but I'm the Pokémon Champion! ...That's a joke too, of course!\pBut this time I'm serious. I'm no good at battling.\pSo could I take you as my master and learn about Pokémon from you?

zh:
耶!
我会买艘船送你的!\p当然还是个玩笑!
不过…谢谢你,师傅!\p你知道对战塔有
50级和自由级之分吧?\p我不知道该
选哪一个…\p你能替我决定吗,师傅?
en: Yes! I'll buy you a boat!\pKidding again, of course! But... thank you, Master!\pYou know the Battle Tower is split into Level 50 and Open Level, right?\pI don't know which to pick...\pWill you decide for me, Master?

zh:
明白,[BUF02]更适合!
那我就不选它了!\p开个玩笑!
我会遵从你的教导的,师傅!\p谢谢你!
希望你以后还能教我!
en: Got it, [BUF02] suits me better! Then I won't pick it!\pJust kidding! I'll follow your teachings, Master!\pThank you! I hope you'll keep teaching me!

zh:
啊-呵!
我是说啊呵,你好的意思!\p我是[BUF02],无敌的
快嘴皮水手!\p现在轮到你进行
自我介绍了,试一试!\p啊-嗬,啊-嗬!
你叫[BUF01][BUF05],\l玩的是宝可梦!\p年纪轻轻就已经
登上了世界舞台!\p总之我的意思是,
你是我今天碰到的\l第十名训练师。\p我们为什么不庆祝一下!
庆祝内容是你当我的导师!
en: A-hoy! I mean ahoy, as in hello!\pI'm [BUF02], the unbeatable fast-talking Sailor!\pNow it's your turn to introduce yourself. Give it a try!\pA-hoy, a-hoy! You're [BUF01][BUF05], and Pokémon's your game!\pSo young, and already on the world stage!\pAnyway, my point is, you're the tenth Trainer I've met today.\pWhy don't we celebrate? And the celebration is you becoming my mentor!

zh:
别这样!
你必须和我合作!\p不要这么刻薄嘛!
你就当一回我的导师吧!
en: Don't be like that! You've got to work with me here!\pDon't be so harsh! Just be my mentor this once!

zh:
这就对了!
[BUF01],要的就是这种精神!\p我第一个想要咨询的
问题是这样的!\p在对战塔战斗
要量力而行!\p有50级和自由级两种级别,
哪一个适合我?
en: That's the way! [BUF01], that's the spirit I'm after!\pHere's the first thing I want to ask!\pAt the Battle Tower, you've got to know your limits!\pThere are two levels, Level 50 and Open Level. Which one suits me?

zh:
哦,你是说[BUF02]!
我这就准备去!\p说到建议,
[BUF01],你的话总会令我满意!
en: Oh, you say [BUF02]! I'll get ready right away!\pWhen it comes to advice, [BUF01], your word always satisfies!

zh:
嘿,你不是[BUF01]吗?
我该怎么办?和你说话?\l为什么不?我已经在和你说话了!\p[BUF01],你对我感到很惊讶?
那我就告诉你我的大名!\p你叫我[BUF02]好了。
吉他界最耀眼的明星,\l那就是我!\p你接受我吗?
你肯定会接受的!\p我的运气无与伦比,
我的要求无懈可击!\p[BUF01],我来当你的下属!
你来教我如何上路!
en: Hey, aren't you [BUF01]? What do I do? Talk to you? Why not? I already am!\p[BUF01], surprised by me? Then I'll tell you my name!\pJust call me [BUF02]. The brightest star in the guitar world, that's me!\pWill you accept me? Of course you will!\pMy luck is second to none, and my request is airtight!\p[BUF01], I'll be your protege! You show me the way!

zh:
你想拒绝我?
那我只能再问一遍!\p[BUF01],我求你收我为下属!
我需要你为我指明道路!
en: You want to turn me down? Then I'll just have to ask again!\p[BUF01], I'm begging you, take me on! I need you to show me the way!

zh:
耶,真走运!
那我能不能问你个问题?\p既然我们在对战塔旁边,
我就以此发问吧?\p下列选择中,
哪一个更适合我?
en: Yeah, lucky me! Then can I ask you a question?\pSince we're right by the Battle Tower, I'll ask about that, okay?\pOf these choices, which one suits me better?

zh:
既然你建议我选[BUF02],
那这一定是最佳答案!\p好了,[BUF01],我要自由驰骋,
你可别忘了我这名学生。\p再见,我的好朋友!
en: If you recommend [BUF02], then it must be the best answer!\pAll right, [BUF01], I'm off to roam free. Don't forget your student here.\pFarewell, my good friend!

zh:
哦,喂!说你呢!
你能不能为我捶一捶肩?\p…对,就是这!这里!
喽,喽!哦,真舒服!\p我叫[BUF02]。
我在练空手道,但我的身体\l好像不适合这种运动…\p于是我决定通过和宝可梦
对战来锻炼自己。\p你是[BUF01][BUF05],对不对?
那个宝可梦联盟冠军?\p听着,你能不能给我
一些建议?
en: Oh, hey! Yes, you! Could you pound my shoulders for me?\p...Yes, right there! There! Ooh, ooh! Ahh, that feels good!\pI'm [BUF02]. I've been training in karate, but my body doesn't seem built for it...\pSo I decided to toughen up by battling with Pokémon.\pYou're [BUF01][BUF05], right? The Pokémon League Champion?\pListen, could you give me some advice?

zh:
哦,为什么?\p我保证不会给你惹麻烦!
行不行?
en: Aw, why not?\pI promise I won't cause you any trouble! Please?

zh:
谢谢。你真是太好了!
…咳!咳!\p哦,我必须赶快变强…\p我马上就去对战塔
但是哪一个级别更适合我?\l50级还是自由级?
en: Thanks. You're too kind! ...Cough! Cough!\pOh, I must get stronger, and fast...\pI'm heading to the Battle Tower right away, but which level suits me better? Level 50 or Open Level?

zh:
嗬,好的。那就[BUF02]吧。
我马上就去。\p真希望能一直向你
咨询--你已经是我的导师了!
en: Oh, all right. [BUF02] it is. I'll head there right away.\pI hope I can always come to you for advice. You're already my mentor!

zh:
呋…嗬…
[BUF01][BUF05]…?\p请不要这样看着我。
我都觉得不自然了。\p我…我是[BUF02]。\p虽然难以启齿,
但我一直在研究古代遗迹。\p更让我难以启齿的是
我对对战开拓区感兴趣。\p[BUF01][BUF05],你是出了名的
高级训练师…\p请原谅我的无礼,
我想求你件事。\p你能当我的老师
给我些建议吗?
en: Um... er... [BUF01][BUF05]...?\pPlease don't look at me like that. It makes me self-conscious.\pI... I'm [BUF02].\pIt's hard to admit, but I've been studying ancient ruins.\pWhat's even harder to admit is that I'm interested in the Battle Frontier.\p[BUF01][BUF05], you're famous as a top Trainer...\pForgive my rudeness, but I have a request.\pWould you be my teacher and give me some advice?

zh:
请不要这样拒绝我!
我无法忍受这种耻辱。\p请当我的老师吧!
我需要你的建议!
en: Please don't refuse me like that! I couldn't bear the shame.\pPlease be my teacher! I need your advice!

zh:
谢-谢谢你…\p但请不要这样看着我。
我会紧张的。\p答应我,回答问题的时候
请不要看着我的眼睛。\p在对战塔…
我应该尝试哪一个级别?
en: Th-thank you...\pBut please don't look at me like that. It makes me nervous.\pPromise me you won't look me in the eye when you answer.\pAt the Battle Tower... which level should I try?

zh:
哦…好的!
我会试一试的。\p希望我能勇于面对
挑战,奋力拼搏…\p谢谢你,[BUF01][BUF05]。
如果我们还能见面的话\l请再给我些建议。
en: Oh... all right! I'll give it a try.\pI hope I can face the challenge bravely and fight with all I have...\pThank you, [BUF01][BUF05]. If we meet again, please give me more advice.

zh:
嗬?你好像是[BUF01][BUF05]…
真的吗?\p你可以叫我[BUF02]。\p我一直在琢磨着
找一个训练师高手做我的老师。\p看来我今天真是走运!
…你真的是[BUF01][BUF05]?\p我是说,是真的就好。
我只是想请你\l收我做徒弟。
en: Hm? You appear to be [BUF01][BUF05]... Is that so?\pYou may call me [BUF02].\pI've been thinking of finding an expert Trainer to be my teacher.\pIt seems today is my lucky day! ...You really are [BUF01][BUF05]?\pI mean, I hope you are. I simply wish to ask you to take me on as your apprentice.

zh:
哦?
但你出于什么原因拒绝了我?\p很抱歉我刚才在
怀疑你的身份。\p请接受我的道歉
收我做徒弟吧。
en: Oh? But on what grounds do you refuse me?\pI apologize for doubting your identity earlier.\pPlease accept my apology and take me on as your apprentice.

zh:
你真的同意了?
我可不想高兴得太早。\p如果你真的同意了,那我道歉。
我现在需要你的指点。\p如果我要去对战塔,
哪一个适合我?\l50级还是自由级?
en: You really agree? I don't want to celebrate too soon.\pIf you truly agree, then I apologize. Now I need your guidance.\pIf I go to the Battle Tower, which suits me: Level 50 or Open Level?

zh:
[BUF02]?
你确定吗?\p我明白了。那就好。
谢谢你抽空解答问题。\p我知道我不讨喜,但我很
高兴你能接受我。\p回见!
en: [BUF02]? Are you certain?\pI see. Very well. Thank you for taking the time to answer.\pI know I'm not the likable sort, but I'm glad you accepted me.\pSee you!

zh:
唉…呜…
哦,[BUF01]!\p我现在进退两难
举棋不定。\p我不知道该让我的[BUF02]
携带什么道具。\p请告诉我,[BUF01]。
我应该选哪一个道具?
en: Sigh... Ugh... Oh, [BUF01]!\pI'm stuck between a rock and a hard place, and I can't decide.\pI don't know what item to give my [BUF02] to hold.\pPlease tell me, [BUF01]. Which item should I choose?

zh:
哦,真的?我不能让
我的[BUF02]携带任何道具?
en: Oh, really? I shouldn't give my [BUF02] any item to hold?

zh:
哦,好的!真高兴问题解决了!
太酷了!棒极了!耶!\p太谢谢你了!
en: Oh, okay! I'm so glad that's settled! So cool! Amazing! Yay!\pThank you so much!

zh:
哦,我太高兴了…
我记得我也有[BUF02]。\p真高兴问题解决了!
太酷了!棒极了!耶!\p太谢谢你了!
en: Oh, I'm so happy... I remember I have a [BUF02], too.\pI'm so glad that's settled! So cool! Amazing! Yay!\pThank you so much!

zh:
哇啊!请别这么小气!\p你之前已经推荐我
选[BUF02]了,呜…\p你的意思是不是
我的[BUF03]应该什么都不拿?
en: Waah! Don't be so stingy!\pYou already recommended [BUF02] before, boo...\pDo you mean my [BUF03] shouldn't hold anything at all?

zh:
耶!是[BUF01]!
太好了!我想问你件事!\p你让不让你的宝可梦携带道具?
我想这样做,可是…\p我的[BUF02]应该
携带什么道具?\p你怎么想?
en: Yay! It's [BUF01]! Perfect! I want to ask you something!\pDo you let your Pokémon hold items? I want to, but...\pWhat item should my [BUF02] hold?\pWhat do you think?

zh:
啊?你是说我的[BUF02]
不需要携带任何道具?
en: Huh? You're saying my [BUF02] doesn't need to hold any item?

zh:
哦,我明白了!我会这么做的!
谢谢你的指点!
en: Oh, I get it! That's what I'll do! Thanks for the tip!

zh:
哦,哇!一个[BUF02],是吗?
我会这么做的!\p谢谢你的指点!
en: Oh, wow! A [BUF02], is it? That's what I'll do!\pThanks for the tip!

zh:
哦,啊,我不是这个意思。
我想了解一个\l以前没用过的道具。\p难道你的意思是我的宝可梦
不需要携带任何道具?
en: Oh, uh, that's not what I meant. I wanted to hear about an item I haven't used before.\pOr do you mean my Pokémon doesn't need to hold any item?

zh:
[BUF01],你好!
我想问问有关[BUF02]的事…\p我想让它携带一个合适的道具。
你看哪一个比较好?
en: Hello, [BUF01]! I wanted to ask about my [BUF02]...\pI'd like it to hold a suitable item. Which do you think would be best?

zh:
哦,那我的[BUF02]不需要
携带任何道具?
en: Oh, so my [BUF02] doesn't need to hold any item?

zh:
我明白了!
再见!
en: Understood! Goodbye!

zh:
哦,[BUF02]?
明白了!\p我会努力去找的!
再见!
en: Oh, a [BUF02]? Understood!\pI'll do my best to find one! Goodbye!

zh:
已经有人告诉过我
[BUF02]了。\p我想让我的宝可梦携带
另一个道具。\p也许我的[BUF03]不需要
携带任何道具?
en: Someone already told me about [BUF02].\pI'd like my Pokémon to hold a different item.\pOr perhaps my [BUF03] doesn't need to hold anything?

zh:
你好,[BUF01]…
很抱歉打搅你,我想\l问你件事。\p我觉得光凭一己之力是
无法赢得比赛的,所以我想让\l我的[BUF02]携带一个道具。\p但我不知道选哪个好。\p[BUF01],请问你能替我
决定吗?
en: Hello, [BUF01]... Sorry to bother you, but I have a question.\pI don't think I can win on my own strength alone, so I'd like my [BUF02] to hold an item.\pBut I don't know which to choose.\p[BUF01], could you decide for me?

zh:
我这种人拥有的宝可梦
最好不要拿道具?
en: So a Pokémon owned by someone like me is better off without an item?

zh:
我明白了…
你是想说我不应该依赖于道具。\l我会尽力的!\p非常感谢!
en: I see... You're saying I shouldn't rely on items. I'll do my best!\pThank you very much!

zh:
[BUF02],好的。
不知道我能不能找到…\l不!我会努力去找的。\p非常感谢!
en: A [BUF02], all right. I wonder if I can find one... No! I'll do my best to find it.\pThank you very much!

zh:
哦,可是…
我以前好像听说过这种道具…\p是不是我以前没有
正确使用[BUF02]?\p还是说我的[BUF03]
不需要携带道具?
en: Oh, but... I think I've heard of that item before...\pWas I not using the [BUF02] correctly before?\pOr are you saying my [BUF03] doesn't need to hold an item?

zh:
哦,[BUF01][BUF05]。
我想问你件事。\p你记得你曾经替我
选了一个宝可梦吧?\p但我当时却忘了问你
它应该携带什么道具。\p既然你之前帮了我一回,
那不如帮到底吧?\p哪一个好?我想让我的
[BUF02]携带一个道具。
en: Oh, [BUF01][BUF05]. I have a question for you.\pYou remember choosing a Pokémon for me once, don't you?\pBut I forgot to ask what item it should hold.\pSince you've helped me before, why not see it through?\pWhich is best? I want my [BUF02] to hold an item.

zh:
哦!这么说我的[BUF02]
应该什么都不拿?
en: Oh! So my [BUF02] shouldn't hold anything at all?

zh:
既然你这么想,那就定了。\p反正是你做的决定,
[BUF01][BUF05],我即使输了\l也不丢人。\p就这样,我还会向你咨询的。
再见!
en: If that's what you think, then it's settled.\pSince it was your decision, [BUF01][BUF05], there's no shame in it even if I lose.\pThat's that. I'll consult you again. Bye!

zh:
选[BUF02],是吗?
还不错。我会用的!\p反正是你做的决定,
[BUF01][BUF05],我即使输了\l也不丢人。\p就这样,我还会向你咨询的。
再见!
en: [BUF02], is it? Not bad. I'll use it!\pSince it was your decision, [BUF01][BUF05], there's no shame in it even if I lose.\pThat's that. I'll consult you again. Bye!

zh:
啊?你说什么?
你之前已经\l告诉过我[BUF02]了。\p你是不是说我的[BUF03]
应该什么都不拿?
en: Huh? What's that? You already told me about [BUF02] before.\pAre you saying my [BUF03] shouldn't hold anything?

zh:
嘿,[BUF01][BUF05]!\p我们都很忙,可仍然
能经常碰到对方!\p今天我想散散步,
打扫一下卫生,做做家务。\p我之前都没时间为我的
宝贝[BUF02]买东西。\p我时间不多,不如你给我
一点建议吧,我的[BUF02]\l应该携带什么道具?
en: Hey, [BUF01][BUF05]!\pWe're both so busy, yet we keep running into each other!\pToday I want to take a walk, tidy up, and do some chores.\pI haven't had time to shop for my precious [BUF02].\pI'm short on time, so how about some advice: what item should my [BUF02] hold?

zh:
哦,我是个大忙人,因此
我的[BUF02]不需要道具?
en: Oh, I'm a busy person, so my [BUF02] doesn't need an item?

zh:
明白了。
真是省了我不少时间。\p谢谢啊!
回见!
en: Got it. That saves me a lot of time.\pThanks! See you!

zh:
明白了。
我会抽空去找\l你推荐的那个[BUF02]。\p真高兴能碰到你这种导师。
谢谢啊!再见!
en: Got it. I'll find time to look for that [BUF02] you recommended.\pI'm lucky to have a mentor like you. Thanks! Bye!

zh:
啊?我早就知道
那个[BUF02]。\p哦,我明白了。
你是说,我这种大忙人的\l[BUF03]不需要道具?
en: Huh? I already know about that [BUF02].\pOh, I get it. You're saying a busy person's [BUF03] doesn't need an item?

zh:
嘿,[BUF01]!是我!
今天我又要向你讨教了。\l我需要你的建议!\p来点鼓声!
我的问题是…\p如果我想让我的[BUF02]
携带一个道具,应该选哪一个?
en: Hey, [BUF01]! It's me! I've come for your wisdom again today. I need your advice!\pDrumroll, please! My question is...\pIf I want my [BUF02] to hold an item, which should I pick?

zh:
是吗?你是说我的[BUF02]
不需要携带任何道具?
en: Really? You're saying my [BUF02] doesn't need to hold any item?

zh:
那就这么定了!\p我今天想问你的
就这么多。\p以后再见吧?
谢谢你!
en: Then it's settled!\pThat's all I wanted to ask today.\pSee you around? Thank you!

zh:
哦!一个[BUF02]。
太酷了!\l我肯定会用的!\p我今天想问你的
就这么多。\p以后再见吧?
谢谢你!

还没有定下来。\p这就是你要发挥的地方,[BUF01][BUF05]!
你来决定哪一个宝可梦打头阵吧!\p不要害羞,说出来吧!
en: Hello, hello! My mentor, [BUF01][BUF05]! Give me some more advice today!\pYou see, I've put together a team of 3 Pokémon. So far, so good.\pBut I haven't settled on the team's order yet.\pThat's where you come in, [BUF01][BUF05]! You decide which Pokémon leads!\pDon't be shy. Let's hear it!

zh:
啊-嗬,我的[BUF02]做领队!
好的,好的!\l我会重新组队的!\p谢谢你再次帮忙!
再见!
en: A-ha, my [BUF02] takes the lead! OK, OK! I'll rearrange my team!\pThanks for helping me out again! Goodbye!

zh:
[BUF01][BUF05],听着!
我遇到危机了!\p我的那三只宝可梦同时
加入了战斗!\p这当然是不可能的!
哇哈哈!\p说正事吧。
我不擅长决定\l宝可梦的出场顺序。\p不如你替我决定
哪一个宝可梦先出场吧,师傅?
en: [BUF01][BUF05], listen! I'm in a crisis!\pAll three of my Pokémon jumped into battle at once!\pThat's impossible, of course! Wahaha!\pBut seriously. I'm no good at deciding the order my Pokémon go out.\pHow about you decide which Pokémon goes first, Master?

zh:
哦,你选的是[BUF02]?
那我绝不选它!\p开玩笑啦!
我会听从你的教导的,师傅!\p谢谢你,师傅!
希望你以后还能教导我!
en: Oh, you picked [BUF02]? Then I definitely won't use it!\pJust kidding! I'll follow your guidance, Master!\pThank you, Master! I hope you'll keep teaching me!

zh:
啊-呵!
我是说啊-呵!\p我是无敌的快嘴皮水手!
我要问你一个\l十分有水平的问题!\p我在队伍的排列上遇到了麻烦
希望你能给点建议!\p我的队伍中哪一个应该
打头阵呢?
en: A-hoy! I said, a-hoy!\pI'm the invincible fast-talking Sailor! I've got a truly top-notch question for you!\pI'm having trouble arranging my team, and I'd like your advice!\pWhich member of my team should lead off?

zh:
好的,我明白你的意思了!
我肯定会调换顺序的!\p说到建议,
[BUF01],你的话总会令我满意!
en: OK, I get what you mean! I'll switch up the order for sure!\pWhen it comes to advice, [BUF01], your word always works for me!

zh:
呀呵,[BUF01]!
你最近怎么样?\p我该怎么办?直接问你?
嗬,我想问你件事!\l你接受我吗?\l你当然接受我!\p你得决定我的宝可梦中
哪一个先出场!\l就这么多。
en: Yo, [BUF01]! How've you been?\pWhat should I do? Just ask you? Heh, I've got a question! Will you take me on? Of course you will!\pYou get to decide which of my Pokémon goes out first! That's all.

zh:
我的[BUF02]?好的!
我会贯彻执行的!\p好了,[BUF01],我要自由驰骋,
你可别忘了我这名学生。\p再见,我的好朋友!
en: My [BUF02]? OK! I'll see it through!\pAll right, [BUF01], I'm off to roam free. Don't you forget about your student here.\pSee you, my good friend!

zh:
…呜…哦…[BUF01][BUF05]…
我突然肚子疼…\p…现在好一些了…\p我肯定是太担忧了
一直在想如何排列\l我的宝可梦。\p事到如今,
我希望你替我决定。\p[BUF01][BUF05],我的宝可梦中
哪一个先出场我才会赢?
en: ...Ugh... oh... [BUF01][BUF05]... My stomach suddenly hurts...\p...It's a little better now...\pI must have worried too much, thinking about how to order my Pokémon.\pAt this point, I'd like you to decide for me.\p[BUF01][BUF05], which of my Pokémon should go out first for me to win?

zh:
嗬,好的。
我的[BUF02]先出场。\p我吃过晚饭后
就去修改顺序。\p希望我以后还能这样
向你咨询。
en: Hmm, OK. My [BUF02] goes out first.\pI'll change the order after dinner.\pI hope I can come to you for advice like this again.

zh:
呋…嗬…
[BUF01][BUF05]?\p请不要这样看着我。
我都觉得脸红了。\p嗬…
我迫切需要你的建议。\p真是有些难以启齿,
我组建了一支3-宝可梦的队伍。\l可是却决定不了出场顺序。\p哪一个宝可梦先出场
我才会有胜算?
en: Whew... hmm... [BUF01][BUF05]?\pPlease don't look at me like that. You're making me blush.\pHmm... I desperately need your advice.\pIt's a bit hard to say, but I've built a team of 3 Pokémon, and I can't decide the order they go out.\pWhich Pokémon should go first for me to have a chance?

zh:
哦…好的!
我会让[BUF02]打头阵的。\p希望我能毫不气馁
奋力拼搏…\p谢谢你,[BUF01][BUF05]。
如果我们还能见面的话\l请再给我些建议。
en: Oh... OK! I'll have [BUF02] lead off.\pI hope I can fight on without losing heart...\pThank you, [BUF01][BUF05]. If we ever meet again, please give me more advice.

zh:
嗬?你好像是[BUF01][BUF05]…
真的是你吗?\l该不会是冒牌的吧?\p哦,不,不,不,别担心!
如果你真的是[BUF01],\l请原谅我的无礼。\p我现在需要你的建议。\p我组建了一支宝可梦战队。
希望你能告诉我应该由\l哪一个宝可梦打头阵。
en: Huh? You look like [BUF01][BUF05]... Is it really you? Not an impostor, right?\pOh, no, no, no, don't worry! If you really are [BUF01], please forgive my rudeness.\pI need your advice now.\pI've built a team of Pokémon. I'd like you to tell me which Pokémon should lead off.

zh:
我的[BUF02]…
你不是开玩笑吧?\p我明白了。那就这么着吧。
谢谢你抽空回答问题。\p我现在虽然还不强
但我一定会努力的。\p回见!
en: My [BUF02]... You're not joking, right?\pI see. Then that's how it'll be. Thanks for taking the time to answer.\pI'm not strong yet, but I'll do my best.\pSee you!

zh:
呜呜…
啊,[BUF01]!\p你来得正好!
有些事我不知道该怎么办…\p我不知道我该选
哪只宝可梦,\p不知道该
选[BUF02]还是[BUF03]…\p[BUF01],你说我用哪只
才会赢呢?
en: Sob... Ah, [BUF01]!\pYou came at just the right time! There's something I don't know what to do about...\pI don't know which Pokémon to choose,\pwhether it should be [BUF02] or [BUF03]...\p[BUF01], which one do you think will win for me?

zh:
呜呜…我…我明白了!
啊,对不起!\l我高兴得都哭出来了…\p我一定要努力抓一只
[BUF02]!\p非常感谢!
en: Sob... I... I understand! Ah, I'm sorry! I'm so happy, I started crying...\pI'll do my very best to catch a [BUF02]!\pThank you so much!

zh:
耶!是[BUF01]!
呀,你来得正好!\l再给我点建议吧!\p呋,我已经搞不清楚了,我应该
用我的[BUF02]还是[BUF03]…\p我该怎么办,
[BUF01]?
en: Yay! It's [BUF01]! Oh, perfect timing! Give me some more advice!\pHmm, I just can't figure out if I should use my [BUF02] or [BUF03]...\pWhat should I do, [BUF01]?

zh:
啊,那么说[BUF02]更好一点!
好,就这么决定了!\p谢谢你的帮忙!
en: Ah, so [BUF02] is the better one! Great, that settles it!\pThanks for your help!

zh:
[BUF01],你好!
我想问你个问题。\p我在犹豫该用
[BUF02]还是[BUF03],\p你说哪只宝可梦
更强一点?
en: [BUF01], hello! I'd like to ask you a question.\pI'm torn between [BUF02] and [BUF03].\pWhich Pokémon do you think is stronger?

zh:
你说是[BUF02]吗?
嗬,我明白了!\p我这就去抓一只
很强的[BUF02]来!\p回头见!
en: You say [BUF02]? Oh, I see!\pI'll go catch a really strong [BUF02] right away!\pSee you later!

zh:
你好,[BUF01]…\p呋,你好像已经忘了
我这个人了…\p…但没关系,我还是希望
你能给我点建议…\p我不知道我该培养
哪只宝可梦…\p我看中了两只宝可梦
[BUF02]和[BUF03],但\l下面我就不知道该怎么办了…\p[BUF01],很抱歉打扰你,
但希望你能给我点建议。
en: Hello, [BUF01]...\pHmm, it seems you've forgotten all about me...\p...But that's fine. I still hope you can give me some advice...\pI don't know which Pokémon I should raise...\pI've got my eye on two Pokémon, [BUF02] and [BUF03], but I don't know what to do next...\p[BUF01], sorry to bother you, but I hope you can give me some advice.

zh:
但野生[BUF02]会
注意到我吗?\p我会努力的!\p但我能不能抓到…
不对,我要尽全力做到!\p谢谢!
en: But will a wild [BUF02] even notice me?\pI'll do my best!\pBut can I really catch one... No, I'll give it everything I've got!\pThanks!

zh:
噘,[BUF01][BUF05]!很高兴见到你!
我还打算去找你呢!\p你能帮我选一下我该
用哪只宝可梦吗?\p比如…
[BUF02]和\l[BUF03]怎么样?\p你说哪一个
更好一点?
en: Oh, [BUF01][BUF05]! Great to see you! I was just about to go looking for you!\pCould you help me choose which Pokémon to use?\pFor example... how about [BUF02] and [BUF03]?\pWhich one do you think is better?

zh:
[BUF02]?太好了!\p这是你替我做的决定,
[BUF01][BUF05],\l即使我输了我也不会失望的。\p好吧,下次我还会找你请教的,
再见!
en: [BUF02]? Wonderful!\pSince you made the decision for me, [BUF01][BUF05], I won't be disappointed even if I lose.\pWell then, I'll come to you for advice again. Goodbye!

zh:
这不是[BUF01][BUF05]嘛!一切还好吧?
我还是像以前一样忙!\p我也想养宝可梦,
但我还没决定\l要养哪只宝可梦。\p你觉得[BUF02]强吗?
但也不能忽视[BUF03]啊。\p[BUF01][BUF05],给我点建议吧!
哪个更适合我?
en: If it isn't [BUF01][BUF05]! How's everything? I'm as busy as ever!\pI want to raise a Pokémon too, but I haven't decided which one to raise.\pDo you think [BUF02] is strong? But you can't overlook [BUF03] either.\p[BUF01][BUF05], give me some advice! Which one suits me better?

zh:
知道了。
我会努力去抓你说的\l那个[BUF02]的。\p真高兴能碰上你这样的好老师。
谢谢啦,再见!
en: Got it. I'll do my best to catch that [BUF02] you mentioned.\pI'm so glad to have met a fine teacher like you. Thanks, see you!

zh:
噘!
呀,是[BUF01]!\p我才没有浪费时间去
向朋友吹嘘碰上你的事!\p今天我还想麻烦你,
对你来说很简单的!\p拜托了!
我的问题是…\p如果我要在[BUF02]与
[BUF03]两只宝可梦中选一只来养,\l我该选哪个?
en: Oh! Hey, it's [BUF01]!\pI have NOT been wasting time bragging to my friends about meeting you!\pI've got another favor to ask today. It'll be easy for you!\pPlease! My question is...\pIf I had to pick between [BUF02] and [BUF03] to raise, which should I choose?

zh:
啊啊!
你说是[BUF02]!\l真棒的答案!\p今天我想问你的
就这些,\p下次再见吧。
真的很感谢你!
en: Ahh! You say [BUF02]! What a great answer!\pThat's all I wanted to ask you today.\pSee you next time. Thank you so much!

zh:
啊,是你,[BUF01]?
很高兴再见到你!\p我成了你的徒弟后,
越来越有信心了。\p我想培养一只
自己的宝可梦!\p[BUF01],能麻烦你帮我
选一只宝可梦吗?\p我该培养[BUF02]
还是[BUF03]?\l哪只宝可梦更适合我?
en: Ah, is that you, [BUF01]? So glad to see you again!\pSince I became your student, I've been gaining more and more confidence.\pI want to raise a Pokémon of my own!\p[BUF01], could I trouble you to pick a Pokémon for me?\pShould I raise [BUF02] or [BUF03]? Which Pokémon suits me better?

zh:
[BUF02]吗?
我马上就去抓一只!\p谢谢,[BUF01],
希望下次还能请你帮忙。\l祝你一路顺风!
en: [BUF02]? I'll go catch one right away!\pThanks, [BUF01]. I hope I can ask for your help again. Safe travels!

zh:
哎![BUF01]!又见到你了!
太…太棒了!\p啊,啊,啊,我知道
我不能白白放掉这次机会!\p能请你帮个忙吗,[BUF01]
帮我选一只宝可梦吧!\p告诉我,[BUF02]和[BUF03]
哪只更好一点!
en: Hey! [BUF01]! We meet again! How... how wonderful!\pAh, ah, ah, I know I can't let this chance slip away!\pCould you do me a favor, [BUF01]? Help me choose a Pokémon!\pTell me, which is better, [BUF02] or [BUF03]?

zh:
哇!你帮我选了一只!
我要尽我的全力\l培养[BUF02]。\p希望以后你还能
再教我。
en: Wow! You chose one for me! I'll do everything I can to raise [BUF02].\pI hope you'll teach me again sometime.

zh:
哎,喂!
老师![BUF01][BUF05]!\p嗥,我一直在找你,
希望你能再给我些建议!\p哪只宝可梦更适合我?
[BUF02]还是[BUF03]?\p别顾忌什么,
告诉我吧!
en: Hey, hey! Teacher! [BUF01][BUF05]!\pWow, I've been looking all over for you, hoping for more advice!\pWhich Pokémon suits me better? [BUF02] or [BUF03]?\pDon't hold back. Tell me!

zh:
啊哈,是[BUF02]
好,太好了!\l我马上就去抓一只!\p还是多谢了!
拜拜!
en: Aha, it's [BUF02]! Good, great! I'll go catch one right away!\pThanks a bunch! Bye-bye!

zh:
[BUF01][BUF05],听好,有大消息了!
我抓了一只稀有的宝可梦!\p当然,我在撒谎!
啊哈哈哈!\p但我不太擅长
抓宝可梦这一点\l可不是撒谎。\p帮我想想我该
抓什么宝可梦好吗,\l老师?\p[BUF02]和[BUF03]
哪只更好?
en: [BUF01][BUF05], listen up, big news! I caught a rare Pokémon!\pOf course, I'm lying! Ahahaha!\pBut the part about me not being good at catching Pokémon is no lie.\pHelp me figure out what Pokémon I should catch, would you, Teacher?\pWhich is better, [BUF02] or [BUF03]?

zh:
你说要选[BUF02]吗?
那么我就去抓另一种吧!\p哈哈,开玩笑的!
我听你的,老师!\p谢谢你!
希望你以后还能教我!
en: You say [BUF02]? Then I'll go catch the other one!\pHaha, just kidding! I'll take your word for it, Teacher!\pThank you! I hope you'll keep teaching me!

zh:
你说的[BUF02],哈,哈!
我马上就去抓来它!\p如果我想要什么建议,
[BUF01],我总会听听你的话!
en: [BUF02], you say, ha-ha! I'll go catch it right away!\pWhenever I want advice, [BUF01], I'll always come listen to you!

zh:
哇,这不是[BUF01]吗?\p我该怎么办?给我建议?
当然!我已经在和你说话了。\p已经很久了,是该捅破窗户纸的
时候了,我需要你的建议!\l你能告诉我吗?\l你当然会告诉我!\p我该用哪个宝可梦?
[BUF02]和[BUF03],\l我该选哪一个?
en: Well, if it isn't [BUF01]!\pWhat should I do? Get your advice? Of course! I'm already talking to you.\pIt's been a while, so it's time to cut to the chase. I need your advice! Will you tell me? Of course you will!\pWhich Pokémon should I use? [BUF02] or [BUF03], which should I choose?

zh:
如果说最好用[BUF02],
那我就听你的!\p哎,[BUF01],我要去自由地流浪,
但你不要忘记我。\p下回再见,我的朋友!
en: If [BUF02] really is the best, then I'll take your word for it!\pWell, [BUF01], I'm off to wander free, but don't you forget me.\pUntil next time, my friend!

zh:
啊,你好,[BUF01][BUF05]…
我正在头疼一件事情…\p对于要培养哪只宝可梦
我已经想得太多了。\p现在只能这样,
你替我决定好吗?\p[BUF01][BUF05],如果要从
[BUF02]和[BUF03]之中选一个,\l那么选择哪个好呢?
en: Ah, hello, [BUF01][BUF05]... Something's been giving me a headache...\pI've thought way too much about which Pokémon to raise.\pAt this point, could you just decide for me?\p[BUF01][BUF05], if you had to pick between [BUF02] and [BUF03], which would you choose?

zh:
晤,[BUF02],好吧,
我的头疼好一点之后就去抓一只来。\p希望以后还能麻烦你
帮我决定这种事情。
en: Mm, [BUF02], all right. Once my headache eases up, I'll go catch one.\pI hope I can trouble you to decide things like this for me again.

zh:
呋…嗬…
[BUF01][BUF05]…?\p拜托别那么看着我。
我太紧张了…\l我…我希望你能给我点建议。\p真…真不好意思,
能帮我决定一下我该用什么宝可梦吗?\p[BUF02]和[BUF03]之中
我该选哪个?
en: Whew... hmm... [BUF01][BUF05]...?\pPlease don't look at me like that. I'm so nervous... I... I'd like your advice.\pIt's... it's embarrassing, but could you help me decide which Pokémon to use?\pBetween [BUF02] and [BUF03], which should I pick?

zh:
啊…好的!
我会努力找到[BUF02]的。\p但愿我能做到最好,
不要这么慌乱。\p谢谢你,[BUF01][BUF05],
下次我们见面的时候\l希望你还能帮我的忙。
en: Ah... OK! I'll do my best to find a [BUF02].\pI just hope I can do my best and not get so flustered.\pThank you, [BUF01][BUF05]. Next time we meet, I hope you'll help me again.

zh:
嗬?你是[BUF01][BUF05]吗…
你真的是吗?\p哎,没什么,是本人的话就太好了。
我想要你\l给我点建议,\p是关于我使用的宝可梦的。\p如果我要在[BUF02]和[BUF03]
两只宝可梦中选一个,\l哪个会更适合我?
en: Huh? Are you [BUF01][BUF05]... Is it really you?\pOh, never mind. If it's really you, that's great. I'd like you to give me some advice.\pIt's about the Pokémon I use.\pIf I had to choose between [BUF02] and [BUF03], which would suit me better?

zh:
[BUF02]?
你确定吗?\p知道了,那样就太好了,
谢谢你的帮忙。\p希望就算是我也能
沉着地解决这件事。\p下次再见吧!
en: [BUF02]? Are you sure?\pGot it. That's great. Thanks for your help.\pI hope even someone like me can handle this calmly.\pSee you next time!

zh:
哇!噘,[BUF01]!
流鼻涕…打嗑…\p我只有一个选择!
我无法决定我的\l行动[BUF02]…\p请,请,[BUF01]。
你能为我做决定吗?\p因为我[BUF02],哪个决定
才是更好的选择:[BUF03]\l或者[BUF04]?
en: Waah! Oh, [BUF01]! Sniffle... hic...\pI have just one choice to make! I can't decide on a move for my [BUF02]...\pPlease, please, [BUF01]. Could you decide for me?\pFor my [BUF02], which is the better choice: [BUF03] or [BUF04]?

zh:
[BUF02]?
哇!\p哦!对不起,[BUF01]!
你为我做的这个决定使我非常满意\l满意,我在哭…\p流鼻涕…
非常感谢你!
en: [BUF02]? Waah!\pOh! I'm sorry, [BUF01]! The decision you made for me makes me so happy, I'm crying...\pSniffle... Thank you so much!

zh:
唉!嗥,[BUF01]!
我又需要你的建议!\p我想要教我很酷的[BUF02]
行动。\p我喜欢决定中的任何一个
[BUF03]或者[BUF04]。\l你的建议是什么?
en: Hey! Yo, [BUF01]! I need your advice again!\pI want to teach my cool [BUF02] a move.\pI'd be happy with either choice, [BUF03] or [BUF04]. What's your advice?

zh:
[BUF02]更好吗?我想是的!
好,我将和那一起去!\p老师,如果我们再次在这里见面,
请教我其它东西!
en: [BUF02] is better? I thought so! OK, I'll go with that one!\pTeacher, if we meet here again, please teach me something else!

zh:
[BUF01],你好!
对于我来说[BUF02],有点\l担心你的决定。\p你看,这个决定[BUF03]
和[BUF04]。\p对于我来说哪个更好更棒
[BUF02]?
en: [BUF01], hello! I'm a little anxious about this decision for my [BUF02].\pYou see, it's a choice between [BUF03] and [BUF04].\pWhich would be better, even greater, for my [BUF02]?

zh:
[BUF02]是你的选择吗?
好,决定这样了!\p我将立刻[BUF02]去
教我的宠物!\p再见!
en: [BUF02] is your choice? Good, then it's decided!\pI'll teach my Pokémon [BUF02] right away!\pGoodbye!

zh:
哦,[BUF01]…
不,真的,我没希望了!\p我决定饲养一个宠物,
但是现在我甚至不能决定\l让它学习什么…\p我知道这并不意味着给你任何
东西,[BUF01]。\p但是却意味着给我很多…\p请,[BUF01],你你能帮
我做一个决定吗[BUF02]?\p如果你在[BUF03]和[BUF04]
之间选择的话…
en: Oh, [BUF01]... No, really, I'm hopeless!\pI decided to raise a Pokémon, but now I can't even decide what it should learn...\pI know this doesn't mean anything to you, [BUF01].\pBut it means so much to me...\pPlease, [BUF01], could you help me make a decision for my [BUF02]?\pIf you had to choose between [BUF03] and [BUF04]...

zh:
噘,[BUF01][BUF05]!
我也正希望遇见你!\p我正想知道什么活动
适合我[BUF02]。\p我不能决定,你能代替我做
决定吗?\p例如…怎样进行行动
[BUF03] [BUF04]?\l哪一个更好?
en: Oh, [BUF01][BUF05]! I was hoping to run into you!\pI've been wondering what move would suit my [BUF02].\pI can't decide. Could you decide for me?\pFor example... how about the moves [BUF03] and [BUF04]? Which one is better?

zh:
怎么会这么忙?
嗥,如果不是这样[BUF01][BUF05]!\l你将怎么做?\p从我早上一起来,我就做了
慢跑,游泳,和吃饭!\p你不相信我会这么忙吗!\p我甚至不能决定我的
[BUF02]学习!\p[BUF03]看起来不错,哼?
但是[BUF04]也很适合。\p[BUF01][BUF05],给一些好的
建议!怎样做将有益于我?
en: How can I be this busy? Whoa, if it isn't [BUF01][BUF05]! What would you do?\pSince I got up this morning, I've jogged, swum, and eaten!\pCan you believe how busy I am?!\pI can't even decide what my [BUF02] should learn!\p[BUF03] looks good, huh? But [BUF04] would suit it too.\p[BUF01][BUF05], give me some good advice! Which one would do me good?

zh:
好,明白了。
我将在我的安排中在家里\l学习这些。\p我高兴见到一位好顾问。
谢谢!再见!
en: OK, got it. I'll fit teaching that into my schedule at home.\pI'm glad to have such a good advisor. Thanks! Goodbye!

zh:
噘!好幸运!
我又遇见你了,[BUF01]!\l我今天再次需要你的建议。\p请敲打!
我的问题是…\p对于我来说[BUF02],哪个行动
最适合,[BUF03]或者\l[BUF04]?
en: Oh! What luck! I ran into you again, [BUF01]! I need your advice once more today.\pDrumroll, please! My question is...\pFor my [BUF02], which move fits best, [BUF03] or [BUF04]?

zh:
啊!
[BUF02],你说的!\l感谢你精彩的回答!\p我猜这些就是我今天所有
想问你的东西了。\p让我们再次在这里相见,好吗?
谢谢!
en: Ah! [BUF02], you say! Thanks for the brilliant answer!\pI guess that's everything I wanted to ask you today.\pLet's meet here again, OK? Thank you!

zh:
噘,你好,[BUF01]。
我十分信任你?\p我又来寻求你的建议了。
这次是关于我的爱情[BUF02]。\p用什么方式能使我惹
人爱[BUF02]?\l[BUF03]或者[BUF04]?
en: Oh, hello, [BUF01]. You know I trust you completely, right?\pI've come for your advice again. This time it's about my beloved [BUF02].\pWhich move would make my [BUF02] even more lovable? [BUF03] or [BUF04]?

zh:
[BUF02] 这!
我将教你正确的方法!\p谢谢,[BUF01]。
我希望能够再次得到你的指教。\l请小心!
en: [BUF02] it is! I'll teach it properly!\pThanks, [BUF01]. I hope to get your guidance again sometime. Take care!

zh:
有见到你了!
我…我非常高兴!\p每当我需要帮助的时候,你总能
出现,[BUF01]!\p今天,我想要你为我推荐
一个活动!\p请为我选择一个
活动[BUF02]!\p哪个活动更好,
[BUF03]或者[BUF04]?
en: We meet again! I... I'm so happy!\pWhenever I need help, you always show up, [BUF01]!\pToday, I'd like you to recommend a move for me!\pPlease choose a move for my [BUF02]!\pWhich move is better, [BUF03] or [BUF04]?

zh:
哦-哦-哦!谢谢!
[BUF02]这!\l完全了解了!\p我希望你下次教会我更多
东西。
en: Oh-oh-oh! Thank you! [BUF02] it is! I understand completely!\pI hope you'll teach me even more next time.

zh:
啊哈,[BUF02]这是!
是,很好!\l我将教导它,就像,人参一样!\p很好,永远感谢你!
再见!
en: Aha, [BUF02] it is! Yes, very good! I'll teach it, like, right away!\pGreat, thanks forever! Goodbye!

zh:
[BUF01][BUF05],好狂热啊!\p我的宠物!
它学到了6个技术!\p当然我是开玩笑的!
哇哈哈哈!\p虽然这不是谎言。
我的宠物学到这些活动使我感觉\l不是很好。\p所以,到底我怎么选择哪个活动
来学呢?\p[BUF03]或者[BUF04]--哪个
我学最好[BUF02]呢?
en: [BUF01][BUF05], huge news!\pMy Pokémon! It learned 6 moves!\pOf course, I'm joking! Wahahaha!\pBut this part's no lie: I don't feel great about picking moves for my Pokémon to learn.\pSo how on earth do I choose which move to teach?\p[BUF03] or [BUF04]--which is best for my [BUF02] to learn?

zh:
[BUF02],你说,嗥,嗥!
我将立刻去教!\p如果我需要建议,
[BUF01],你的话就是最好的!
en: [BUF02], you say, yo, yo! I'll go teach it right away!\pWhenever I need advice, [BUF01], your word is the best!

zh:
哦,也,如果不是[BUF01]!\p我将怎么做?得到你的建议?
为什么不呢?我已经告诉你了!\p[BUF01],我是否给了你一个惊喜?
我想要你的建议,可以吗?\p你能接受我吗?
你将要接受我!\p我的[BUF02]--要使用什么?
或者[BUF03]是[BUF04],\l你选择的是什么?
en: Oh, yeah, if it isn't [BUF01]!\pWhat should I do? Get your advice? Why not? I'm already talking to you!\p[BUF01], did I catch you by surprise? I want your advice, OK?\pWill you take me on? Of course you will!\pMy [BUF02]--what should it use? [BUF03] or [BUF04], which do you choose?

zh:
如果[BUF02]这是最好的,
我将依你的建议去做!\p那么,[BUF01],我就要走了,
但是你不要忘记我。\p再见,我最好的朋友!
en: If [BUF02] is the best, I'll do as you advise!\pWell then, [BUF01], I'm off, but don't you forget me.\pGoodbye, my best friend!

zh:
呀!啊!哦,[BUF01][BUF05]…
我很冷,我做…\p我想要我的宠物进行,
但是我不能让它达到这个地步…\p于是,事情就这样了,
我需要你给我一个建议。\p[BUF01][BUF05],如果我在这之间有
[BUF03]一个[BUF04]选择\l[BUF02],会是哪个呢?
en: Ah! Oh, [BUF01][BUF05]... I've caught a chill, achoo...\pI want my Pokémon to learn a move, but I just can't get it sorted out...\pSo that's how things stand. I need your advice.\p[BUF01][BUF05], if I had to choose between [BUF03] and [BUF04] for my [BUF02], which would it be?

zh:
咳!
我好了后将教它。\p我希望我能一直像这样
帮助你。
en: Cough! I'll teach it once I'm better.\pI hope you can keep helping me out like this.

zh:
嗬…呋…
[BUF01][BUF05]…?\p请不要那样看着我。
我感到很混乱…\l我…我需要你的建议。\p我…我已经被囚禁了,但是我不能
决定要教我的宠物什么\l活动。\p这是为了我[BUF02]。
如果是这样选择[BUF03]\l[BUF04],哪个会是更好的呢?
en: Hmm... whew... [BUF01][BUF05]...?\pPlease don't look at me like that. I'm all flustered... I... I need your advice.\pI've been agonizing over it, but I can't decide what move to teach my Pokémon.\pIt's for my [BUF02]. If it's a choice between [BUF03] and [BUF04], which would be better?

zh:
噘…好的!
我试一下[BUF02]。\p我希望我能教那样的活动…
这太伤脑筋了…\p谢谢,[BUF01][BUF05]。
如果我们再见面,我希望你能\l给我帮助。
en: Oh... OK! I'll try [BUF02].\pI hope I can teach a move like that... This is so nerve-racking...\pThanks, [BUF01][BUF05]. If we meet again, I hope you'll help me out.

zh:
嗬?你出现了[BUF01][BUF05]…
但是你是真的吗?\p或许你是一个
模仿者?\p不,不,如果你是真的,那就好了。
不需要被覆盖,我保证!\p顺便说一下,我非常喜欢得到你
的建议。\p我也是关于我的[BUF02]。\p什么活动会是更好的选择
选择,[BUF03]或者[BUF04]?
en: Huh? You appeared, [BUF01][BUF05]... But are you the real one?\pOr maybe you're an impersonator?\pNo, no, if you're the real deal, that's great. No offense meant, I promise!\pAnyway, I'd really love to get your advice.\pIt's about my [BUF02] again.\pWhich move would be the better choice, [BUF03] or [BUF04]?

zh:
[BUF02]?
那儿没有问题了?\p我知道。如果很小心,一切都会很好。
非常谢谢你。\p我希望我的宠物能学到一些
东西。\p让我们再见面吧!
en: [BUF02]? No problem there, right?\pI see. If I'm careful, everything will be fine. Thank you so much.\pI hope my Pokémon can learn a thing or two.\pLet's meet again!

zh:
哦…[BUF01]?
这是[BUF01]!\l哦!吸…泣…听!\p我…当我战斗时,我感到很紧张,
如果我赢了,我甚至不能说话…\p当我赢了我希望能很酷的说话
说话…\p请,请,[BUF01]!
你能教我赢了后不酷并且很酷的\l说话吗?
en: Oh... [BUF01]? It's [BUF01]! Oh! Sniff... sob... listen!\pI... I get so nervous when I battle. If I win, I can't even speak...\pWhen I win, I want to say something cool...\pPlease, please, [BUF01]! Could you teach me something cool to say when I win?

zh:
[BUF02]\p太棒了!厉害!哇啊啊啊!
这已经很酷了!\p噘…对不起…
我太高兴了,我要哭…\p流鼻涕…[BUF01]!
谢谢你的每件事!\p因为你我将要表演一场
精彩的战斗,[BUF01]!\p[BUF01]…
下次…我们将战斗!
en: [BUF02]\pAmazing! Awesome! Waaah! That's so cool already!\pOh... sorry... I'm so happy, I'm going to cry...\pSniffle... [BUF01]! Thank you for everything!\pThanks to you, I'm going to put on a brilliant battle, [BUF01]!\p[BUF01]... Next time... we battle!

zh:
耶!这是[BUF01]!你好!
我想问你一些事情!\p我一旦赢了这个比赛那将事
一件很酷的事。\p你能推荐一些很酷事情
说吗?
en: Yay! It's [BUF01]! Hello! I want to ask you something!\pIt would be such a cool thing if I won a battle.\pCould you suggest something cool for me to say?

zh:
[BUF02]\p哦,哇啊!太酷了!
好的,我将会这样说!\p谢谢你这段时间一直在教我!
无论我今后走哪里我都\l会尽力的!\p当我们再见面,那将是一场
战斗!
en: [BUF02]\pOh, wow! So cool! OK, that's what I'll say!\pThanks for teaching me all this time! Wherever I go from here, I'll do my best!\pWhen we meet again, it'll be for a battle!

zh:
你好啊,[BUF01]!\p我和我的宝可梦一切都
准备妥当,只剩下那么一件事。\p我想我获胜的时候找句话来欢呼
应该是件不错的事情。\p你认为应该
怎么欢呼呢?
en: Hello there, [BUF01]!\pMy Pokémon and I are all set, except for one last thing.\pI think it'd be nice to have a victory cheer for when I win.\pWhat do you think I should cheer?

zh:
[BUF02]\p…太帅了!
我决定就用这句了!\p我走到哪里就
战斗到哪里。\p说不定有一天,我就能打败
你了,[BUF01]。\p下次见面时,就让我们痛快
地打一场吧!
en: [BUF02]\p...So stylish! That's the one I'm going with!\pWherever I go, I'll battle.\pWho knows, one day I might even beat you, [BUF01].\pNext time we meet, let's have ourselves a real battle!

zh:
你好,[BUF01]…
很抱歉打扰你,可是我真的绝望了…\p我好不容易…
好不容易赢得了比赛,可我却\l不知道说些什么…\p[BUF01],我知道这对你来说
根本算不了什么。\p但对我而言是件大事…\p拜托了,[BUF01],请告诉我胜利后
要说的台词好吗?
en: Hello, [BUF01]... Sorry to bother you, but I'm truly desperate...\pI finally... finally won a battle, but I didn't know what to say...\p[BUF01], I know this is nothing to you.\pBut it's a big deal to me...\pPlease, [BUF01], will you tell me a line to say when I win?

zh:
[BUF02]\p太棒了…\p啊…我刚才的表现是不是
很棒呢?\p不!我必须全力以赴!\p[BUF01],非常感谢你能
容忍我这么久…\p我保证从现在开始我会全力以赴的。\p我知道你很快就会忘掉
我这种人的,但我们一定会\l再见面的!
en: [BUF02]\pWonderful...\pAh... wasn't that great just now?\pNo! I have to give it my all!\p[BUF01], thank you so much for putting up with me for so long...\pI promise I'll give it everything from now on.\pI know you'll soon forget someone like me, but we will meet again!

zh:
啊啦,[BUF01][BUF05]。
稍微听我说两句。\p我知道我给人的印象不是
不好就是没礼貌…\p当我打赢时,
我会自大起来。\p我不希望人们讨厌我,
所以我想在胜利时\l说些什么以示友好。\p但我根本不知道该怎么办!
你能给我出出主意吗?
en: Oh my, [BUF01][BUF05]. Hear me out a moment.\pI know I come across as either unpleasant or rude...\pWhen I win, I get full of myself.\pI don't want people to hate me, so I'd like to say something friendly when I win.\pBut I have no idea what! Could you give me an idea?

zh:
啊,忙死了,忙死了!
噘,嘿,我正找你呢,[BUF01][BUF05]。\p身体还好吗?
这儿对我来说还是和平常一样。\p每天都要跑步,战斗,
还要画图。我咋这么忙呢?\p就算我再忙,也不能
打赢之后\l抬腿就走吧。\p所以,在我离开时
说些什么才能让我\l显得更酷呢?帮帮我吧,[BUF01][BUF05]!
en: Ah, so busy, so busy! Oh, hey, I was just looking for you, [BUF01][BUF05].\pHow've you been? Things here are the same as ever for me.\pEvery day it's running, battling, and drawing. Why am I so busy?\pBut busy as I am, I can't just win and walk off without a word.\pSo, what should I say as I leave to look extra cool? Help me out, [BUF01][BUF05]!

zh:
[BUF02]\p太好了,就是它了。
我会找机会这么说的!\p老实说,有你这么好的朋友
真是我的福气啊。\p不知怎的,我一有时间
就想和人对战。\p谢谢你,[BUF01][BUF05]!
总有一天,你和我,我们会打一场的!
en: [BUF02]\pPerfect, that's the one. I'll find a chance to say it!\pHonestly, having a friend as good as you is a real blessing.\pSomehow, whenever I have free time, I want to battle someone.\pThank you, [BUF01][BUF05]! Someday, you and me, we're going to have a battle!

zh:
我真走运!
[BUF01]!很高兴见到你!\l和平常一样,我需要你的帮助!\p请听我说,是这样!
我最后的问题就是…\p如果我想在胜利后
显得又炖又酷,我应该\l说点儿什么呢?
en: What luck! [BUF01]! Great to see you! As usual, I need your help!\pHear me out, it's like this! My last question is...\pIf I want to look hip and cool after a win, what should I say?

zh:
[BUF02]\p真…真是太棒了!
真是又炖又酷!就是它了!\p…你听,我认为这样
就很不错,是吧?\p啊,想到以后就要
向其他训练师挑战。\p[BUF01],你真的帮了个大忙。\p说不定哪一天,就是我们
对战的日子了!\p谢谢你的帮助!
en: [BUF02]\pThat's... that's amazing! So hip and cool! That's the one!\p...Listen, that sounds pretty good, right?\pAh, just think, from now on I'll be challenging other Trainers.\p[BUF01], you've been a huge help.\pWho knows, one of these days it'll be our turn to battle!\pThanks for your help!

zh:
嗥,[BUF01]。
见到你非常高兴!\p我不再为我的宝可梦
的事情操心了。\p我是担心我自己…\p你知道作为一名训练师在获胜
之后以应该说点什么吗?\p当然,我希望
我也能做到!\p那么,我获胜时
应该说什么呢?
en: Yo, [BUF01]. Great to see you!\pI've stopped worrying about my Pokémon.\pIt's myself I'm worried about...\pDo you know what a Trainer should say after winning?\pOf course, I hope I can pull it off too!\pSo, what should I say when I win?

zh:
[BUF02]\p啊!太棒了!这话让我清醒
并且感到如获新生!\p我一定将它用好!\p现在,我必须提升实力,
[BUF01]…\p我要和其他人战斗,
但决不会忘记你的教导。\p没准儿哪天…
回见!
en: [BUF02]\pAh! Fantastic! Those words wake me up and make me feel reborn!\pI'll be sure to use them well!\pNow I have to get stronger, [BUF01]...\pI'll battle other people, but I'll never forget your teachings.\pMaybe someday... See you!

zh:
呋!你是[BUF01]吧!
我… 能见到你真是太高兴了!\p噘-噘-噘!我有些事
要向你请教一下!\p不久之前,我赢得了比赛。
那真是令人眼花缦乱!\p但是我在万分高兴之余
就说不出话来了!\p所以,[BUF01],我想请你现在
为我指明一条出路!
en: Whew! You're [BUF01], right? I... I'm so happy to see you!\pOh-oh-oh! There's something I need to ask you!\pNot long ago, I won a battle. It was simply dazzling!\pBut I was so overjoyed, I was left speechless!\pSo, [BUF01], please show me a way out of this!

zh:
[BUF02]\p哇啊啊啊啊!
我以后就要这么说了吗?!\l我…高兴得不知说什么好了!\p谢-谢-谢谢你了!
我现在可以没有遗憾的离开了!\p我要游遍大江南北
和各种人战斗。\p什么也不说了,[BUF01]。
真的,真的,太感谢你了!\p我现在就要走了,但是有一天
我们会见面并且打一场的!
en: [BUF02]\pWaaaah! That's what I get to say from now on?! I... I'm so happy I don't know what to say!\pTh-th-thank you! Now I can leave with no regrets!\pI'm going to travel far and wide and battle all kinds of people.\pNo more words, [BUF01]. Really, truly, thank you so much!\pI'm off now, but one day we'll meet again and battle!

zh:
喂,你好!
[BUF01][BUF05]!\p你知道,我渴望到处流浪并且
到处战斗。\p但是在这之前,我想请你再次
帮助我!\p如果我赢了,我应该如何
向被我打败的训练师\l吹嘘自己的本领呢?
en: Hey, hello! [BUF01][BUF05]!\pYou know, I long to wander everywhere and battle everywhere.\pBut before that, I'd like your help once more!\pIf I win, how should I brag about my skills to the Trainers I've beaten?

zh:
不错!\l我会试着这么说的, 就像是,演员!\p现在,是该说再见的时候了!
谢谢你的指导!\p那天和我打一场吧,怎么样?
再见!
en: Not bad! I'll try saying it, like, an actor!\pNow, it's time to say goodbye! Thanks for your guidance!\pBattle me one of these days, how about it? Goodbye!

zh:
[BUF01][BUF05],有大麻烦了!\p当我赢了的时候,我至少
吹了一个小时的牛!\p当然,我是说着玩儿的!
哇哈哈哈哈!\p尽管是这样,可是。
我并不怎么擅长聊天。\p所以,你认为我获胜后
应该怎么说呢,\l老师?
en: [BUF01][BUF05], big trouble!\pWhen I win, I brag for at least an hour!\pOf course, I'm just kidding! Wahahaha!\pEven so, though, I'm not much good at talking.\pSo, what do you think I should say after I win, Teacher?

zh:
[BUF02]\p我应该这么说,是吗?
那时,我就离开了那里!\p还是小孩子的时候!
我会谨遵教诲的,老师!\p谢谢你的教导,
老师!\p我终于知道了如何成为
一名训练师。\p我要外出并且打败
更多的训练师。\p可能你后还会遇到你,老师!\p就这样!
再见了,老师!
en: [BUF02]\pThat's what I should say, is it? Then I'll make my exit!\pLike a kid again! I'll follow your teachings faithfully, Teacher!\pThank you for your guidance, Teacher!\pI finally know what it takes to be a Trainer.\pI'm going out to beat even more Trainers.\pMaybe I'll run into you again someday, Teacher!\pThat's that! Goodbye, Teacher!

zh:
[BUF02]\p太完美了!以后就用这句了。
我会把它用好的!\p现在,我想我会是,
我们那最棒的!\p感谢你能教我。
我要尽情享受战斗去了!\p一---路---平--安!
一路平安,\l祝你一路平安!
en: [BUF02]\pPerfect! That's my line from now on. I'll use it well!\pNow I think I'll be, like, the best around!\pThanks for teaching me. I'm off to enjoy some battles!\pBon vo-ya-ge! Bon voyage, I wish you bon voyage!

zh:
噘,耶,[BUF01]!
我今天又见到你了!\p我来干啥?再次向你请教?
为啥不呢?我已经向你请教过了!\p不管怎样,[BUF01]…
你能接受我吗?\l你能!\l我需要得到更多的建议!\p是关于我要如何欢呼的。
当战斗获胜时\l很帅地欢呼。\p来吧,我要听听你的意见!
en: Oh, yeah, [BUF01]! I found you again today!\pWhat am I here for? To ask your advice again? Why not? I've done it before!\pAnyway, [BUF01]... will you take me on? Of course you will! I need more advice!\pIt's about how I should cheer. A stylish victory cheer for when I win a battle.\pCome on, let's hear what you think!

zh:
[BUF02]\p好,太好了!
我要用它因为它很简练!\p我还有话要说。
人们分开时都要挥手告别。\p不过也许有一天我们会再见面的,
而且注定要战斗的。\p但是,现在确实是该告别的时候了。\p那么,[BUF01],我要到处流浪,
但请不要忘记我!\p保重,[BUF01]!
宝贝儿!
en: [BUF02]\pGood, real good! I'm using it because it's short and sweet!\pOne more thing. When people part, they wave goodbye.\pBut maybe someday we'll meet again, and we're destined to battle.\pFor now, though, it really is time to say farewell.\pSo, [BUF01], I'm off to wander, but please don't forget me!\pTake care, [BUF01]! Baby!

zh:
[BUF01][BUF05],我完了…
我在不停地流鼻涕…\p我曾试着想过在我胜利时
怎么说才能更酷。\p这让我倍受激励,我哭了起来,
并且开始不停流鼻涕…\p所以,事情发展成这样,
我需要你的帮助,[BUF01][BUF05]。\p当我取得胜利时,
我该说点什么呢?
en: [BUF01][BUF05], I'm done for... My nose won't stop running...\pI tried to think of something cool to say when I win.\pIt moved me so much that I started crying, and my nose started running nonstop...\pSo, that's how things ended up. I need your help, [BUF01][BUF05].\pWhen I win, what should I say?

zh:
[BUF02]\p… … …太棒了。

和鼻子,我以后就这么说了!\p我还有事要和你说,
[BUF01][BUF05]。\p现在开始,我们就是对手了!
谢谢你的帮助!
en: [BUF02]\p... ... ...Wonderful. No, truly moving! I'm tearing up all over again!\pBut never mind my tears and my nose. That's what I'll say from now on!\pThere's something else I have to tell you, [BUF01][BUF05].\pFrom now on, we're rivals! Thanks for your help!

zh:
呋… 哞…

你弄得我很紧张。\p我…我还得向你请教。
在比赛结束之后, 虽然…\p这真的让人难以启齿,
但是如果我赢了比赛\l我该说些什么呢?
en: Whew... hmm... [BUF01][BUF05]...\pPlease don't look at me like that. You're making me nervous.\pI... I have to ask your advice again. About after a battle ends, that is...\pIt's really hard to say, but if I win a battle, what should I say?

zh:
[BUF02]\p哦… 好的!
我会试着这么说的!\l我可能会不好意思说出来…\p谢谢你,[BUF01][BUF05]。
那么再见了。\p我会按你教的那样做的,
[BUF01][BUF05],而且要做到最好。
en: [BUF02]\pOh... OK! I'll try saying that! Though I might be too embarrassed to get it out...\pThank you, [BUF01][BUF05]. Goodbye, then.\pI'll do just as you taught me, [BUF01][BUF05], and I'll do my very best.

应该说些什么呢?

你和其他拥有相同卡的\l训练师战斗录像。\p寻找并和拥有与你有相同卡的训练师

通过阅读新闻。\p请一定要试试看!
en: Thank you for using the Mystery Gift system.\pYour Battle Points Card keeps recordings of battles between you and other Trainers who hold the same card.\pSeek out Trainers who hold the same card as you and battle them!\pYou can check the final rankings by reading the news.\pPlease do give it a try!

zh:
给大力鲷携带后在
战斗时能够超进化
的超进化石。
en: A Mega Stone that enables the Pokémon holding it to Mega Evolve during battle.

zh:
唤设备,方
便前往各个城镇。
en: ...a device that makes it easy to travel to the various towns.

zh:
天生个性高傲,身上的长毛可以
御寒。
en: It is proud by nature. Its long fur protects it from the cold.

zh:
翅膀的攻击非常强而有力,会在
结冰的海中寻找猎物。
en: Its wings deliver powerful blows. It searches for prey in frozen seas.

zh:
能以不输摩托艇的速度游泳。翅
膀的边缘很锐利,能将浮冰切断
。
en: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

zh:
会很多只一起群体行动。虽然身
体很小,但拍打翅膀的力量非常
强。
en: They move about in large flocks. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

zh:
有组成庞大的团队来行动的习性
。各个团队之间的争斗很激烈。
en: It lives in huge flocks. Fights between rival flocks are very fierce.

zh:
个性凶猛,就算遇到比自己更巨
大的对手,也会果敢的挑战。
en: It has a savage nature. It will boldly challenge foes much larger than itself.

zh:
拥有健壮的门牙来啃咬树木与岩
石,在水边建巢居住。
en: It gnaws on trees and rocks with its sturdy front teeth. It makes its nest beside water.

zh:
勤劳地用锐利的门牙啃断树枝和
树根,堆积起来在水边筑巢。
en: It diligently gnaws through branches and roots with its sharp front teeth, piling them up to build its nest by the water.

zh:
用互相撞击触角发出的声音和伙
伴对话。那音色是秋夜的风景诗
。
en: It converses with its friends using the sound of its antennae knocking together. That tone is the poetry of autumn nights.

zh:
鸣叫的时候会将刀子般的前臂交
叉在胸前。即兴创作出旋律。
en: When it cries, it crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest. It improvises melodies.

zh:
察觉到危险时,全身的体毛就会
发出光芒,由此趁对方的眼睛,
还来不及适应时逃走。
en: When it senses danger, the fur all over its body shines brightly. It escapes while its foe's eyes are still dazzled.

zh:
从爪子释放出一击就能令人晕嘏
的电流。由数只组成团队生活。
en: One strike of the electricity from its claws is enough to knock a foe out. It lives in small groups.

zh:
具有能够透视万物的双眼,可以
找到躲藏在阴暗处的对手。
en: Its eyes can see through anything. It can find foes hiding in the shadows.

zh:
如果汔浴到温暖的阳光,花苞就
会打开,飞散出花粉。住在清澈
的水边。
en: When bathed in warm sunlight, its bud opens and scatters pollen. It lives beside clear water.

zh:
用甜甜的香气引诱猎物,并用双
臂的毒刺鞭刺入或勒紧,以了结
对方。
en: It lures prey with a sweet aroma, then finishes them off by piercing or binding them with the poisonous whips on its arms.

zh:
生活在大约1亿年前的密林中。
用最拿手的头锤对抗化石翼龙。
en: It lived in dense jungles about 100 million years ago. It fought Aerodactyl with its prized headbutt.

zh: 对抗化石翼龙。
en: ...to fight Aerodactyl.

zh:
反复使出头锤的头盖骨变得又硬
又厚。但脑子比起头盖龙有所缩
减
en: Its skull grew hard and thick from repeated headbutts. But its brain is smaller than Cranidos's.

zh:
脸部的皮肤坚硬,有磨蹭大树树
干磨皮的习性。
en: The skin on its face is very hard. It has a habit of polishing its face by rubbing it against tree trunks.

zh:
如果是从正面的话,可以防住所
有的攻击,但从后方被袭的话就
束手无策了。
en: It can block any attack from the front, but it is helpless when attacked from behind.

zh:
为了能挡住寒风,会用小树枝或
落叶为材料,做成蓑衣覆盖身体
。
en: To block the cold wind, it makes a cloak from twigs and fallen leaves to cover its body.

zh:
雌性结草儿的进化形态,根据进
化的地点,它的样子也不同。
en: The evolved form of a female Burmy. Its appearance differs depending on where it evolved.

zh:
没有固定的住处,会因为寻找喜
欢的蜜,穿过山野一直飞。
en: It has no fixed home. It flies on and on over hills and fields in search of its favorite nectar.

zh:
三只合而为一的宝可梦,会努力
的搬运花朵的甜甜蜜。
en: Three of them together form a single Pokémon. They work hard to carry sweet flower nectar.

zh:
它的腹部就是幼蜂的蜂巢,幼蜂
吃三蜜蜂收集的蜂蜜长大。
en: Its abdomen is a hive for its grubs, which grow up on the honey gathered by Combee.

zh:
会将积存了静电啪吱啪吱响的毛
球和它喜欢的树果一起藏在树干
的洞里。
en: It hides balls of fur that crackle with static electricity, along with its favorite Berries, in holes in tree trunks.

zh:
颈部的环状毛发可以鼓起可以像
泳圈一样产生浮力,在水中时利
用尾巴快速旋转向前移动。
en: The ring of fur around its neck inflates like a swim ring for buoyancy. In the water, it spins its tail rapidly to move forward.

zh:
它可以很好的漂浮在水面上,会
帮助溺水的人。
en: It floats skillfully on the water's surface and helps people who are drowning.

zh:
进化所需要的营养储存在小小的
球里,看起来非常的香甜可口。
en: The nutrients it needs to evolve are stored in its small ball, which looks sweet and very tasty.

zh:
花苞汔浴阳光后,会绽开花瓣并
活泼地动起来
en: When its bud bathes in sunlight, its petals unfurl and it moves about energetically.

zh:
岩岸是它主要的居所。根据栖息
地的环境和食物的质地,颜色和
样子会有所不同。
en: Rocky shores are its main home. Its color and shape vary with its habitat and the makeup of its food.

zh:
再生能力很高。即使被鱼宝可梦
咬断,也会在几小时内恢复原状
哦
en: It has high regenerative power. Even if a fish Pokémon bites part of it off, it recovers within a few hours.

zh:
以庞大的群体进行行动。把尾巴
紧紧连在一起做成环。就像是友
情的证明。
en: They move about in huge troops. They link their tails tightly together in a ring, as if to prove their friendship.

zh:
据说会牵着年幼孩子的手,将其
带去另一个世界。不喜欢身体重
的孩子
en: It is said to take young children by the hand and carry them off to another world. It dislikes heavy children.

zh:
曾经发生过乘着随风球外出旅行
的男人就这么行踪不明的事件。
en: There was once an incident in which a man who set out traveling on a Drifblim went missing.

zh:
如果猛地伸直总是卷成团的耳朵
,连很大的岩石也能轻易破坏。
en: If it sharply uncoils its usually rolled-up ears, it can easily smash even large rocks.

zh:
戒备心很强。一旦感知到危险,
就会轻巧地跳起来逃之丨丨。
en: It is very wary. The moment it senses danger, it springs away nimbly and flees.

zh:
不知从何处出现,碎碎念着咒文
,施加诅咒,制造恐怖的幻象。
en: It appears out of nowhere, muttering incantations, casting curses, and creating terrifying visions.

zh:
夜行性。只要鸣叫一声,就会有
超过100只的黑暗鸦跟班聚集
起来。
en: It is nocturnal. A single cry from it will summon more than 100 of its Murkrow underlings.

zh:
一不称心,就会竖起爪子。但偶
尔会从喉咙里发出声响来撒娇,
这样的性格很受部分人喜爱。
en: When displeased, it bares its claws. Yet it sometimes purrs sweetly to fawn on others--a temperament some people adore.

zh:
即使是其他宝可梦的住所,如果
感觉很舒服的话,就会赖着当做
自己的住所
en: Even if a den belongs to another Pokémon, if it feels comfortable there, it will move in and claim it as its own.

zh:
每次跳跃都会发出铃铃声。用高
频率的叫声让对手失聪。
en: A bell-like ring sounds with every hop it makes. It deafens foes with its high-frequency cries.

zh:
从屁屁喷出的臭液的气味会扩散
到半径2公里的范围,周围的宝
可梦都会逃得无影无踪。
en: The stench of the fluid sprayed from its rear spreads over a two-kilometer radius, and nearby Pokémon flee without a trace.

zh:
从尾巴尖端喷出带有恶臭的液体
进行攻击。喷射距离能达到50
米以上。
en: It attacks by spraying a foul-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail. It can hit targets more than 50 meters away.

zh:
过去的人们相信,铜镜怪背上的
花纹里蕴藏着神秘的力量。
en: People long ago believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back held a mysterious power.

zh:
从遥远的过去开始就作为能召唤
雨云的宝可梦被供奉着。时不时
会被埋入地下
en: Since the distant past, it has been worshipped as a Pokémon that can summon rain clouds. It is sometimes found buried underground.

zh:
很怕水,所以生活在干燥的地方
。因为周围绿色很少,所以相当
醒目。
en: It fears water, so it lives in dry places. It stands out because there is so little greenery around it.

zh:
能完美地模仿对手的动作,趁对
手迷惑的时候迅速逃走
en: It perfectly mimics its opponent's movements, then swiftly flees while the foe is bewildered.

zh:
腹部的袋子里装着白色的圆形石
头。如果关系变好,也可能会分
给你哦。
en: It keeps a round white stone in its belly pouch. If you grow close to it, it may even share the stone with you.

zh:
通过发出与对手相同的叫声,让
对方深信自己是同伴,从而免受
袭击。
en: By making the same cry as its opponent, it convinces them it is a friend and avoids being attacked.

zh:
108个魂魄聚集在一起生成的
宝可梦。被绑缚在楔石的裂缝里
。
en: A Pokémon formed from 108 spirits gathered together. It is bound to the crack in an Odd Keystone.

zh:
生活在因地热而温暖的洞窟里。
即便如此,一旦变冷就会和伙伴
们紧紧挨在一起。
en: It lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat. Even so, when it gets cold, it huddles close with its friends.

zh:
偶尔蜕皮,鳞片会脱落。其成分
中所含的药物成分可以让疲劳的
身体活力四射。
en: It sheds its skin from time to time, and its scales fall off. The medicinal ingredients they contain can fill a tired body with energy.

zh:
以媛美喷气式飞机的高速来飞行
。如果冲入鸟宝可梦的群体中,
会就这么把整个群体都吞掉。
en: It flies at speeds rivaling a jet plane. If it plunges into a flock of bird Pokémon, it swallows the whole flock.

zh:
每天必须要吃和自重同等分量的
食物。味道的好坏并不在意。
en: It must eat an amount of food equal to its own weight every day. It pays no attention to how the food tastes.

zh:
以“波导”这种波的形式观察人
和宝可梦的感情,以及自然的样
子。
en: It reads the feelings of people and Pokémon, and the state of nature, through waves known as auras.

zh:
不仅仅是读取,还获得了操控波
导的能力。也会被用于战斗。
en: It has gained the power not only to read auras but to control them. It uses them in battle, too.

zh:
在干燥的土地生活。是身体会分
泌出沙粒而不是汗水的宝可梦。
en: It lives on dry land. Its body secretes grains of sand instead of sweat.

zh:
嘴巴张得大大的,炖耀自己的强
大。向上卷起大量的沙子进行攻
击。
en: It opens its mouth wide to show off its strength. It attacks by whipping up huge amounts of sand.

zh:
用尾巴上的钩爪夹住猎物并注入
毒素。很执着,毒不发作就绝不
松开。
en: It grips prey with the claws on its tail and injects poison. Tenacious, it never lets go until the poison takes effect.

zh:
用引以为傲的力量把对手打得七
零八落,而且还要用剧毒给对手
致命一击。
en: It batters foes to pieces with its prized strength, then delivers the final blow with a deadly poison.

zh:
脸颊上带有毒囊。会抓住对手的
空当,用渗透了剧毒的手指猛戳
。
en: It has poison sacs in its cheeks. It waits for an opening, then jabs the foe with fingers steeped in deadly poison.

zh:
喉咙里带有毒囊。如果从喉咙发
出声响,储存的毒素会被炼制得
更强劲。
en: It has a poison sac in its throat. When it croaks, the stored toxin is refined and becomes even more potent.

zh:
先用甜香的唾液引诱猎物,然后
用大颉大口地嚼。要花1整天吃
掉猎物。
en: It first lures prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chews them up with its big mouth. It takes a whole day to eat its prey.

zh:
粉红色的那部分皮肤会储存太阳
光并发光。听说是用来做保护色
的。
en: The pink parts of its skin store sunlight and glow. It is said this serves as protective coloration.

zh:
利用光来诱惑猎物靠近,但是作
为天敌的凶猛鱼宝可梦也靠了过
来。
en: It uses light to lure prey closer, but that also draws in the ferocious fish Pokémon that are its natural enemies.

zh:
背上的花纹根据地域而有所不同
。常常混在铁炮鱼群里。
en: The pattern on its back varies by region. It often mingles with schools of Remoraid.

zh:
在寒冷的季节里,会迁移到山脚
下,一到春天就会返回积雪残留
的山顶。
en: In cold seasons, it moves down to the foot of the mountain. When spring comes, it returns to the snowcapped peak.

zh:
会引发暴风雪,让周围变得一片
雪白。别名叫冰雪怪物。
en: It whips up blizzards that turn its surroundings pure white. It is also known as the Ice Monster.

zh:
4-5只一组进行行动。在岩石
和树木上留下记号,以团队合作
捕杀猎物。
en: They move in groups of four or five. They leave signs on rocks and trees and hunt down prey through teamwork.

zh:
从3个组件中放出磁力。经常有
把飞向夜空的自爆磁怪错看成U
FO的报告
en: It emits magnetism from its three units. Magnezone flying through the night sky are often reported as UFOs.

zh:
不断伸出的舌头会卷住任何东西
。一不留神靠近的话,就会被唾
液弄得稞糊糊的。
en: Its ever-extending tongue wraps around anything. Get careless near it, and you'll end up covered in sticky saliva.

zh:
从手掌的洞里发射出小拳石。全
身的护具连火山喷发都能经受住
。
en: It launches Geodude from the holes in its palms. Its full-body armor can withstand even volcanic eruptions.

zh:
伸出由植物的藤蔓长成的手臂缠
住猎物。即便手臂被吃掉也毫不
在意。
en: It extends arms made of plant vines to entangle prey. It doesn't mind at all even if its arms get eaten.

zh:
用尾巴尖尖按住敌人,输入高压
电流。敌人瞬间就成黑炭了
en: It presses the tips of its tails against a foe and pours in a high-voltage current. The foe is charred black in an instant.

zh:
栖息在火山口。据说一座火山只
有一对鸭嘴炎兽。
en: It dwells in volcanic craters. It is said that each volcano is home to only a single pair of Magmortar.

zh:
据说,波克基斯会访问没有争端
的和平之地,给那里带去各种恩
惠
en: It is said that Togekiss visits peaceful lands free of strife and brings them all manner of blessings.

zh:
高速飞行着,在擦肩而过的瞬间
咬断对手的脖子。它热衷这样的
战斗方式。
en: Flying at high speed, it bites through its foe's neck the instant it passes by. It relishes this way of fighting.

zh:
比起动物,细胞构成更接近植物
。用光合作用,就算不吃也能获
得能量。
en: Its cellular composition is closer to a plant's than an animal's. Through photosynthesis, it can get energy without eating.

zh:
自由地控制体温,让大气中的水
分冻结,卷起冰晶。
en: It freely controls its body temperature to freeze the moisture in the air, whipping up crystals of ice.

zh:
用尾巴倒挂在树枝上观察猎物。
瞅准空当就从上空发动袭击。
en: It hangs upside down from branches by its tail to watch for prey. The moment it spots an opening, it strikes from above.

zh:
从遥远的过去就存在的宝可梦,
甚至在1万年前的冰层中也发现
过它。
en: A Pokémon that has existed since the distant past. One was even found in ice 10,000 years old.

zh:
以更优秀的宝可梦为目标,好像
新追加的程序状况不佳,动作很
奇怪。
en: It was upgraded to become an even better Pokémon, but the newly added program seems faulty, and it moves strangely.

zh:
因为有着能敏锐感知对手想法的
能力,所以可以率先攻击。
en: With its keen ability to sense what its opponent is thinking, it can strike first.

zh:
因为会释放强大的磁力,所以导
致附近的电器都变得无法使用。
en: It gives off such powerful magnetism that nearby electronic devices become unusable.

zh:
据说,会把无处可去的魂魄吸入
它那具有弹力的身体中,并带往
另一个世界
en: It is said to draw spirits with nowhere to go into its elastic body and carry them off to another world.

zh:
用冷气把中意的人类或宝可梦都
冻起来。然后带回巢穴当装饰用
。
en: It freezes humans and Pokémon it takes a liking to with cold air, then carries them back to its den as decorations.

zh:
作为驱动特殊马达的动力能源而
被长期研究的宝可梦。
en: A Pokémon long studied as a source of power for driving a special motor.

zh:
被称为知识之神。据说拥有消除
与之目光交会者的记忆的力量。
en: It is known as the Being of Knowledge. It is said to have the power to erase the memories of any who meet its gaze.

zh:
教会了人们悲伤的痛苦和快乐的
宝贵。被称为感情之神。
en: It taught people the pain of sorrow and the value of joy. It is known as the Being of Emotion.

zh:
被称为意志之神。一直沉睡在湖
底,维持着世界的平衡
en: It is known as the Being of Willpower. It sleeps at the bottom of a lake, keeping the world in balance.

zh:
由于帝牙卢卡的诞生,时间才开
始流动。是有着这样传说的宝可
梦
en: Legends say that time began to flow only when Dialga was born.

zh:
据说居住在平行排列的空间狭缝
中,是出现在神话中的宝可梦。
en: It is said to dwell in the gaps between parallel dimensions. A Pokémon that appears in mythology.

zh:
栖息在火山的洞穴里。用十字形
的爪子钩住墙壁和洞顶爬来爬去
en: It dwells in volcanic caves. It crawls along walls and ceilings, hooking them with its cross-shaped claws.

zh:
据说用特殊的冰山,岩石和熔岩
制作出了形似自己的宝可梦
en: It is said to have made Pokémon in its own image out of special ice, rocks, and magma.

zh:
据说栖息在位于这个世界背面的
毁坏的世界里。那里所有的常规
都与这个世界不同
en: It is said to inhabit a ruined world on the reverse side of ours, where none of the usual rules apply.

zh:
飞行的时候,会从薄纱一样的翅
膀中发出闪光粒子。被称为新月
的化身
en: When it flies, shining particles stream from its gauzy wings. It is called the embodiment of the crescent moon.

zh:
如果海水的温度上升,该宝可梦
就会让头部的浮囊膨胀起来,然
后集体在海面上漂浮
en: When the seawater warms, this Pokémon inflates the flotation sac on its head and drifts on the surface in groups.

zh:
如果使用与生俱来的神奇力量,
就可以和任何宝可梦心意相通。
en: By using its innate mysterious power, it can bond hearts with any Pokémon.

zh:
用能引诱对方进入深度睡眠的力
量,让人和宝可梦做恶梦,并将
其驱逐出自己的领地。
en: With its power to lull others into deep sleep, it gives people and Pokémon nightmares and drives them from its territory.

zh:
拥有分解大气中的毒素,让荒芜
大地瞬间变成花圃的力量。
en: It has the power to break down toxins in the air and instantly turn barren land into a field of flowers.

zh:
神奥神话里说,它从蛋中现身,
并创造出了整个世界。
en: Sinnoh mythology says that it appeared from an egg and created the entire world.

zh:
是会带来胜利的宝可梦。据说带
着比克提尼的训练家会赢得任何
对战。
en: A Pokémon that brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, no matter the battle.

zh:
如果汔浴在阳光下,就能比平时
动作迅速。比起手,藤蔓用得更
灵活。
en: When bathed in sunlight, it moves far more swiftly than usual. It uses its vines more skillfully than its hands.

zh:
像滑行一样在地面奔跑。用敏捷
的动作迷惑敌人,然后用藤鞭了
结。
en: It runs along the ground as if gliding. It bewilders foes with its nimble movements, then finishes them off with its vine whip.

zh:
君主蛇只会对那些即使被它高贵
的眼眢盯着,也毫不畏惧的强大
对手动真格。
en: Serperior gets serious only against strong opponents who are not cowed by its noble gaze.

zh:
可以轻巧地躲避敌人的攻击,从
鼻子里射出火球来。会用火烤树
果吃。
en: It nimbly dodges foes' attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts Berries before eating them.

zh:
吃得越多,可供燃烧的东西就越
多,胃里的火会增强,力量也会
源源不断地溢出
en: The more it eats, the more fuel it has. The fire in its stomach grows stronger, and power wells up without end.

zh:
用下颉的火焰燃烧拳头,连续使
出火焰拳。是对伙伴非常体贴的
宝可梦。
en: It sets its fists alight with the flames on its chin and unleashes flurries of fiery punches. It is very caring toward its comrades.

zh:
腹部长出的扇贝贝不只是战斗时
使用,还能用来割开坚硬的树果
。
en: The scalchop on its belly isn't just for battle--it can also be used to crack open hard Berries.

zh:
通过严格的修炼,将使用2片扇
贝贝的刀法运用得行云流水。
en: Through strict training, it has mastered a flowing swordsmanship that uses its two scalchops.

zh:
能在敌人眨眼的瞬间,用前脚上
带有的双足刃切斩对手,然后将
其收回。
en: In the blink of an eye, it can draw the blades on its forelegs, cut down its foe, and sheathe them again.

zh:
会在颊囊里藏食物,连续放哨好
几天。用尾巴给伙伴发出暗号。
en: It hides food in its cheek pouches and stands watch for days on end. It signals its friends with its tail.

zh:
用体内的发光物质让眼珠和身体
闪闪发光,使来袭的敌人畏缩。
en: It uses luminescent matter in its body to make its eyes and body glow, cowing attackers.

zh:
因为不会汪汪汪地叫个不停,所
以对于住在公寓里的训练家是人
气很高的宝可梦。
en: Because it doesn't yap endlessly, it is a very popular Pokémon among Trainers who live in apartments.

zh:
黑色的体毛非常坚硬,会不断长
出。是要花修剪费,很费事的宝
可梦。
en: Its black fur is very hard and never stops growing. Trimming costs make it a high-maintenance Pokémon.

zh:
聪明温厚而勇敢。是救援队队员
们可以信赖的伙伴。
en: Clever, gentle, and brave, it is a partner that rescue-team members can rely on.

zh:
用可爱的动作让对手疏忽,抓住
那个空当抢夺持有物。一旦生气
,就会竖起爪子反击。
en: It disarms foes with cute gestures and steals their belongings in that instant. When angered, it fights back with its claws.

zh:
优美的身姿归功于全身发达的肌
肉。能悄无声息地在夜间飞奔。
en: Its graceful form comes from the well-developed muscles throughout its body. It can dash through the night without a sound.

zh:
会把头上的叶子分给没有精神的
宝可梦。具有缓解疲劳的效果。
en: It shares the leaves on its head with Pokémon that are feeling low. The leaves relieve fatigue.

zh:
用带有很多尖刺的尾巴摔打对手
进行攻击。是性格很粗暴的宝可
梦。
en: It attacks by slamming its thorn-covered tail into foes. It is a very rough-tempered Pokémon.

zh:
智商很高,有着将树果烤熟后再
吃的习性。很喜爱给人类帮忙。
en: Highly intelligent, it has a habit of roasting Berries before eating them. It loves to help people.

zh:
燃烧体内的火焰,从头和尾巴纷
纷扬扬地撒出火花,把敌人都烧
焦。
en: It burns the flames within its body and scatters showers of embers from its head and tail, scorching its enemies.

zh:
头上的毛发丛里储藏的水充满了
营养。会用尾巴给草木浇这种水
。
en: The water stored in the tuft on its head is packed with nutrients. It uses its tail to water plants with it.

zh:
如果从尾巴发射出高压水,那威
力甚至能破坏混凝土墙壁。
en: The high-pressure water it fires from its tail is powerful enough to smash through concrete walls.

zh:
会出现在为恶梦所苦的宝可梦和
人的面前,吃掉那个恶梦。
en: It appears before people and Pokémon tormented by nightmares and eats those bad dreams.

zh:
从额头冒出的烟雾里载满许许多
多的人和宝可梦做的梦。
en: The mist that rises from its forehead is filled with the dreams of countless people and Pokémon.

zh:
非常健忘的宝可梦。明明训练家
已经下了命令,却还在等待着新
命令。
en: A very forgetful Pokémon. Even after its Trainer gives an order, it keeps waiting for a new one.

zh:
人们相信,咕咕鸽所居住的森林
深处有着没有战争的和平国度。
en: People believe that deep within the forests where Tranquill live lies a peaceful land free of war.

zh:
雄性会摇晃头上的冠羽威吓对手
。雌性的飞行能力在雄性之上。
en: The male swings the plume on its head to threaten foes. Females surpass males in flying ability.

zh:
天空雷雨云密布时就会出现。用
鬃毛捕捉雷电,储存电力。
en: It appears when the sky is thick with thunderclouds. It catches lightning with its mane and stores the electricity.

zh:
性格粗暴的宝可梦。如果发脾气
,就会从鬃毛里向着四面八方放
电。
en: A rough-tempered Pokémon. When it loses its temper, it discharges electricity from its mane in every direction.

zh:
在地下的最深处诞生。会与亲缘
相近的小拳石和小碎钻较量硬度
。
en: It is born in the deepest part of the ground. It compares its hardness with its close relatives Geodude and Carbink.

zh:
橙色的结晶是能量块。一块结晶
可提供100辆翻斗车所需的燃
料。
en: Its orange crystals are lumps of energy. A single crystal holds enough fuel to power 100 dump trucks.

zh:
从太阳光线中造出来的能量弹威
力巨大。但是晚上和雨天无法射
击。
en: The energy blasts it creates from sunlight are tremendously powerful, but it can't fire them at night or in the rain.

zh:
生活在昏暗的森林和洞穴中。从
鼻孔里发出超音波探查周边的情
形。
en: It lives in dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nostrils to probe its surroundings.

zh:
发出连混凝土都能破坏的强力超
音波时,尾巴会激烈地振动。
en: When it emits ultrasonic waves powerful enough to shatter concrete, its tail vibrates fiercely.

zh:
将双掌上的爪子并拢,并让身体
高速旋转的话,就会以迅猛的速
度在地里前进。
en: By putting the claws on both paws together and spinning its body at high speed, it can burrow through the ground at a tremendous pace.

zh:
进化成钢的钻头拥有穿透铁板的
破坏力。在隧道工程里非常活跃
。
en: Its drill has evolved into steel with the power to bore through iron plates. It is a great help in tunnel construction.

zh:
通过耳朵上的触角,能了解对方
的身体状况,甚至连宝可梦何时
从蛋里孵出来都能知道。
en: With the feelers on its ears, it can tell how others are feeling--even when a Pokémon will hatch from its Egg.

zh:
总是抱着方材。是会出现在建筑
工地帮忙干活的宝可梦。
en: It is always carrying a squared log. It shows up at construction sites and helps with the work.

zh:
肌肉锻炼得很棒。能够灵巧地操
纵工字钢,将整座屋子拆除。
en: Its muscles are superbly trained. It deftly wields its steel beam to tear whole buildings down.

zh:
制作混凝土的技术,被认为是2
000年前从修建老匠那儿学来
的。
en: The technique of making concrete is thought to have been learned from Conkeldurr 2,000 years ago.

zh:
振动脸颊上的振动膜,发出人类
无法听见的音波向伙伴们传递危
险警告。
en: It vibrates the membranes on its cheeks to emit sound waves people can't hear, warning its friends of danger.

zh:
如果让头上的瘤振动,不只是水
里泛起波浪,连地面也会像地震
一样摇晃。
en: When it vibrates the bump on its head, it not only stirs up waves in the water but shakes the ground like an earthquake.

zh:
如果让拳头上的瘤振动,拳击的
威力就会倍增。能一拳把巨大岩
石击得粉碎。
en: Vibrating the bumps on its fists doubles the power of its punches. One punch can smash a huge boulder to pieces.

zh:
如果系紧带子,力量就会提升。
野生的投摔鬼会编织藤蔓做成自
己的带子。
en: Tightening its belt raises its power. Wild Throh weave their own belts from vines.

zh:
因追求最强的空手劈而隐居在深
山里,不眠不休地修行。
en: In pursuit of the ultimate karate chop, it secludes itself deep in the mountains and trains without rest or sleep.

zh:
咬断叶子,用嘴里吐出的粘丝进
行缝合。是会自己做衣服的宝可
梦。
en: It bites off leaves and sews them with the sticky thread it spits from its mouth. A Pokémon that makes its own clothes.

zh:
宝包茧会把落叶转换成养分,所
以它居住的森林总是草木繁茂。
en: It converts fallen leaves into nutrients, so the forests it lives in are always lush and green.

zh:
如果发现幼小的宝可梦,就会用
嘴里吐出的粘丝为它缝制叶子衣
服。
en: When it finds a young Pokémon, it sews clothes of leaves for it using the sticky silk it spits from its mouth.

zh:
用头和尾巴上的触角探查周围的
情形。性格非常粗暴。
en: It probes its surroundings with the feelers on its head and tail. Its disposition is extremely violent.

zh:
被坚硬的壳保护着。像轮胎那样
地旋转,猛烈地撞击敌人。
en: It is protected by a hard shell. It spins like a tire and slams violently into enemies.

zh:
用颈部的爪子夹住猎物,让对方
动弹不得之后,施以剧毒,一击
毙命。
en: It grips prey with the claws on its neck until they can't move, then finishes them off with deadly poison in a single blow.

zh:
找到伙伴后就会贴上去。贴得太
多的话,有时候看上去就像积雨
云。
en: When it finds others of its kind, it sticks to them. When too many stick together, they can look like a cumulonimbus cloud.

zh:
乘着风侵入民居。把房间里弄得
满是棉花后,咯咯咯地笑着离去
。
en: It rides the wind into people's homes. After filling the room with cotton, it leaves with a chuckle.

zh:
头上的叶子苦得让人头晕眼花,
但是对疲惫的身体很有效果。如
果煎服饮用会更有效。
en: The leaves on its head are so bitter they make you dizzy, but they work well on tired bodies. Brewing them makes them even more effective.

zh:
无论花多少工夫和金钱,比起借
助人工手段让它开放,在野外绽
放的花更美。
en: No matter how much time and money is spent, flowers made to bloom by artificial means can't match the beauty of those blooming in the wild.

zh:
性格非常粗暴,红色和蓝色的野
蛮鱿鱼一直都在争斗。吃起来好
像出乎意料的鲜美。
en: It has an extremely violent nature. The red and blue ones are always fighting. They're said to be surprisingly tasty.

zh:
潜藏在沙中像游泳一样移动。是
为了不被敌人发现和不让体温下
降而采取的机智行为。
en: It hides in the sand and moves as if swimming--clever behavior that keeps it hidden from enemies and keeps its body temperature from dropping.

zh:
数只成群后行动。群体的中心大
多都是♀,♂们会收集食物。
en: They move about in small groups. The center of the group is mostly made up of ♀, while the ♂ gather food.

zh:
拥有特殊的双眼,即使在沙暴中
也能发现前方50公里处的小猎
物。
en: Its special eyes can spot small prey 50 km away, even in the middle of a sandstorm.

zh:
火红不倒翁的粪便是热的,因此
过去的人们会放入怀中取暖。
en: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people long ago would tuck them into their clothes to keep warm.

zh:
如果在激烈的战斗中受伤,就会
像岩石一样一动不动,沉思着磨
炼自己的心智。
en: When wounded in a fierce battle, it becomes as still as a rock, meditating to sharpen its mind.

zh:
对于那些以花的种子为目标的天
敌鸟宝可梦,会用节奏轻快的舞
蹈和音乐来驱赶。
en: It drives away bird Pokémon--natural enemies after its flower seeds--with rhythmical dancing and music.

zh:
在合适的石头上开洞作为住所。
如果被破坏,在找到替代的石头
之前会一直心里不踏实。
en: It bores a hole in a suitable rock to make its home. If the rock is broken, it feels uneasy until it finds a replacement.

zh:
脚力非常的好,身上背负着很重
的岩石,还能在干燥的土地上移
动多日。
en: Its legs are remarkably strong. Even carrying heavy rocks on its back, it can travel across dry land for days.

zh:
把皮拉到颈部,摆出防御的姿势
。橡胶般有弹力的皮能减少伤害
。
en: It pulls its skin up to its neck in a defensive pose. Its rubbery, elastic skin reduces damage.

zh:
把蜕下来的皮往上提,减少伤害
的同时使出脚踢!头上的冠越大
,似乎地位越高。
en: It pulls up its shed skin to reduce damage while lashing out with kicks! The bigger the crest on its head, the higher its rank, it seems.

zh:
曾是古代都市的守护神。用精神
力量攻击入侵领地的敌人。
en: It was the guardian deity of an ancient city. It uses psychic power to attack enemies that invade its territory.

zh:
有传言说,它会吞掉接近它的人
类,做成木乃伊。喜欢吃金块。
en: Rumor has it that it swallows people who come near and turns them into mummies. It loves to eat gold nuggets.

zh:
根据对其骨骰的调查结果,它似
乎能潜到大约1000米的深海
之中。
en: Studies of its bones suggest it could dive to depths of about 1,000 meters.

zh:
为了形成结实的甲壳,会把猎物
的硬壳和骨头都整个嚼碎了吃下
去。
en: To build its tough shell, it chews up and swallows its prey whole--hard shells, bones, and all.

zh:
是所有鸟宝可梦的祖先。始祖小
鸟本身还不会飞,在树上跳着移
动。
en: The ancestor of all bird Pokémon. Archen itself couldn't fly yet, moving by hopping through the trees.

zh:
好像也会飞行,但主要是在地上
四处飞奔。平均时速达到40公
里。
en: It seems capable of flight, but it mostly dashes about on the ground, averaging 40 km per hour.

zh:
喜欢不卫生的场所。在阿罗拉经
常可以发现被臭泥追着到处跑的
样子。
en: It loves unsanitary places. In Alola, it's often spotted being chased around by Grimer.

zh:
要注意从右臂喷出的毒液。只要
沾到一点点,就会被未知的毒素
侵袭。
en: Watch out for the poisonous liquid sprayed from its right arm. Even the slightest touch infects you with unknown toxins.

zh:
经常幻化成和对手一模一样的外
表,趁对方受骗惊吓的空当逃之
丨丨。
en: It often transforms into an exact copy of its opponent, then slips away while the startled foe is still fooled.

zh:
拥有一下子迷惑许多人的力量。
展现出虚幻的景色来保护自己的
住所。
en: It has the power to beguile many people at once. It protects its den by showing illusory scenery.

zh:
泡沫栗鼠会互相用尾巴将对方清
理得干干净净,这是它们彼此打
招呼的方式。
en: Minccino groom each other spotless with their tails. It's how they greet one another.

zh:
白色的体毛触感超群。完全不会
吸附到灰尘和静电。
en: Its white fur feels wonderful to the touch. It repels dust and static electricity completely.

zh:
用蝴蝶结一样的触角让精神力量
增强。一直都目不转睛地盯着什
么。
en: Its ribbonlike feelers boost its psychic power. It's always staring intently at something.

zh:
星光是其力量的来源。到了夜里
就会用精神力量让石头浮起,按
星星的分布排列。
en: Starlight is the source of its power. At night, it uses psychic power to levitate stones and arrange them to match the stars.

zh:
受强大的精神力量的影响,周围
的空间会扭曲,数万光年之外的
星空也能映照出来。
en: Its immense psychic power warps the space around it, reflecting starry skies from tens of thousands of light-years away.

zh:
身体被特殊的液体包裹着,所以
无论多么严峻的情况都能平安无
事。
en: Its body is wrapped in a special liquid, so it stays safe in even the harshest conditions.

zh:
因为有着一分为二的大脑,所以
有时会突然采取不同的行动。
en: Because its brain is divided in two, it sometimes suddenly takes two different actions at once.

zh:
使用发出的精神力量,操纵特殊
液体做成的手臂将岩石击碎。
en: It uses its psychic power to control arms made of a special liquid, smashing rocks with them.

zh:
如果被敌人袭击,就会从全身的
羽毛里喷出水花。混在一片水雾
中逃之丨丨。
en: If attacked by an enemy, it sprays water from all its feathers and slips away under cover of the spray.

zh:
尽管有着优雅的外表,挥动翅膀
时却很用力,可以连续飞行几千
公里。
en: Despite its elegant appearance, it flaps its wings powerfully and can fly thousands of kilometers without a break.

zh:
从冰柱中诞生的宝可梦。用冰冷
的气息制造雪的结晶,让天上下
雪。
en: A Pokémon born from icicles. It creates snow crystals with its freezing breath and makes snow fall from the sky.

zh:
在炎热的天气里身体会融化。如
果让它冻住就会恢复原状,但身
体的形状会稍稍歪掉。
en: Its body melts in hot weather. Freezing it restores it, though its shape ends up slightly warped.

zh:
2个头拥有各自的大脑,如果两
者意见一致,就会喷出猛烈的暴
风雪袭击敌人。
en: Its two heads each have their own brain. When the two agree, it blasts enemies with a raging blizzard.

zh:
不只是换季时,即使是气温和湿
度的变化,身体颜色也会有稍稍
改变。
en: Its body color changes subtly not only with the seasons but also with shifts in temperature and humidity.

zh:
会根据季节改变住所。人们会通
过萌芽鹿的角来感知季节的变迁
。
en: It changes where it lives with the seasons. People sense the changing of the seasons from Deerling's horns.

zh:
用斗篷一样的膜滑翔。到处放电
,让敌人和同伴都纷纷触电。
en: It glides on its cape-like membrane, scattering electricity everywhere and shocking friend and foe alike.

zh:
与小嘴蜗在一起时,如果受到电
的刺激就会进化的神奇宝可梦。
en: A mysterious Pokémon that evolves when it receives electrical stimulation while together with Shelmet.

zh:
用从小嘴蜗那里抢来的壳盖住自
己的身体,一边防守一边用2根
长矛突刺。
en: It covers itself with a shell stolen from Shelmet, defending while thrusting with its two lances.

zh:
以酷似精灵球的花纹引诱对手并
向其喷出毒孚子。为何那么像还
是一个谜。
en: It lures foes with markings that look just like a Poké Ball, then sprays poison spores. Why it looks so similar is still a mystery.

zh:
显摆着精灵球状的菌伞引诱猎物
靠近,但是被骗到的宝可梦很少
。
en: It flaunts its Poké Ball-shaped cap to lure prey closer, but very few Pokémon are fooled.

zh:
用毒将猎物麻痹后,将其带到据
说在海下8000米深的住所。
en: It paralyzes prey with poison, then drags it down to its lair, said to lie 8,000 meters beneath the sea.

zh:
身体几乎都是海水。据说,海底
有胖喔喔弄沉的船做成的城堡。
en: Its body is almost entirely seawater. It's said there's a castle on the seafloor built from ships Jellicent has sunk.

zh:
抱着受伤的宝可梦,用特殊的粘
液敷伤口。但其中的理由不太清
楚。
en: It embraces injured Pokémon and dresses their wounds with its special mucus. Why it does so is not well understood.

zh:
因为自己不能制造电,所以会附
在其它大型宝可梦身上吸取静电
。
en: Since it can't produce electricity itself, it clings to large Pokémon and absorbs their static electricity.

zh:
会用带电的丝设下陷卩。会慢慢
地享用触电后无法动弹的猎物。
en: It sets traps with electrified threads, then slowly savors prey left unable to move by the shock.

zh:
察觉到危险的同时会发射尖刺反
击。然后趁机翻滚着逃跑。
en: The moment it senses danger, it fires spikes in retaliation, then rolls away to escape in the confusion.

zh:
挥打3根触手,然后射出尖刺,
将对手粉碎,不留痕迹。
en: It swings its three feelers and fires spikes, smashing opponents to bits without a trace.

zh:
通过2个身体的咬合旋转,制造
出用以生存的能量。
en: Its two bodies mesh together and rotate, generating the energy it needs to live.

zh:
通过改变旋转的方向来向伙伴传
递感情。越是生气,旋转得就越
快。
en: It conveys its feelings to companions by changing its direction of rotation. The angrier it is, the faster it spins.

zh:
让带有红色核心的齿轮高速旋转
,便能快速填充能量。
en: By spinning its red-cored gear at high speed, it can rapidly charge up energy.

zh:
1条的电力虽小,但是许多麻麻
小鱼聚在一起,其威力可以比得
上雷电。
en: One alone produces little electricity, but a swarm of Tynamo together can rival a lightning bolt.

zh:
缠住对手,从圆圆的斑点放出电
流通过对方身体,使其麻痹后啃
食。
en: It coils around foes and sends electricity from its round spots through their bodies, paralyzing them before it feeds.

zh:
用吸盘一样的嘴巴吸住猎物,并
从刺入的牙齿中释放电流,使对
方触电。
en: It latches onto prey with its suckerlike mouth and discharges electricity through its sunken fangs, shocking the target.

zh:
操纵强劲的精神力量。用精神力
量勒住对手的大脑,引起头痛。
en: It wields formidable psychic power, squeezing opponents' brains with it to cause headaches.

zh:
好像是通过指尖闪烁来交流,但
目前还无法解读这种交流方式。
en: It seems to communicate through the flashing of its fingertips, but this form of communication has yet to be decoded.

zh:
假装点亮烛光,指引道路,实际
上是在吸取对方的生命力。
en: It pretends to light the way with its flame, but it's actually draining the life force of those who follow it.

zh:
吸取灵魂来点亮灯火。为了等待
人类死去,而在医院里嶝徉游荡
。
en: It absorbs spirits to fuel its flame. It loiters around hospitals, waiting for people to pass away.

zh:
如果被水晶灯火灵的火焰包围,
魂魄就会被吸取燃烧。只剩下行
尸走肉。
en: Those engulfed in Chandelure's flames have their spirits drawn out and burned away, leaving only an empty shell behind.

zh:
用牙齿粉碎树果后食用。牙齿会
通过多次再生,变得无比强劲锐
利。
en: It crushes Berries with its tusks before eating. Its tusks regrow again and again, becoming incredibly strong and sharp.

zh:
拥有能粉碎巨大岩石的牙齿。争
夺领地的斧牙龙们会进行非常激
烈的争斗。
en: Its tusks can crush huge boulders. Fraxure battle each other fiercely over territory.

zh:
性格温和,但对于入侵领地者绝
不会手软。会用削铁如泥的牙齿
发起挑战。
en: It's gentle by nature, but it shows no mercy to anyone invading its territory, challenging them with tusks that cut through steel.

zh:
总是流着鼻涕。吸着鼻涕使出招
式。鼻涕是招式的本源。
en: Its nose is always running. It sniffs its snot back up to use its moves--the mucus is the source of its power.

zh:
喜欢北方冰冷的大海。将嘴里吐
出的气息冻结,在海上铺成道路
来行走。
en: It loves the cold northern seas. It freezes its own breath to lay down paths of ice and walk across the water.

zh:
在雪云之中诞生。用冰的结晶所
形成的锁捕捉猎物。
en: Born inside snow clouds, it catches prey with chains formed from crystals of ice.

zh:
与盖盖虫在一起时,如果受到电
的刺激,双方的身体就会进化。
en: When it and Karrablast receive electrical stimulation together, both of their bodies evolve.

zh:
因为脱掉了沉重的壳,而变得轻
巧。会用简直是忍者般的身手战
斗。
en: Having shed its heavy shell, it became light and nimble. It fights with the agility of a ninja.

zh:
皮肤坚硬,所以即使被相扑力士
踩踏也照样淡定自如。释放电流
时,会喜笑颜开。
en: Its skin is so tough that even being trampled by sumo wrestlers leaves it unfazed. It smiles broadly when discharging electricity.

zh:
以使出招式的速度自豪。即便力
量很弱,也能以出招次数弥补。
en: It takes pride in the speed of its moves. What it lacks in power, it makes up for with the sheer number of strikes.

zh:
手臂上的体毛运用得像鞭子一样
灵活。双臂的攻击速度快到迅雷
不及掩耳。
en: It wields the fur on its arms like whips. Its arm strikes come faster than the eye can follow.

zh:
在狭小的洞穴里来回奔走,用锋
利的爪子捕获猎物。脸上的皮肤
比岩石还硬。
en: It dashes through narrow caves, catching prey with its sharp claws. The skin on its face is harder than rock.

zh:
因体内燃烧的能量而活动着。但
究竟是何种能量尚且不明。
en: It moves thanks to energy burning within its body, but what kind of energy it is remains a mystery.

zh:
据说,制作泥偶巨人的古人命令
它要保护人和宝可梦。
en: It's said that the ancient people who made Golurk ordered it to protect people and Pokémon.

zh:
全身都是刀的宝可梦。如果在战
斗中损伤了刀刃,就会用河滩的
石头打磨。
en: A Pokémon whose whole body is blades. If its blades are damaged in battle, it hones them on stones by the river.

zh:
让数只驹刀小兵战斗,将受伤无
法动弹的猎物一劈为二的恐怖宝
可梦。
en: A fearsome Pokémon that sends packs of Pawniard into battle, then cleaves the wounded, helpless prey in two.

zh:
一往无前地猛冲,使出头锤。拥
有让奔跑的列车脱轨的破坏力。
en: It charges straight ahead with a mighty headbutt. It has enough destructive force to derail a running train.

zh:
会不由分说挑起战斗。随着每次
被打倒,每次受伤,成长得更强
更壮。
en: It picks fights without a second thought. Every time it's knocked down or wounded, it grows stronger and tougher.

zh:
为了伙伴的话,无论受多重的伤
都不会放弃战斗,是勇敢的天空
战士。
en: For its friends, it never gives up the fight no matter how badly it's hurt--a brave warrior of the skies.

zh:
保护着软乎乎屁股的是吃完的猎
物的尸骨。会随着每次生长丢弃
更换哦。
