en: The bones of eaten prey protect its soft rear. It discards and replaces them each time it grows.

zh:
据说,用骨头华丽地装饰是为了
吸引♂,但还没有发现过♂的秃
鹰娜。
en: It's said to adorn itself with bones to attract a ♂, but no ♂ Mandibuzz has ever been found.

zh:
用高温燃烧的火焰舌头熔化铁蚁
的钢铁身体,并吃掉其内部。
en: It melts the steel bodies of Durant with its blazing tongue of fire and devours their insides.

zh:
面对天敌熔蚁兽时,大家会分工
合作进行反击,把它从巢穴中驱
赶出去。
en: When facing Heatmor, their natural enemy, they divide the work and counterattack together, driving it away from the nest.

zh:
因为眼睛看不见,所以会又撞又
咬地来探索周围。浑身新伤不断
。
en: Since it can't see, it explores its surroundings by bumping into and biting things. Its body is covered in fresh wounds.

zh:
2个头之间关系恶劣,都想比对
方吃得更多来学会主导权。
en: Its two heads are on bad terms. Each tries to eat more than the other to seize the leading role.

zh:
双臂上的头是没有大脑的。用3
个头把一切都吃光并破坏掉。
en: The heads on its arms have no brains. It uses all three heads to devour and destroy everything.

zh:
据说是从太阳中诞生出来的。进
化时,会用从角喷出的火焰包裹
住全身。
en: It's said to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its whole body is engulfed in flames erupting from its horns.

zh:
战斗时,从6根翅膀到处飞撒火
花鳞粉,把周围变成一片火海。
en: In battle, it scatters blazing scales from its six wings, turning its surroundings into a sea of fire.

zh:
拥有钢铁的身体和心灵。只要瞪
一眼,连粗暴的宝可梦也会俯首
称臣。
en: It has a body and heart of steel. One glare from it makes even unruly Pokémon bow in obedience.

zh:
拥有一击冲破巨大城墙的猛撞力
。是传说中所描述的宝可梦。
en: Its charge can smash through a huge castle wall in a single blow. It is a Pokémon spoken of in legend.

zh:
头上的角是锋利的刀刃。用旋风
般的动作戏弄敌人,迅速切斩。
en: The horns on its head are sharp blades. It toys with enemies using whirlwind-like movements, then slices them in a flash.

zh:
下半身被云一样的能量体包裹着
。以300公里的时速在空中飞
行。
en: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud-like mass of energy. It flies through the sky at 300 km per hour.

zh:
用尾巴上的尖刺射电攻击。在合
众地区的天空飞来飞去制造雷电
。
en: It fires bolts of electricity from the spikes on its tail. It soars around the skies of Unova, creating lightning.

zh:
用火焰让世界燃烧殆尽的传说的
宝可梦。会帮助构筑真实世界的
人。
en: A legendary Pokémon that can burn the world away with fire. It helps those who seek to build a world of truth.

zh:
用闪电让世界燃烧殆尽的传说的
宝可梦。会辅佐创造理想世界的
人。
en: A legendary Pokémon that can burn the world away with lightning. It aids those who seek to create an ideal world.

zh:
土地云造访的土地,作物收成必
定大好,因此被称为农田之神。
en: The lands Landorus visits always yield bountiful harvests, so it has been hailed as the deity of the fields.

zh:
等待着用真实与理想填补自己失
去的身体的英雄,是冰之传说的
宝可梦。
en: A legendary Pokémon of ice that awaits a hero who will fill in its missing body with truth or ideals.

zh:
在江河湖海的水面奔跑,驰骋全
世界。会出现在美丽的水边。
en: It dashes across the surfaces of rivers, lakes, and seas, racing around the whole world. It appears at beautiful watersides.

zh:
美洛耶塔演奏的旋律拥有让周围
的宝可梦或悲或喜的力量。
en: The melodies Meloetta plays have the power to fill the Pokémon around it with sorrow or joy.

zh:
被等离子队改造过的古代的虫宝
可梦。背上的大炮力量得到了提
升。
en: An ancient bug Pokémon altered by Team Plasma. The cannon on its back was upgraded for greater power.

zh:
头部的刺平时很柔软,如果注入
了力量,就会变尖锐,硬得连岩
石也能刺穿。
en: The spikes on its head are usually soft. When it puts strength into them, they become sharp enough to pierce even rock.

zh:
覆盖着身体的结实外壳能反弹敌
人的攻击,会用锐利的刺反击。
en: The tough shell covering its body deflects enemies' attacks, and it strikes back with its sharp quills.

zh:
有着用身体撞击来弄翻50吨重
坦克的力量。会把自己当作护盾
来保护伙伴。
en: Its body slam is powerful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It protects its friends by acting as their shield.

zh:
吃小树枝后就会变得充满活力,
会从大大的耳朵里喷出超过摄氏
200度的热气。
en: Eating a twig fills it with energy. It vents air hotter than 200 degrees Celsius from its big ears.

zh:
尾巴上插着树枝。通过尾巴上的
毛摩擦生热,点燃树枝来战斗。
en: It keeps a twig in its tail. It ignites the twig with friction heat from its tail fur and fights with it.

zh:
盯着木杖前端燃烧着的火焰,集
中精神的话,就能看透未来发生
之事。
en: By gazing into the flame atop its wooden wand and focusing its mind, it can see events yet to come.

zh:
从胸部和背部发出泡泡。用具有
弹力的泡泡抵挡攻击,减少伤害
。
en: It produces bubbles from its chest and back. The springy bubbles cushion attacks and reduce damage.

zh:
使用投掷被泡泡包着的小石头的
招式。控制力很强,可以击中3
0米外的空罐子。
en: It attacks by hurling pebbles wrapped in bubbles. Its aim is so good, it can hit an empty can 30 meters away.

zh:
压缩水,制造出手里剑。让它高
速旋转后飞出的话,连金属也能
一劈两半。
en: It compresses water into shuriken. Thrown with a high-speed spin, they can slice even metal in two.

zh:
用大大的耳朵挖掘地面制造巢穴
。可以整晚不休息连续不停地挖
。
en: It digs burrows with its big ears. It can keep digging all night long without a rest.

zh:
大大的耳朵拥有轻松举起超过1
吨重的岩石的力量。在施工现场
非常活跃。
en: Its big ears are strong enough to easily lift boulders weighing over a ton. It's a big help at construction sites.

zh:
非常容易和人亲近的性格。通过
美妙婉转的叫声以及挥动尾羽的
动作向伙伴传递信号。
en: It takes to people very easily. It signals its flock with lovely, melodious cries and waves of its tail feathers.

zh:
从鸟嘴里喷出火花,将草丛烧焦
,捕捉因受惊而蹿出的猎物。
en: It spits embers from its beak to scorch the grass, then catches the startled prey that comes leaping out.

zh:
因激烈的战斗而兴奋的话,会从
全身的羽毛缝隙里喷出火花飞行
。
en: When excited by a fierce battle, it flies while spraying embers from the gaps between its feathers.

zh:
如果被鸟宝可梦袭击,就会挥撒
黑色的粉。是一旦接触就会麻痹
的毒粉。
en: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it scatters a black powder--a poisonous powder that paralyzes on contact.

zh:
隐藏在繁茂的树荫中生活。一旦
被敌人袭击,就会尖尖地竖起体
毛威吓对方。
en: It lives hidden in thick foliage. When attacked by an enemy, it bristles the fur on its body to threaten the attacker.

zh:
世界上有着各种各样翅膀花纹的
彩粉蝶。好像是受所居住土地的
气候影响。
en: Vivillon with all sorts of wing patterns exist across the world, apparently shaped by the climate of their homelands.

zh:
面对的对手越强大,鬃毛的温度
就变得越高,全身都充满了力量
。
en: The stronger the opponent it faces, the hotter its mane burns and the more power fills its whole body.

zh:
群体中,拥有最大火焰鬃毛的雄
性会作为首领率领着伙伴。
en: The male with the largest mane of fire leads the pride as its boss.

zh:
引导出花朵蕴藏的力量,自由地
操纵。花蓁蓁拿着的花几乎已成
为了身体的一部分。
en: It draws out the hidden power of flowers and controls it freely. The flower Floette holds is practically a part of its body.

zh:
在花圃里飞来飞去,照料快要枯
萎的花朵。能引导出花朵蕴藏的
力量战斗。
en: It flutters around flower beds, tending flowers on the verge of wilting. It can draw out the hidden power of flowers to fight.

zh:
领地是漂亮的花园。汔浴着花草
释放的能量,作为自己的力量。
en: Its territory is a beautiful flower garden. It bathes in the energy released by flowering plants and makes it its own power.

zh: 自己的力量。
en: its own power.

zh:
据说是最早能够和人一起生活的
宝可梦。性格很温和。
en: It's said to be the first Pokémon to live alongside people. It has a very gentle nature.

zh:
从握角的细微差异就能读取训练
家的心情,所以会心灵一体奔跑
。
en: It can read its Trainer's feelings from slight shifts in grip on its horns, letting the two run as one in heart and body.

zh:
为了不被敌人轻视而努力瞪眼,
但收效甚微。叼着的叶子是它的
独特特征。
en: It glares hard so enemies won't take it lightly, but with little effect. The leaf in its mouth is its trademark.

zh:
性格暴躁,很冲动,但不容许欺
负弱小。会用叶子洞悉敌人的动
向。
en: It's hot-tempered and reckless, but it won't stand for the weak being bullied. It reads enemies' movements with its leaf.

zh:
如果修剪好乱蓬蓬的体毛,不只
是样子变美,身体也会变得更敏
捷。
en: Trimming its shaggy fur not only improves its looks but also makes its body more agile.

zh:
为了不让强大的精神力量漏出,
用耳朵捂住释放力量的器官。
en: To keep its immense psychic power from leaking out, it presses its ears shut over the organs that release it.

zh:
如果危险逼近,就会竖起耳朵,
释放出能拧碎10吨重卡车的精
神力量。
en: When danger approaches, it raises its ears and unleashes psychic power strong enough to crush a 10-ton truck.

zh:
好像是死者的灵魂寄宿在古剑上
转生而成。会附在人类身上吸食
生命。
en: It seems to be a departed spirit that possessed an ancient sword and was reborn. It attaches itself to people and drains their life.

zh:
进化后分裂为2把。通过心灵感
应对话,用配合攻击砍碎敌人。
en: Upon evolving, it split into two blades. The pair converse via telepathy and cut down enemies with coordinated attacks.

zh:
曾跟随着历代国王。用灵力控制
人和宝可梦的心,使之服从。
en: It served generations of kings. With its spectral power, it controlled the hearts of people and Pokémon, forcing them to obey.

zh:
从身体里飘出令闻者神魂颠倒的
香气。香气会因所吃的食物而改
变。
en: A scent that entrances all who smell it wafts from its body. The fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

zh:
制作出各种各样的气味。发出对
手讨厌的气味,让战斗朝对自己
有利的方向推进。
en: It concocts all sorts of scents. It releases smells its opponents dislike to turn battles in its favor.

zh:
放出像棉花糖那样又甜又稞的白
丝缠住对手,封住其行动。
en: It shoots white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy, entangling opponents to stop them from moving.

zh:
拥有即便是细微气味也能区分的
敏锐嗅觉,是西点师傅的好帮手
。
en: Its keen nose can pick out even the faintest scents, making it a great helper for pastry chefs.

zh:
如果对手盯着它闪烁的发光体看
,就会头晕眼花,斗志全无。
en: Opponents who stare at its flashing, light-emitting spots grow dizzy and lose their will to fight.

zh:
会使用宝可梦中最强的催眠术。
按自己的意愿操纵对手。
en: It uses the strongest hypnosis of any Pokémon, manipulating opponents exactly as it pleases.

zh:
2只龟脚脚生活在一块岩石上。
如果吵架了,就会有某只转移到
其他岩石上去。
en: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they quarrel, one of them moves off to a different rock.

zh:
进化的时候,2只龟脚脚会分裂
为7只的宝可梦。会以7只的力
量战斗。
en: A Pokémon in which two Binacle multiply into seven upon evolving. It fights with the strength of all seven.

zh:
会模拟成腐烂海藻的形态。向没
注意到而靠近的猎物泼洒毒液,
了结对方。
en: It mimics rotting seaweed. It douses unwary prey that draws near with poison and finishes it off.

zh:
会不顾一切地向入侵领地者吐出
能够腐蚀油轮船体的剧毒。
en: It spits a virulent poison that can corrode a tanker's hull at anything invading its territory, no questions asked.

zh:
像手枪一样把压缩过的水从大大
的钳子里射出,击落飞着的猎物
。
en: It fires compressed water from its big pincer like a pistol, shooting down flying prey.

zh:
拥有能发射水炮弹的巨大手臂,
连油轮的船体也能击穿。
en: Its enormous arm can fire cannonballs of water powerful enough to punch through a tanker's hull.

zh:
在沙漠生活。只要能汔浴着阳光
发电,即使不吃食物也安然无怼
。
en: It lives in deserts. As long as it can bask in sunlight and generate electricity, it stays fine without eating any food.

zh:
会张开颈伞发电。1只光电伞蜍
就能制造出一栋高层建筑所必需
的电。
en: It generates electricity by unfurling its frill. A single Heliolisk can produce enough electricity to power a skyscraper.

zh:
从化石复活而来的宝可梦。如果
有不喜欢的事情,就会大动肝火
大闹一场。
en: A Pokémon revived from a fossil. If anything displeases it, it flies into a rage and goes on a rampage.

zh:
大颉能把厚实的铁板像纸那样咬
碎,因此在古代的世界里以无敌
自豪。
en: Its great jaws could chomp through thick iron plates as if they were paper, so it boasted of being invincible in the ancient world.

zh:
从1亿年前起就处于冰封状态的
身体的一部分复活而来的古代宝
可梦。
en: An ancient Pokémon revived from part of its body that had been frozen for 100 million years.

zh:
从身上的菱形结晶里放出零下1
50度的冷气,把敌人包住并冰
封起来。
en: From the diamond-shaped crystals on its body, it releases air of -150 degrees, engulfing enemies and freezing them solid.

zh:
从蝴蝶结那样的触角里释放出削
弱敌意的波动,令猎物大意后袭
击对方。
en: From its ribbonlike feelers, it emits an aura that weakens hostility, catching prey off guard before it strikes.

zh:
体型虽小,却是个技术高手。与
怪力和铁掌力士等大型宝可梦战
斗起来都难分伯仲。
en: Though small, it's a master technician. It fights on even footing with big Pokémon like Machamp and Hariyama.

zh:
胡子起着天线的作用。用它来收
发电波,与远处的伙伴保持联络
。
en: Its whiskers serve as antennas. It sends and receives electrical waves with them to keep in touch with faraway friends.

zh:
出生在高温高压的地下深处。从
宝石的部分放出光束保护身体。
en: Born deep underground under intense heat and pressure, it fires beams from its jeweled body to protect itself.

zh:
最弱小的龙属性宝可梦。皮肤干
燥的话就会无法呼吸,因此一直
静静地呆在背阴处哦。
en: The weakest of Dragon-type Pokémon. If its skin dries out it can't breathe, so it always stays quietly in the shade.

zh:
食物和伙伴的区别模糊不清。即
使关系很好,有时候也会淡定地
将对方溶解吸食。
en: The line between food and friend is blurry to it. Even close companions sometimes get calmly dissolved and slurped up.

zh:
和人非常亲近的宝可梦。不管它
的话,就会很寂寞,流着稞糊糊
的眼泪鸣叫。
en: A Pokémon that's very affectionate toward people. If left alone, it gets lonely and cries streams of sticky tears.

zh:
有着收集钥匙的习性。性格稳重
,却会偷偷潜入民宅偷盗钥匙。
en: It has a habit of collecting keys. Though calm by nature, it will sneak into houses and steal their keys.

zh:
在森林中死去的孩子的魂魄寄生
在树桩上。用悲鸣般的诡异声音
鸣叫。
en: The spirit of a child who died in the forest, now dwelling in a tree stump. It cries out in an eerie voice like a wail.

zh:
据说会把毁坏森林者吃掉的宝可
梦。对生活在森林中的生物们非
常温柔。
en: It's said to devour anyone who harms the forest, yet it's very kind to the creatures that live there.

zh:
南瓜的身体里有无法往生的灵魂
。黄昏到来便开始活动。
en: A spirit unable to pass on inhabits its pumpkin body. It becomes active when dusk falls.

zh:
在朔月的夜晚一边在街上游荡一
边用诡异的声音唱歌。如果听到
那歌声,就会被诅咒。
en: On nights of the new moon, it roams the streets, singing in an eerie voice. All who hear its song are cursed.

zh:
覆盖着身体的冰可以抵御敌人的
攻击。即使被打破也能立即用冷
气结起冰。
en: The ice covering its body wards off enemy attacks. Even if it's broken, it instantly refreezes it with cold air.

zh:
冻住的身体像钢铁一样坚硬。用
巨大身躯压碎挡道的东西移动。
en: Its frozen body is as hard as steel. It moves by crushing anything in its way beneath its massive bulk.

zh:
在一片漆黑的洞窟里生活。从大
大的耳朵里发射出20万赫兹的
超音波。
en: It lives in pitch-black caves. From its huge ears, it emits ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

zh:
飞行在连月光都没有的黑夜里,
袭击那些疏忽大意的猎物。在黑
暗的战斗中所向无敌。
en: It flies through moonless, pitch-black nights, attacking careless prey. In battles in the dark, it is unbeatable.

zh:
据说,能够分享出永恒的生命。
以树木的样子睡了1000年后
复活
en: It's said to be able to share eternal life. It slept for 1,000 years in the form of a tree before its revival.

zh:
展开翅膀和尾羽,闪着红色光芒
时,就会吸取生物的生命,是传
说的宝可梦。
en: A legendary Pokémon: when it spreads its wings and tail feathers glowing red, it steals the life force of living things.

zh:
细胞聚集了50%的样子。会毫
不留情地把敌对者全部消灭。
en: This is its form with 50% of its cells gathered. It mercilessly eliminates all who stand against it.

zh:
小碎钻的突变体。闪着粉红色光
辉的身体被赞为全世界最美。
en: A mutation of Carbink. Its body, glittering with pink light, is praised as the most beautiful in the world.

zh:
据说会用6个圆环和6个巨大的
手臂夺走一切东西。被封印了力
量而变成了小小的样子。
en: It's said to seize anything it wants with its six rings and six huge arms. Its power was sealed, leaving it in a small form.

zh:
喷出水蒸气,用浓雾隐藏自己。
据说住在人类不会进入的山里。
en: It expels steam and conceals itself in dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where no human treads.

zh:
很注重外表,只要有空就会整理
翅膀。有时候也会因为过于在意
羽毛的整洁而无法战斗。
en: It cares a lot about its looks, grooming its wings at every spare moment. Sometimes it can't fight because it's too busy keeping its feathers tidy.

zh:
搭弦射出收藏在翅膀里的箭羽。
有着连前方100米的小石头也
能穿透的精度。
en: It nocks and fires the arrow quills stored in its wings--precise enough to pierce a pebble 100 meters away.

zh:
通过理毛然后将积在腹中的落毛
燃烧,喷出火焰。根据吐毛的方
式不同,火焰也会变化。
en: It grooms itself, then burns the fur collected in its belly to spit fire. The flames change depending on how it coughs up the fur.

zh:
脖子上挂有火焰铃铕。喷出火焰
的时候,会叮铃铃地发出很响的
声音。
en: A bell of fire hangs at its throat. When it spews flames, the bell rings out with a loud, clear tone.

zh:
性格粗鲁又任性。心情不爽的时
候,连训练家的命令也会淡定地
无视。
en: It's rough and selfish by nature. When it's in a bad mood, it coolly ignores even its Trainer's orders.

zh:
因为勤奋的性格而有名。用鼻子
将体液吹成气球,扔向敌人。
en: It's famous for its diligence. It blows balloons of fluid from its nose and hurls them at enemies.

zh:
擅长跳舞,能够边跳舞,边一个
接一个地制作水做的气球扔向敌
人。
en: A skilled dancer, it creates water balloons one after another as it dances and flings them at enemies.

zh:
用歌声操纵水做的气球。这个旋
律会在伙伴间学习,被一代代地
群体传承下去。
en: It controls its water balloons with song. Its companions learn the melody, and it's passed down through the group for generations.

zh:
以每秒16连击在树干上啄出洞
来。啄开的洞穴用作收藏食物的
仓库和巢穴。
en: It pecks holes in tree trunks at a rate of 16 strikes per second. It uses the holes as food stores and nests.

zh:
把吃掉的树果的种子储藏在鸟嘴
里。遇到敌人或猎物时,就一口
气发射出去。
en: It stores the seeds of Berries it has eaten in its beak. When it meets an enemy or prey, it fires them all out at once.

zh:
让鸟嘴发热来战斗。那温度足足
超过100度,只要被啄到就会
严重灼伤。
en: It fights by heating up its beak. The temperature tops 100 degrees, so a single peck causes serious burns.

zh:
无论什么都能用锐利的牙齿咬住
。原本并不住在阿罗拉,是从其
他地区被带过来的。
en: It can bite through anything with its sharp fangs. It isn't native to Alola--it was brought over from another region.

zh:
找到猎物的踪迹后,就会坚持蹲
守在那个地方,但到了傍晚就会
昏昏欲睡。
en: When it finds traces of prey, it stakes out the spot with great patience, but come evening it starts to nod off.

zh:
用结实的颉部削树木,吸取树的
汁液。平常就在地里生活。
en: It shaves trees with its sturdy jaw and sips their sap. It normally lives underground.

zh:
拥有在体内蓄电的能力。露营等
时候有1只这种宝可梦的话,会
非常值得庆幸。
en: It has the ability to store electricity in its body. Having one along when camping is something to be truly thankful for.

zh:
来回盘旋寻找机会。用巨大的颉
部收集电能向敌人发射。
en: It circles around, watching for its chance. It gathers electrical energy in its huge jaws and fires it at enemies.

zh:
用钳子保护自己的弱点,同时伺
机出拳。输了的话会吐泡泡倒下
。
en: It guards its weak points with its pincers while watching for a chance to throw a punch. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and keels over.

zh:
不管不顾地打架。遇到危机时刻
,就会自断钳子,像发射火箭一
样砸出去。
en: It brawls without a second thought. In a pinch, it snaps off its own pincers and launches them like rockets.

zh:
拍打翅膀生火。一边踩着华丽的
步伐,一边洒下猛烈的火焰。
en: It beats its wings to create fire. Dancing with flamboyant steps, it scatters raging flames all around.

zh:
花蜜和花粉是它的食物。拥有感
知气场的力量,能分辨出要开放
的花。
en: It feeds on nectar and pollen. With its power to sense auras, it can tell which flowers are about to bloom.

zh:
把花粉做成圆形的团子。可以食
用或战斗中使用,有许多的种类
哦。
en: It rolls pollen into round puffs. There are many kinds--some for eating and some for use in battle.

zh:
非常容易亲近,因此是适合推荐
给新手的宝可梦。可一旦成长脾
气就会变粗暴。
en: It's very friendly, making it a recommended Pokémon for beginners. But its temper grows rougher as it matures.

zh:
快速移动迷惑敌人。除了爪子和
牙齿之外,鬃毛里的尖锐岩石也
是武器之一。
en: It confuses enemies with quick movements. Besides its claws and fangs, the sharp rocks in its mane are also among its weapons.

zh:
一旦陷入危机,眼睛就会变得湿
润并发光。和汇聚在这光亮中的
伙伴们一起对抗敌人。
en: When it's in danger, its eyes grow moist and shine. It fights back against enemies together with the allies drawn to that light.

zh:
用头上的毒刺扎猎物。在其虚弱
的时候,用10条触手抓住,一
击毙命。
en: It stabs prey with the poison spike on its head. Once they weaken, it grips them with its 10 tentacles and finishes them off.

zh:
用12只脚在海底爬行。在超坏
星爬过的地方会散落太阳珊瑚的
碎屑。
en: It crawls along the seafloor on its 12 legs. Fragments of Corsola are scattered along the paths Toxapex has traveled.

zh:
牢牢地粘在脚上的泥会提高抓地
力,让它能够矫健的奔跑。
en: The mud clinging firmly to its legs improves its grip, letting it run with sure-footed agility.

zh:
从嘴里吐出的泥凝固后,即便是
风雨也能经得住,所以常被涂在
以前家里的外墙上。
en: The mud it spits hardens enough to withstand wind and rain, so it was once used to coat the outer walls of houses.

zh:
为了寻找食物而到地面上来。戴
着水泡是为了呼吸,以及保护柔
软的头部。
en: It comes onto land in search of food. Its water bubble lets it breathe and protects its soft head.

zh:
用头部的水泡来进行撞头攻击。
如果是弱小的宝可梦,就会被吸
进水泡溺死。
en: It headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Weak Pokémon get sucked into the bubble and drown.

zh:
要保持鲜艳的身体颜色,得花很
多功夫。但把这个当做兴趣的爱
好者也是有的。
en: Keeping its body colors vivid takes a lot of work. Yet some enthusiasts make that upkeep their hobby.

zh:
深夜前往灯罩夜菇栖息的森林是
很危险的。会被怪异的光线诱惑
,再也回不来了。
en: Going into forests where Shiinotic live at night is dangerous. You'll be lured away by the eerie lights, never to return.

zh:
燃烧体液,释放毒瓦斯。等吸了
毒气的敌人变得晕晕乎乎后就发
动袭击。
en: It burns its bodily fluids to release toxic gas. Once enemies grow woozy from breathing the gas, it attacks.

zh:
不知为何只发现♀。率领夜盗火
蜍的♂,组成逆后宫一起生活。
en: For some reason, only ♀ have ever been found. It forms a reverse harem, living with a group of ♂ Salandit.

zh:
外表惹人喜爱,但如果被发怒后
胡乱挥舞的腿脚碰到,即便是职
业摔角手也会被击飞。
en: It looks adorable, but if you're struck by its flailing limbs when it's angry, even a pro wrestler would be sent flying.

zh:
拥有压倒性的肌肉力量,是非常
危险的宝可梦。栖息地基本是禁
止进入。
en: With its overwhelming muscular strength, it's an extremely dangerous Pokémon. Its habitats are mostly off-limits.

zh:
闻起来很美味的香气从体内渗透
出来。会被受气味诱惑的铪嘴大
鸟整个吞下。
en: A delicious aroma seeps from its body. It gets swallowed whole by Toucannon lured in by the scent.

zh:
为了保护身体,壳盖很发达。因
为相当坚硬,即使被鸟宝可梦啄
到,也完全安然无怼。
en: Its calyx developed to protect its body. It's so hard that even pecks from bird Pokémon leave it completely unharmed.

zh:
擅长运用自己的脚来踢。用脚踩
住已被打倒的对手,大笑着炖耀
自己的胜利。
en: It excels at kicking with its legs. It stamps on defeated opponents and laughs aloud as it shows off its victory.

zh:
将花粘在充满营养的藤蔓上。花
会活化,芳香也会飘散出来。
en: It sticks flowers onto its nutrient-rich vine. The flowers grow vibrant and release their fragrance.

zh:
因为非常聪明而被知晓。看不起
没经验的训练家,是面向资深训
练家的宝可梦。
en: Known for its great intelligence, it looks down on inexperienced Trainers--a Pokémon suited to veterans.

zh:
会形成20只左右的团队。这样
团结在一起,会非常坚固,绝对
不会舍弃伙伴。
en: They form troops of about 20. Their unity is rock solid, and they never abandon their companions.

zh:
因为胆小,慌慌张张地挥动着许
多脚,拼命逃跑。逃跑的痕迹会
闪闪发光很漂亮。
en: Cowardly by nature, it frantically scurries away on its many legs. The trail it leaves behind sparkles beautifully.

zh:
用锐利而巨大的爪子一挥而下。
连空气和海水都能一分为二的本
事。
en: It swings its huge, sharp claws downward. It has the skill to cleave air and seawater alike in two.

zh:
倒毙路边者的怨念附在孩子们堆
砌的沙丘上,诞生而成的。
en: It was born when the grudges of those who fell by the roadside possessed mounds of sand piled up by children.

zh:
操纵人们,让沙丘进化为沙堡。
诅咒的力量也得到了提升。
en: It manipulates people into building its sand mound into a castle. Its cursed power has grown stronger, too.

zh:
栖息在沙滩等浅海地区。从身体
里飞出体内器官,捕捉食物,或
是与敌人战斗。
en: It lives in shallow seas, such as along beaches. It launches its internal organs from its body to catch food or fight enemies.

zh:
带着沉重的控制面罩,不能释放
出原来的能力。蕴藏着特别的力
量。
en: Wearing its heavy control mask, it can't unleash its true power. It conceals a special strength within.

zh:
因为与同伴之间的信赖而觉醒。
发挥自由变换属性的能力进行战
斗。
en: It awakened through the bond of trust with its partner. It fights by wielding the power to change its type at will.

zh:
原本栖息在臭氧层,身体的外壳
变重后,就会向着地面落下。
en: It originally lived in the ozone layer. When its outer shell grows heavy, it falls down toward the ground.

zh:
睡着生,睡着死。似乎所有的行
动都是根据所看见的梦而引发的
睡相。
en: It's born asleep and dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than tossing in its sleep, driven by its dreams.

zh:
背上的甲壳是爆炸物。不小心打
到的话会发生大爆炸。肚子上的
小洞是弱点。
en: The shell on its back is explosive. Striking it carelessly triggers a huge blast. The small hole on its belly is its weak point.

zh:
背上的针毛平时是倒伏的。一旦
兴奋就会倒立起来,刺向前来袭
击的敌人。
en: The needle-like fur on its back usually lies flat. When excited, it bristles up and stabs attacking enemies.

zh:
正身不明。某位学者看过破布里
面后,因为太过恐惧而被惊吓致
死。
en: Its true identity is unknown. A scholar who once looked inside its rag was so terrified that he died of shock.

zh:
从头部的突起物放出精神力量的
时候,周围会响起非常刺耳的磨
牙声。
en: When it emits psychic power from the protrusion on its head, an ear-grating sound of grinding teeth echoes all around.

zh:
心地非常善良。可一旦被激怒,
就会用非常猛烈的气息把周围破
坏殆尽。
en: It's extremely kindhearted, but if angered, it destroys everything around it with raging gusts of breath.

zh:
咧咧地来回摆动巨大的船锚,连
吼鲸王也能一击击倒。绿色的海
藻是它的本体。
en: Swinging its massive anchor around, it can knock out even Wailord in a single blow. The green seaweed is its true body.

zh:
敲击鳞片,传递自己的心情。在
心鳞宝栖息的高山上,回荡着金
属的声音。
en: It expresses its feelings by rattling its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the mountains where Jangmo-o live.

zh:
伴随着战吼猛扑猎物。用布满鳞
片的拳头将对手撕成碎片。
en: It pounces on prey with a war cry. It tears opponents to shreds with its scale-covered fists.

zh:
坚硬的鳞片集攻防于一体。过去
曾被加工成武器和日用品来使用
。
en: Its hard scales serve as both weapon and armor. Long ago, they were crafted into weapons and everyday tools.

zh:
好奇心旺盛的,美乐美乐的守护
神。会呼唤雷雨云在体内储存雷
。
en: The curious guardian deity of Melemele. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

zh:
天真无邪,残酷的阿卡拉的守护
神。鲜花的芳香气息是它能量的
来源。
en: The guardian deity of Akala, both innocent and cruel. The fragrant scent of flowers is the source of its energy.

zh:
拔出巨大的树木,轰轰地来回挥
舞。让草木茂盛,吸收其中的能
量。
en: It rips huge trees from the ground and swings them around with a roar. It makes plants flourish and absorbs their energy.

zh:
拥有利用浓雾迷惑敌人,让其自
我毁灭那种程度的可怕。海流是
其能量的来源。
en: It is fearsome enough to befuddle foes with dense fog and drive them to destroy themselves. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

zh:
容易消逝的气体状身体。一边收
集大气的尘埃,一边慢慢地成长
着。
en: Its gaseous body is frail and fleeting. It grows slowly as it gathers dust from the atmosphere.

zh:
就像死了一般几乎不动,但触碰
后有些许温暖。在遥远的过去被
称为星之茧。
en: It stays as still as if it were dead, yet it feels slightly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

zh:
据说是栖息在其他世界的。全身
放出猛烈的光芒,即使是暗夜也
会照得如同白昼。
en: It is said to live in another world. Its whole body blazes with such brilliant light that it can turn the darkest night into day.

zh:
据说是科斯莫古进化后的♀。当
第3只眼浮现时,就会飞去其他
世界。
en: Said to be a Cosmog that evolved, ♀. When its third eye appears, it flies away to another world.

zh:
被谜团包围的究极异兽的一种。
有人目击了街上的人们被寄生后
暴走起来的样子。
en: One of the Ultra Beasts, shrouded in mystery. People in town were seen going berserk after being parasitized by it.

zh:
从其他世界出现的究极异兽。会
向人展现自己的身体,但不知道
是出于自豪还是威吓。
en: An Ultra Beast that appeared from another world. It shows off its body to people, though whether from pride or as a threat, no one knows.

zh:
危险究极异兽中的一种。被人目
击到以骇人的速度在大地狂奔的
样子。
en: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts. It has been seen tearing across the land at terrifying speed.

zh:
被目击到了从全身喷涌出骇人电
击的光景。谜一般的生物究极异
兽的一种。
en: It has been witnessed spraying fearsome jolts of electricity from its entire body. One of the mysterious Ultra Beasts.

zh:
从究极之洞出现的究极异兽。被
人目击到以高速在空中飞行的样
子。
en: An Ultra Beast that emerged from an Ultra Wormhole. It has been seen flying through the sky at high speed.

zh:
从究极之洞出现的究极异兽。本
身并不打算恐吓敌人,但是锐利
的全身就是凶器。
en: An Ultra Beast that came through an Ultra Wormhole. It has no intention of frightening anyone, but its razor-sharp body is itself a weapon.

zh:
有人报告过它啃噬山体,以及吞
掉大楼的模样。是究极异兽的一
种。
en: There are reports of it gnawing through mountains and swallowing entire buildings. It is one of the Ultra Beasts.

zh:
好像一直都沉睡在地下。被认为
是太古时代从其他世界来到此地
的类似究极异兽的生物。
en: It seems to have slumbered underground all along. It is thought to be an Ultra Beast-like creature that came from another world in ancient times.

zh:
500多年前被制造出的人造宝
可梦。理解人类的语言但不会说
。
en: An artificial Pokémon built more than 500 years ago. It understands human speech but cannot speak itself.

zh:
可以潜入影子中,因为不会在人
的面前展露身姿,所以其存在曾
是个幻想。
en: It can sink into shadows. Because it never shows itself to people, its very existence was thought to be a myth.

zh:
栖息在异世界的究极异兽,会从头
部的毒针朝对手喷出毒液,咯咯咯
大笑。
en: An Ultra Beast that lives in another world. It sprays venom at foes from the needles on its head while cackling away.

zh:
究极异兽中的一种。会从毒针发射
出稞性很大又发光的毒液。
en: One of the Ultra Beasts. It fires glowing, extremely sticky venom from its poison needles.

zh:
像是究极异兽的谜一般的生命体。突
然动起来并展开袭击的石墙,正身就
是这家伙。
en: A mysterious life-form resembling an Ultra Beast. That stone wall that suddenly moved and attacked? This is its true identity.

zh:
从究极之洞里出现的究极异兽。用爆
炸吓唬对手,趁那空当夺走对方的生
命气息。
en: An Ultra Beast that emerged from an Ultra Wormhole. It startles foes with explosions, then snatches away their life force in the confusion.

zh:
让双手双脚的爪子带电,将对手撕得
稀碎。即使被躲开,也会用飞散的电
击让其触电。
en: It electrifies the claws on its hands and feet to tear foes to shreds. Even if they dodge, the scattered sparks will shock them.

zh:
身体是融化成液状的钢铁。
它能够将土壤中的铁或其它
金属溶解后吸收进体内。
en: Its body is steel melted into liquid form. It dissolves iron and other metals in the soil and absorbs them into its body.

zh:
因为拥有产出铁的力量而受到崇拜。
不知为何,
经过3000年后突然苏醒了过来。
en: It was worshipped for its power to create iron. For reasons unknown, it suddenly awoke after 3,000 years.

zh:
当它用特别的木棒敲奏时,
能够给予花草活力的力量
就会变成音波扩散开来。
en: When it drums with its special stick, the power to invigorate flowers and plants spreads out as sound waves.

zh:
越是能用根木棒敲奏出
激烈节拍的啪咂猴,
越是能获得伙伴们的尊敬。
en: The Thwackey that beats out the most intense rhythms with its two sticks earns the greatest respect from its peers.

zh:
能够通过打鼓来控制特别的
树桩中的力量,
操纵树根进行战斗。
en: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special stump and manipulates tree roots to fight.

zh:
一旦做好了战斗的准备,
它鼻头上和脚底的肉球
就会发出极度的高温。
en: Once it's ready for battle, the pads on its nose and the soles of its feet radiate tremendous heat.

zh:
会用脚把树果从树木上踢落,
用来练习颠球,
借此锻炼自己的脚法。
en: It kicks Berries down from trees and juggles them with its feet, honing its footwork.

zh:
会将石头像足球般用脚挑起,
制造出缠绕着火焰的足球。
会用猛烈的踢射来燃烧对手。
en: It scoops up a stone with its foot like a soccer ball, wrapping it in flames. Its ferocious shots scorch its opponents.

zh:
皮肤在湿掉时会变色,
仿佛像是隐身了一样,
谁都看不见它的身影。
en: When its skin gets wet, it changes color, making it seem to vanish—no one can see it at all.

zh:
很有战略头脑,
会把手掌分泌出的
水分做成水弹攻击敌人。
en: A keen strategist, it forms water balloons from the moisture secreted by its palms and hurls them at enemies.

zh:
身上隐藏着多种特殊能力,
例如从手指喷射水流,
以及用背部的翼膜滑翔等等。
en: Many special abilities are hidden in its body, such as shooting water from its fingertips and gliding on the membranes on its back.

zh:
由于它无论何时都在吃树果,
让它比外表看起来还要顽强。
会出现在田地里寻找树果。
en: Since it's eating Berries at every waking moment, it's far tougher than it looks. It shows up in fields searching for Berries.

zh:
在尾巴里囤积树果。
虽然囤过头了就会掉出来,
但是迟钝的它不会发现。
en: It stockpiles Berries in its tail. It hoards so many that they spill out, but it's too slow-witted to notice.

zh:
娇小的体型让它敏捷地飞翔。
利用攻其不备的战法将体型
巨大的对手玩弄于股掌之间。
en: Its small body lets it fly with agility. Using surprise tactics, it toys with opponents many times its size.

zh:
经历无数次艰难的战斗后,
它学会了该如何正确地
判断敌人的力量。
en: Through countless grueling battles, it has learned how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.

zh:
在空中所向披靡。
它那黑得发亮的钢铁之躯
有着让敌人畏惧的威慑力。
en: It reigns supreme in the sky. Its lustrous black steel body radiates a menace that makes enemies cower.

zh:
经常出现在田地里的宝可梦。
会通过长在身体上的
毛来感应周围发生的事。
en: A Pokémon often seen in fields. It senses everything happening around it through the hairs covering its body.

zh:
正在壳里成长着。
用精神力量掌握外界的状况,
做好进化的准备。
en: It grows inside its shell, using its psychic power to grasp what's happening outside as it prepares to evolve.

zh:
以头脑聪慧而闻名。
大大的脑子是它拥有
出众精神力量的证明。
en: Famous for its high intelligence. Its large brain is proof of its exceptional psychic power.

zh:
性格谨慎且狡猾。
在偷盗食物逃走的时候
会用尾巴擦掉自己的足迹。
en: Cautious and cunning, it uses its tail to wipe away its footprints as it flees with stolen food.

zh:
会偷偷在看中的猎物身上
留下标记,追踪目标的气味,
在对方放松警戒时偷盗。
en: It secretly marks its chosen prey, tracks the target's scent, and steals from it the moment its guard is down.

zh:
当它把单脚扎进地面里,
并且汔浴充分的阳光,
花瓣就会染上鲜艳的颜色。
en: When it plants one foot in the ground and bathes in plenty of sunlight, its petals take on vivid colors.

zh:
棉絮的种子营养丰富。它会
通过风散播种子,让草木
和宝可梦变得活力十足。
en: The seeds in its cotton fluff are packed with nutrients. It spreads them on the wind, filling plants and Pokémon with vitality.

zh:
卷卷的体毛弹性十足。
就算从悬崖上掉下去,
也不会受伤。
en: Its curly fleece is so full of bounce that it won't be hurt even if it tumbles off a cliff.

zh:
长得长长的角是为了
向异性求爱而存在的。
它从不会把角当做武器。
en: Its long horns exist solely to court the opposite sex. It never uses them as weapons.

zh:
有着不管看到什么都会咬
上去的习性。这似乎是因为
长门牙的时候会痒的缘故。
en: It has a habit of biting anything it lays eyes on—apparently because its front teeth itch as they grow in.

zh:
性格凶暴的宝可梦。
会用能咬断铁棍的
颉部大口咬住猎物。
en: A ferocious Pokémon. It clamps down on prey with jaws that can bite clean through iron bars.

zh:
因为想要得到零食而帮助
人类工作的贪吃鬼。
总是带着电火花跑来跑去。
en: A glutton that helps people with their work just to earn treats. It's always dashing about, trailing crackling sparks.

zh:
电力增强了它的脚力。
当以最高速度奔跑时,
时速可以轻易超过90公里。
en: Electricity boosts the strength of its legs. Running at full speed, it easily tops 90 km/h.

zh:
在满是岩石的崎幡之路上
也能像独轮车那样自在移动。
靠燃烧煤炭维持生命。
en: It travels rocky, rugged paths as smoothly as a unicycle. It keeps itself alive by burning coal.

zh:
能通过高速旋转自己的脚,
以30公里的时速奔跑。
能喷出1000度的火焰。
en: By spinning its legs at high speed, it can run at 30 km/h. It can spew flames of 1,000 degrees.

zh:
进入战斗状态后,
它会把煤炭山燃烧得通红,
飞撒火花来烧焦四周。
en: When it enters battle, the mountain of coal on its body burns bright red, scattering sparks that scorch its surroundings.

zh:
一出生就躲进了苹果中。
一边吃果肉一边成长。
进化方向因苹果的味道而定。
en: It hides inside an apple the moment it's born, eating the flesh as it grows. Its evolution depends on the apple's flavor.

zh:
会用苹果皮的翅膀飞翔,
并吐出强酸性的唾液。
可以变成苹果的形状。
en: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits highly acidic saliva. It can disguise itself in the shape of an apple.

zh:
身体被甜甜的蜜汁包裹,
背部的皮尤其甘甜,
过去曾经是小孩的零食。
en: Its body is coated in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially sweet. Long ago, it was a snack for children.

zh:
会从鼻孔喷射出沙子,
趁敌人看不清的
时候躲进地底下藏身。
en: It sprays sand from its nostrils and hides underground while its foe is blinded.

zh:
蜾缩身体后从鼻孔里
喷射出100公斤的沙子。
没有了沙子就会变得很懦弱。
en: Coiling up its body, it blasts 100 kg of sand from its nostrils. Without sand, it turns quite cowardly.

zh:
虽然拥有一击定胜负的威力,
由于记性实在太差,对战
还没结束就会忘记对手是谁。
en: It has the power to end a battle in a single blow, but its memory is so poor that it forgets who it's fighting before the battle ends.

zh:
尖锐的下巴是它的骄傲。
只要发现周围有什么小动作,
就会一直线冲过去。
en: Its sharp jaw is its pride. The moment it notices any movement nearby, it charges straight at it.

zh:
像长矛一样尖锐的下巴
拥有钢铁般的硬度。
据说它的肉好吃得惊人。
en: Its spear-like jaw is as hard as steel. Its flesh is said to be astonishingly delicious.

zh:
通过让自身的毒素产生
化学反应来发电。
电力虽然弱,却能造成麻痹。
en: It generates electricity through chemical reactions with its own toxins. The current is weak, but it can still cause paralysis.

zh:
通过分解摄入体内的毒素来
生成电力,发出与电吉他
弹奏的旋律十分相似的声音。
en: It generates electricity by breaking down the toxins it ingests, producing sounds much like the strumming of an electric guitar.

zh:
靠储存在体内的可燃气体
来发热。热度最高的是
腹部的黄色部分。
en: It produces heat with the combustible gas stored in its body. The yellow part of its belly burns hottest.

zh:
性格极具攻击性。
危险的不只是它烧烫的身体,
大大的猸牙也锐利无比。
en: An extremely aggressive Pokémon. Its searing body isn't the only danger—its huge fangs are razor sharp, too.

zh:
智商大致相当于岁的儿童。
虽然触手经常断掉,但因为
能再生,所以它并不在意。
en: Its intelligence is about that of a young child. Its tentacles often tear off, but they regenerate, so it doesn't mind.

zh:
全身都是肌肉。
会用触手施展绞技,
威力无与伦比。
en: Its entire body is muscle. The choke holds it performs with its tentacles are of unmatched power.

zh:
真货会吸走饮用者的精气。
但市面上还是会有很多厝品。
en: A genuine one drains the life force of anyone who drinks it. Even so, many counterfeits still circulate on the market.

zh:
住在古董茶壶里。
虽然大多数都是厝品,
但偶尔也能发现真货。
en: It dwells in antique teapots. Most of them are counterfeits, but on rare occasions a genuine one is found.

zh:
通过头部的突起物来
感应生物的情感。
只对温和的人敞开心熹。
en: It senses the emotions of living things with the protrusion on its head. It opens its heart only to gentle people.

zh:
遇到情绪激昂的对手时,
无论对方是谁,
都会用粗暴的方式使其沉默。
en: When it meets someone bursting with emotion, no matter who they are, it silences them by force.

zh:
由于会朝四周释放足以
引起头痛的精神力量,
其他生物都躲得远远的。
en: It radiates psychic power strong enough to give everyone around it a headache, so other creatures keep their distance.

zh:
不但会溜进民宅偷盗,还会
吸收人们悔恨时的负面能量。
en: It sneaks into homes to steal, and it also absorbs the negative energy people give off in moments of regret.

zh:
会先装成要下跪道歉的样子,
然后用后脑勺尖
如长矛的头发刺向对手。
en: It feigns kneeling down to apologize, then skewers its opponent with the spear-like hair on the back of its head.

zh:
毛发能发挥肌肉纤维般的
作用。伸展开来时会像
触手那样把对手缠绕起来。
en: Its hair works like muscle fibers. When extended, it coils around opponents like tentacles.

zh:
能够发出惊人的音量。
它在大叫的同时威吓对手的
样子被称为“拦堵”。
en: It can bellow at an astonishing volume. Its habit of howling while intimidating opponents is known as Blocking.

zh:
有着十分好战的性格。
头上像铁头盔一样的东西
其实是它硬化后的体毛。
en: It has a very combative nature. The iron-helmet-like object on its head is actually its own hardened fur.

zh:
灵力增强之后从壳里被
解放出来。用灵体保护着
内核中的灵魂。
en: Freed from its shell as its spiritual power grew, it now protects the soul in its core with its ghostly body.

zh:
会用坚硬的葱叶抵挡攻击,
接着用锋利的茎反击。
它的葱既是武器也是食材。
en: It blocks attacks with its tough leek leaves, then counters with the sharp stalk. Its leek is both weapon and food.

zh:
踢踏舞的达人。
会挥动手中的冰杖,
向观众表演轻快的舞步。
en: A master of tap dancing. It waves its ice cane about while showing audiences its light, nimble steps.

zh:
被注入了强烈诅咒的
古代绘画在吸进哭哭面具的
灵魂后就开始动起来了。
en: An ancient painting infused with a terrible curse, it began to move after absorbing the spirit of a Yamask.

zh:
据说有小仙奶现身过的
蛋糕店保证能生意兴隆。
en: It's said that any cake shop where Milcery has appeared is guaranteed to prosper.

zh:
它会把自己用鲜奶油
装饰过的树果送给
自己信任的训练家。
en: It gives Berries decorated with its own whipped cream to Trainers it truly trusts.

zh:
列阵兵由个头头和
个跟班组成。
头头的命令不可违抗。
en: Falinks is made up of one boss and its troopers. The boss's orders are absolute.

zh:
能从刺的尖端放电。
会用锐利的牙齿刮取
附在岩石上的海藻吃。
en: It discharges electricity from the tips of its spines. It uses its sharp teeth to scrape off and eat seaweed clinging to rocks.

zh:
会吃地面上的积雪。
吃得越多,
背上的刺就会长得越挺拔。
en: It eats snow that has piled up on the ground. The more it eats, the taller the spikes on its back grow.

zh:
绝不放过破坏山野环境的人。
会用冰冷的翅膀四处飞翔,
制造出暴风雪来惩罚他们。
en: It never forgives those who destroy the mountains and fields. It flies about on frigid wings, whipping up blizzards to punish them.

zh:
佤立在大草原里,
每天眺望着日升日落。
擅长强而有力的踢技。
en: It stands in the great grasslands, gazing at the sunrise and the sunset each day. It excels at powerful kicks.

zh:
从非常寒冷的地方漂流而来。
它那一脸惬忮的表情让
许多人为之着迷。
en: It drifted here from somewhere terribly cold. Its blissful expression has charmed a great many people.

zh:
雄性就像管家一样,
在主人的身边打理一切。
雌性十分擅长带孩子。
en: The male acts like a butler, attending to everything at its master's side. The female is excellent at raising children.

zh:
总是饿着肚子。
会吃掉装在像口袋一样的
袋子里的种子来发电。
en: It's always hungry. It generates electricity by eating the seeds it keeps in its pocket-like pouches.

zh:
能轻松举起重达5吨
货物的大力士宝可梦。
会用鼻子挖地。
en: A mighty Pokémon that can easily lift cargo weighing five tons. It digs up the ground with its trunk.

zh:
群居的宝可梦。
鼻子的握力十分强劲,
甚至能把大石头弄得粉碎。
en: A Pokémon that lives in herds. Its trunk grips with such strength that it can crush a boulder to pieces.

zh:
会用尾部结实的肌肉发电。
与下半身相比,
上半身真的太小了。
en: It generates electricity with the sturdy muscles of its tail. Compared to its lower half, its upper body is simply too small.

zh:
它冻成冰的上半身在
颤抖后可以产生电能。
非常不擅长走路。
en: Its frozen upper half produces electricity when it shivers. It's very poor at walking.

zh:
虽然能用自豪的脚力
以60公里的时速奔跑,
但是只能在水中呼吸。
en: Its proud legs can carry it at 60 km/h, but it can breathe only underwater.

zh:
面部的皮肤无论受到什么
攻击都不会受伤,但由于
呼吸起来不方便而灭绝了。
en: The skin on its face could withstand any attack, but breathing was such a struggle that it went extinct.

zh:
身体犹如打磨过的金属,
虽然轻而坚硬,
却有着容易生锈的弱点。
en: Its body is like polished metal—light yet hard. Its one weakness is that it rusts easily.

zh:
曾经栖息在古代的大海。
在重生为幽灵宝可梦后,
会在昔日的住处徘徊。
en: It once lived in the seas of antiquity. Reborn as a Ghost Pokémon, it drifts around its old dwelling places.

zh:
飞行速度为每小时200公里。
与多龙梅西亚一起战斗,
到它进化为止都会细心照顾。
en: It flies at 200 km/h. It battles alongside Dreepy and cares for it devotedly until it evolves.

zh:
它角里的多龙梅西亚似乎
满心期待着能被以
音速发射出去。
en: The Dreepy in its horns seem to look forward eagerly to being launched at supersonic speed.

zh:
被称为妖精王之剑,让敌友
都对其敬畏不已。能以一剑
将超极巨化宝可梦拿下。
en: Known as the Fairy King's Sword, it is held in awe by friend and foe alike. A single stroke of its blade can fell a Gigantamax Pokémon.

zh:
被称为格斗王之盾,受到人
们的畏惧与尊崇。能轻易抵
挡超极巨化宝可梦的攻击。
en: Known as the Fighting Master's Shield, it is feared and revered. It can easily deflect the attacks of Gigantamax Pokémon.

zh:
会用胸部的核心吸收
佚勒尔地区涌出的能量,
借以保持自己的活力。
en: It absorbs the energy welling up from the Galar region through the core on its chest to keep itself active.

zh:
拉紧头上又白又长的体毛
就变得斗气势高昂,
并从丹田涌出力量。
en: When it pulls the long white fur on its head taut, its fighting spirit soars and power surges up from deep within.

zh:
流派不同, 分别会像水流一样
毫不停息地用打击招式攻击对手。
或是用千锤百炼的拳头一击必杀。
en: Depending on its style, it either batters foes with a ceaseless flow of strikes like rushing water, or fells them in one blow with a well-forged fist.

zh:
长在身上的藤蔓断掉之后
会变成土壤的养分,
帮助森林中的植物成长。
en: When the vines growing on its body snap off, they become nutrients in the soil, helping the plants of the forest grow.

zh:
由电能聚集而成。
据说解开身上的圆环后
会释放出隐藏的力量。
en: It is formed of gathered electrical energy. They say that removing the rings on its body unleashes its hidden power.

zh:
整个身体是龙之能量的结晶。
据说它拥有所有龙宝可梦的能力。
en: Its entire body is a crystallization of dragon energy. It is said to possess the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

zh:
拥有十分惊人的怪力。
戴在脸上的冰之面罩
硬度是钻石的100倍
en: It possesses astonishing strength. The ice mask on its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

zh:
黑暗的夜晚中奔驰,
吸取睡觉中的生命的能量。
喜欢孤独和静寂。
en: It gallops through the dark of night, draining the life energy of sleeping creatures. It favors solitude and silence.

zh:
曾经在很久的很久以前
统治着佚勒尔的传说之王。
拥有治愈心灵和让草木发芽的能力。
en: A legendary king that ruled over Galar long, long ago. It has the power to heal hearts and make plants sprout.

zh: 以它的叫声非常吵闹。
en: Its cry is terribly noisy.

zh:
腿能自由地伸缩,
即使离得很远,
也能把对手踢飞。
en: Its legs stretch freely, letting it send opponents flying with a kick even from far away.

zh:
制造障壁时,黑珠会发
出妖异的光辉。身上脱落的
胡须是制作温暖冬衣的原料。
en: When it creates a barrier, its black orbs give off an eerie glow. The whiskers it sheds are used as material for warm winter clothing.

zh:
用坚硬的岩石守护自身,
以粗衢的斧头砍倒大树。
性情暴躁易怒。
en: It guards itself with hard rock and fells great trees with its rough axes. It has a violent, irritable temper.

zh:
正是遍布在洗翠大地上
的湿地土壤,造就了它坚实的躯
体和自在运用泥炭的能力。
en: The wetland soil that covers the land of Hisui is what gave it its sturdy body and its skill at wielding peat.

zh:
在溯河而上的旅程中半途
丧命的伙伴的灵魂缠绕其身。
在洗翠的河川里所向无敌。
en: The souls of companions that perished midway on the journey upstream cling to its body. It is invincible in the rivers of Hisui.

zh:
拥有凌驾其他物种之上
的身体能力以及剧毒。
在寒冷的高地上所向无敌。
en: With physical prowess surpassing other species and a lethal poison, it is unbeatable in the cold highlands.

zh:
身上如同枪尖般的针以及
凶暴的性情使这种宝可梦
得到了海鬼的外号。
en: Its spear-like spines and savage temperament have earned this Pokémon the nickname of sea fiend.

zh:
当它越海飞来,便代表
严冬即将终结。传说中其慈爱
将使新生命在大地上萌芽。
en: When it flies in from across the sea, it heralds the end of harsh winter. Legends say its loving heart makes new life sprout across the land.

zh:
究极异兽的\p关东地区冠军-赤红, 
把他带回来我们这里.\p那么我就先回去汇报消息了... ...
它就交给你了!
en: …of the Ultra Beast…\pRed, the Champion of the Kanto region—bring him back here to us.\pWell, I'll head back and report in… I leave the rest to you!

zh:
你好[F9D3]我是小冰,
至于我为什么以光殿的\p形象出现在这游戏里,
因为我太喜欢她了嘛emmmm.\p竹兰姐我也很喜欢呢
,光竹CP什么的最棒最甜啦.\p
(姬佬属性是不是暴露了233)

既然在这里相遇了,\p就遵循训练师之间的规矩,
来和我进行宝可梦对战吧……
en: Hello[F9D3]! I'm Xiao Bing. As for why I appear in this game looking like Lady Dawn—it's because I just love her that much, hehe.\pI love Cynthia too—Dawn and Cynthia make the sweetest, most perfect pair.\p(Whoops, did my yuri fangirl side just show? Heh.)\pWell, since we've met here, Trainers' rules apply—let's have a Pokémon battle……

zh:
能遇到你这样的对手,
小冰很高兴呢
en: Meeting an opponent like you makes Xiao Bing very happy!

zh: 你真强
en: You're really strong

zh: 早有耳闻,你的实力凌驾于冠军!
en: I've heard the rumors—your strength surpasses even the Champion's!

zh:
看来你经历过了比我还严酷的训练,
才能有如此的强大!
en: You must have endured training even harsher than mine to become this strong!

zh:
亮的精灵,
 想获得就得先打到我!
en: …a shiny Pokémon. If you want it, you'll have to beat me first!

zh: 莎莉娜:你的精灵战斗很华丽啊!
en: Serena: Your Pokémon battle so gracefully!

zh:
什么!我输给了你这样一个
乳臭未干的小孩?
en: What?! I lost to a wet-behind-the-ears child like you?

zh:
我怎么可能会输给你
一个来历不明的路人训练家!!!
en: How could I possibly lose to some random, no-name Trainer like you?!

zh:
好厉害呀[F9D3]!
原来你是丰缘冠军呀[F9D3]!
en: Amazing[F9D3]! So you're the Hoenn Champion[F9D3]!

zh:
呋...这也热血过头了吧...
我都还没燃起斗志就...输了?
en: Whew… that was way too hot-blooded… I lost before my fighting spirit even caught fire?

zh:
你的战斗风格简直和我一样!
看来是我误会你了...战斗就此暂停。
en: Your battle style is exactly like mine! It seems I misjudged you… Let's call off this battle.

zh:
我...和暗黑酋雷姆...
竟然输了?
en: I… and Black Kyurem… actually lost?

zh:
嘿嘿嘿!Rock 起来!嗥翻天!哟哟哟!
Rock! Rock ! Rock! 大家一起来!\p...看来你一点都不明白摇滚呢...
我是自由售卖DVD的商人,\p刚好经过随意镇行商,
那么你要买一些卡碟吗?\p非常摇滚的曲风哦!
en: Heh heh heh! Let's ROCK! Raise the roof! Yo yo yo! Rock! Rock! Rock! Everybody now!\p…Looks like you don't get rock at all… I'm a traveling DVD merchant.\pJust passing through Suiyi Town on business. So, want to buy some discs?\pTotally rockin' tunes, yo!

zh:
欢迎来到 山后屋咖啡厅[F9D3]
请问要来点咩咩鲜奶吗?
en: Welcome to the Hillside Café[F9D3]! Would you like some fresh Wooloo milk?

zh: 欢迎光临! 来点糕点吗?
en: Welcome! Care for some pastries?

zh:
你也在孵蛋吗?
和我孵化的宝宝对战吧!
en: Hatching Eggs, too? Then battle the babies I hatched!

zh: 不...!我的宝贝们!
en: No...! My precious babies!

zh:
越是经历磨练,
人们就会越变越强!
en: The more trials people endure, the stronger they become!

zh: 是你修炼更甚于我!
en: You've trained even harder than I have!

zh:
啊啊,我不想和你遭遇啊...!
真没办法!
en: Aww, I didn't want to run into you...! Oh well, nothing for it!

zh: 啊啊,就知道会这样,钱拿去!
en: Argh, I knew it would end this way! Take the money!

zh: 姐姐,我们一起打倒这位训练家吧[F9D3]!
en: Big Sister, let's beat this Trainer together[F9D3]!

zh: 姐与妹: 呜呜呜...欺负我们...
en: Sisters: Waaah… You're picking on us…

zh:
姐姐,我们一起打倒这位训练家吧[F9D3]!
\p好的妹妹,我们一定能行的...!
en: Sis, let's beat this Trainer together[F9D3]!\pAll right, little sister—together, I know we can do it…!

zh:
这位训练家!
跑那么快,一定是在孵蛋吧!
en: Hey, Trainer! Running that fast, you must be hatching an Egg!

zh: 抱歉打扰你孵蛋了!
en: Sorry for interrupting your Egg hatching!

zh:
嘿嘿,逮个正着!
抱歉了,让我挑战看看你的宝可梦吧!
en: Heh heh, caught you red-handed! Sorry, but let me test myself against your Pokémon!

zh: 是我错了!耽误了你的行程!
en: It was my fault! Sorry for holding up your journey!

zh:
想获得宝可梦蛋,
就必须培育两只意气相投的宝可梦,\p想了解更多就和我对战吧!
en: To get a Pokémon Egg, you have to raise two Pokémon that truly get along.\pWant to know more? Then battle me!

zh: 没想到,你竟然有那么疯狂的孵蛋经历!
en: I can't believe you've had such a wild Egg-hatching career!

zh:
真是壮观的大坑啊!!!
那深不见底的地下肯定埋着好东西!!!
en: What a magnificent crater!!! There must be treasures buried deep in those bottomless depths!!!

zh:
真是强大的实力,
堪比冠军-希罗娜啊!
en: What tremendous strength—on par with Champion Cynthia!

zh:
我相信以我和豪力的力量!
一定能把这颗树打的倒下的!\p你认为我做不到吗?
en: I believe in my strength and my Machoke's!\pWe can definitely knock this tree down! You think we can't?

zh: 破坏数木是不对的啊... 对不起!
en: Destroying trees is wrong... I'm sorry!

zh:
好华丽的演出[F9D3]
好完美的节奏[F9D3]没问题[F9D3]!
en: What a dazzling performance[F9D3]! What perfect rhythm[F9D3]! Simply flawless[F9D3]!

zh:
怎么...可能...?!
 身为神之王的我... 竟然输了...?!
en: How... can this be...?! I, the king of gods... have lost...?!

zh: 里无尽的徘徊吧!
en: …wander there for all eternity!

zh:
怎么会啊!
我是不会向命运低头的! \p未来就无法改变吗...!
en: How can this be! I will never bow to fate!\pCan the future truly not be changed…?!

zh: 哇!!!出现了!!!出现了!!!
en: Whoa!!! It's here!!! It's here!!!

zh: 什么啊...原来是训练家...
en: What... Oh, it's just a Trainer...

zh:
我的伙伴离开了很久...
但是我仍然感受到\p它一直守护在我身边,
我每天准备给它的\p粮食贡品仍然会消失...
是不是你拿走了?!
en: My partner passed on long ago... But I can still feel it\pwatching over me, always at my side. The food offerings I set out for it each day\pstill keep disappearing... Wait, was it YOU taking them?!

zh:
啊啊,也许是因为我这样独断闹事,
所以我的伙伴仍然不肯成佛吗...
en: Ahh... Could it be that because of my selfish rampage, my partner still refuses to pass on...?

zh:
不要过来...!
徘徊着的灵魂都徘徊过来了!
en: Stay away...! The wandering souls are all wandering over here!

zh:
啊...停止战斗吧...
这里并不是战斗的地方....
en: Ah... Stop this battle... This is not a place for fighting...

zh:
呼...呼...呼...
你有失去过陪伴在\p身边很久很久的精灵吗...?
en: Huff... huff... huff... Have you ever lost a Pokémon that was by your side for a long, long time...?

zh:
不管过去多久...
我还是很心痛啊...
en: No matter how much time passes... my heart still aches...

zh:
忠叶:年轻人...
在之后一定会迎来离别...\p但是别怕...
\p凤: 就像那些孩子
一样可爱天真,\p但是最终还是迎来了离别...
en: Zhongye: Young one… someday a parting will surely come…\pBut don't be afraid…\pFeng: They were as sweet and innocent as those children,\pbut in the end, the parting still came…

zh:
忠叶:你的精灵充满着幸福,
就像曾经我的孩子们一般...\p凤: 好好培育你的精灵,
我回忆里仍然留存着它们的记忆.
en: Zhongye: Your Pokémon are full of happiness, just like my children once were…\pFeng: Raise your Pokémon well. Their memory still lives on in mine.

zh:
胜:宝贝,你看他和他的精灵,
是不是和我们曾经很像\p爱理:亲爱的,那么我们的精灵
是不是也还在这里睡着?
en: Sheng: Honey, look at that kid and their Pokémon. Aren't they just like we used to be?\pAili: Darling, then are our Pokémon still sleeping here too?

zh:
胜:很好,很好,你的精灵
还幸福洋溢的生活着\p爱理: 亲爱的,为什么他的精灵
能和他还能那么幸福...?
en: Sheng: Good, good. Your Pokémon are living happily.\pAili: Darling, why can that kid's Pokémon still be so happy with them…?

zh:
殆好,我是小松,
来自城都地区的道馆馆主,\p这里是著名的历史幽灵岛的后山,
我经常远途来到此处修炼,\p并且和这里的幽灵馆主切磋,
如果想越过这绝望的洞窟,\p必须得到幽灵的指引才行...!
en: Hello, I'm Morty, a Gym Leader from the Johto region.\pThis is the back hills of the famous, historic Ghost Island. I often travel far to train here\pand spar with the local Ghost Gym Leader. If you wish to cross this cavern of despair,\pyou must first receive the guidance of the ghosts...!

zh:
茬好!
有着这实力才是我期待的...!
en: ...Good! Strength like this is exactly what I was hoping for...!

zh:
嘿...嘿...那边那位小伙伴,
我手上有一些从世界各地\p收集的珍贵球哦,
过来看看吗,\p能遇见也是缘分,
我经常在世界各地旅行
en: Hey... hey... you over there, friend. I've got some rare Balls collected\pfrom all over the world. Want to take a look?\pMeeting you here must be fate. I travel all around the world.

zh:
治:嗬... 已经抵达陨石区附近了, 
接下来就交给探测仪器们去工作了。
en: 治: Whew... We've arrived near the meteoroid zone. Now we'll leave the rest to the survey instruments.

zh:
除喂,你的背包满了啊喂,
把背包道具整理一遍再来!
en: Hey, your Bag is full! Sort out your items and come back!

zh: 20周年皮卡丘
en: 20th Anniversary Pikachu

zh: 马上回去大吾宅邡做身体检查...
en: Head back to Steven's house right away for a checkup...

zh:
6事情大家也都忙,\p主要和猫猫一起搞得,
说起来她准备了个惊喜,\p可以期待下但是我就不评论了哈哈,\p也谢谢绠衣瓦吉,
还有一直帮助我们的人!\p谢谢对究极绿宝石的支持!
这个送给你!
en: …everyone's been busy with things.\pThis was mostly put together with Maomao— speaking of which, she's prepared a surprise.\pLook forward to it, but I won't spoil anything, haha.\pThanks also to Gengyi and Waji, and everyone who has helped us!\pThank you for supporting Hyper Emerald! This is for you!

zh: 起始海滩
en: Prelude Beach

zh: 吹火岛屿
en: Firespit Island

zh: 天冠山麓
en: Coronet Highlands

zh:
赋予。
\p帕路奇亚的诞生,
创造出无数的空间。\p不论我们活在世上或是化为尘土,
都在相同的空间内,\p一切都因为有帕路奇亚的创造。
en: …bestowed.\pWith Palkia's birth, countless spaces were created.\pWhether we live in this world or crumble to dust, we remain within the same space—\pall through Palkia's creation.

zh:
没有特征!
这就是雪峰的特征!\p我一点儿也不厉害!
这就是我厉害的地方!
en: No special features! That's Snowpoint's special feature!\pI'm not impressive at all! That's what's impressive about me!

zh: 请选择需交递的第二枚化石。
en: Please choose the second Fossil to hand over.

zh:
啊啦,你是训练师么\p那么就是说,你是这些
宝可梦的养父母呢!\p与宝可梦在一起
会有很多发现吧?\p这就像是父母看着孩子们
成长一样
en: Oh my, are you a Trainer?\pThen that makes you these Pokémon's foster parent!\pYou must discover so much, being with Pokémon.\pIt's just like parents watching their children grow.

zh:
我妈妈和宝可梦的
感情非常好哦!\p妈妈睡午觉的时候
宝可梦也会陪着一起睡
en: My mom and her Pokémon get along wonderfully!\pWhen Mom takes her afternoon nap, her Pokémon naps right beside her.

zh:
么
英勇善战了.
en: ...as strong a fighter as they say.

zh:
空扭曲的究极之洞而来的,
你的事情我从大吾和米可利\p他们那里有所耳闻,
起初我还不相信你的实力,\p但在我们之间的对战后,
我错了,我相信你的实力…\p待会好好给我们说说
你在究极空间的经历吧,\l我们再梳理一遍… \p据说你有关于火箭队的消息…
我对这情报可非常关注…待会再聊!
en: ...the Ultra Wormhole that's distorting space and time. I've heard about you from Steven and Wallace,\pand at first I didn't believe in your strength,\pbut after our battle, I was wrong--I believe in your strength now...\pLater, tell us all about your experiences in Ultra Space, and we'll sort through it once more...\pThey say you have information on Team Rocket... I'm very interested in that... We'll talk later!

zh: 艾梦 :哈哈,不愧是图鉴拥有者
en: Aimeng: Haha, just what I'd expect from a Pokédex holder!

zh: 回忆技能
en: Remember moves

zh:
我的草属性宝可梦
明明已经培养得很好了啊……
en: But I raised my Grass-type Pokémon so well...

zh:
不愧是传闻中
丰缘最强的训练师呢,我认输了.
en: You live up to the rumors--the strongest Trainer in Hoenn. I concede.

zh: 哞!我千锤百炼的宝可梦!!
en: Moo! My Pokémon, tempered through a thousand trials!!

zh:
结……战斗结束了吗!
真是激烈的对攻气氛呢!
en: The battle... The battle's over?! What a fierce exchange of attacks that was!

zh: 又有挑战者来了吗?那来决斗吧!
en: Another challenger already? Then let's duel!

zh: 完全打不过嘛
en: I just can't win at all!

zh: 让你见识一下我挖沙队的厉害
en: I'll show you what my sand-digging crew can do!

zh: 这挖沙队得不得行啊!
en: So much for my sand-digging crew!

zh: 来看看吧,我的宝可梦都很漂亮哦
en: Come take a look! My Pokémon are all beautiful!

zh: 你的宝可梦也好帅呀!
en: Your Pokémon is really cool too!

zh: 你也想起舞嘛?
en: Do you want to dance too?

zh: 红舞鞋也还是停下来啦
en: Even the red dancing shoes have come to a stop.

zh:
触手宝可梦好可爱呀!
你也喜欢触手嘛?
en: Tentacle Pokémon are so cute! You like tentacles too, right?

zh: 啊!可爱的触手!!
en: Ah! What adorable tentacles!!

zh:
蘑菇类的宝可梦是
世界上最好的精灵!
en: Mushroom Pokémon are the finest Pokémon in the world!

zh: 啊我的蘑菇宝可梦啊!
en: Ah! My mushroom Pokémon!

zh:
要克制钢属性,
就要用火属性和格斗属性
en: To beat Steel types, use Fire-type and Fighting-type moves.

zh: 啊我的火斗大队啊
en: Ah, my fire brigade!

zh:
双属性组合只要抗性够好
就算有四倍弱点也不是大问题
en: With a dual-type combo, as long as your resistances are good, even a 4x weakness isn't a big problem.

zh: 我的四倍弱点队就这么输了?
en: My team of 4x weaknesses lost just like that?

zh: 为什么大家都说大钢蛇他不得行啊?
en: Why does everyone say Steelix is no good?

zh: 这个大钢蛇就是逊啦
en: That Steelix is just lame.

zh: 努力打铁,终有一天能够战胜馆主
en: Keep hammering away, and one day you'll beat the Gym Leader.

zh: 看来我打铁还不够啊
en: Seems my smithing still isn't good enough.

zh: 可别想从我眼前溜过去哦
en: Don't even think about slipping past me!

zh: 好啦好啦,你赢了,过去吧
en: Fine, fine, you win. Go on through.

zh: 呀!被我找到啦[F9D3]
en: Yay! Found you[F9D3]

zh: 呜呜,我可爱的宝可梦输啦
en: Waah, my adorable Pokémon lost!

zh:
迷路了么?打赢我
就告诉你正确的方向
en: Lost, are you? Beat me and I'll point you the right way.

zh: 好啦你赢了,告诉你就是了
en: All right, you win. I'll tell you.

zh:
这个房间很大呢
需要点提示么?
en: This room is pretty big. Need a hint?

zh: 有没有被这黑暗困扰而迷失方向呢?
en: Has this darkness got you lost and confused?

zh: 好强的战斗能力啊
en: What incredible battle prowess!

zh:
发 现 目 标[F9D3]来陪姐姐玩吧[F9D3]
放心这里很黑没人看得到[F9D3]
en: Target sighted[F9D3] Come play with big sis[F9D3] Don't worry, it's dark here—no one will see[F9D3]

zh: 好厉害啊[F9D3]都把姐姐弄疼啦
en: You're amazing[F9D3] You actually hurt your big sis!

zh:
的奖励,
告诉你一点情报吧[F9D3]\p不要因为有5扇门
就强迫症地走中间哦[F9D3]\l强行追求对称可没什么好处[F9D3]
en: ...as a reward, I'll share a little tip[F9D3]\pJust because there are 5 doors doesn't mean you should compulsively pick the middle one[F9D3] Forcing symmetry won't do you any good[F9D3]

zh: 真厉害呀,看来有资格挑战馆主呢
en: Impressive! Looks like you're worthy of challenging the Gym Leader.

zh:
萌萌咝工作人员:欢迎,挑战者。
神奥联盟使用的比赛赛制是普双……\l啊,阁下原来已是丰缘联盟名人堂\l榜上有名之人,\l那应该是不需要更多的科普了。\p[FC0105]但是战斗前会有大约6秒的黑屏等待时间,
这是正常现象。\p[FC0101]四天王分别在两边的四扇门的后面,\l您可以自由选择挑战的顺序。\p只有当你战胜四人后,
才能通过中间的门进入冠军之间。\p那么现在请做出您的选择。
en: Attendant: Welcome, challenger. The Sinnoh League's battle format is standard Doubles... Ah, but your name is already in the Hoenn League Hall of Fame, so you hardly need the introduction.\p[FC0105]Before each battle there will be about six seconds of black screen. This is normal.\p[FC0101]The Elite Four await behind the four doors on either side, and you may challenge them in any order you like.\pOnly after defeating all four can you pass through the center door into the Champion's room.\pNow, please make your choice.

zh: 请选择下一道门。
en: Please choose the next door.

zh:
[FC0105]红莲使徒:准备好开始第[BUF02]回战了吗?
[FC0101][FC0302](如果没有准备好请按B键返回。)
en: [FC0105]Crimson Apostle: Are you ready to begin round [BUF02]? [FC0101][FC0302](Press B to go back if you're not ready.)

zh:
红莲使徒:
一直按A键碾过去的感觉爽吗?
en: Crimson Apostle: Enjoying just holding down the A Button and steamrolling through?

zh: 红莲使徒:我超?
en: Crimson Apostle: Wait, seriously?

zh: 红莲使徒:我麻了……
en: Crimson Apostle: I'm speechless...

zh:
门口贴着字条,
“请勿随便擅闯民宅!”
en: There's a note on the door: "No trespassing in private homes!"

zh:
甲贺长老:准备好开始第[BUF02]回战了吗?
(如果没有准备好请按B键返回.)
en: Elder Koga: Ready to begin round [BUF02]? (If not, press B to go back.)

zh: 高等位面联盟
en: Higher Plane League

zh:
狂沁
 卡露妮:非常感谢莎莉娜选手专业的表演!
 接下来....有请来自神奥地区的\p宝可梦协调家-小光 登场...!
en: Diantha: A big thank-you to Serena for that masterful performance!\pNext up... please welcome Sinnoh's own Pokémon Coordinator--Dawn...!

zh:
小蓝:你的阵容也很华丽呢...
谢谢你的共演[F9D3]我也很满足[F9D3]!
en: Blue: Your lineup is dazzling too… Thanks for performing with me[F9D3] I'm satisfied as well[F9D3]!

zh:
利:对,美丽的幻影们齐聚于此,
即将灿放出无与伦比的异彩,\p我将作为评委见证这场\l究极的华丽大赛...! \p并且! 我们有幸能邀请到
卡洛斯的女大公兼联盟冠军-卡露妮\p为我们主持这场盛宴...!
en: ...Yes--beautiful visions have gathered here, ready to burst into unparalleled brilliance.\pAs a judge, I will bear witness to this ultimate Contest Spectacular...!\pAnd what's more! We have the honor of welcoming Kalos's Grand Duchess and League Champion--Diantha--\pto host this grand celebration with us...!

zh:
嘿!你想去庆祝市吗?
噘!是祝庆市!\p老是叫错...! 
总之必须先通过我!
en: Hey! Wanna go to Lifejubi City? Gah! Jubilife City!\pI always get it wrong...! Anyway, you'll have to get past me first!

zh:
哇...! 你这水准怎么还在
这新手区打转啊...!
en: Whoa...! With skills like yours, why are you still hanging around the beginner area...?!

zh:
喂!别看了,就是你,
你也想来和我抢\l限定的宝可手表吗,做梦!
en: Hey! Quit staring—yeah, you! You're after the limited-edition Pokétch too? Dream on!

zh:
岂可修!你竟然突破了
我的最佳拍档,\l看来我与手表无缘了!
en: Dang it all! You actually broke through my best partner! Looks like that watch and I just weren't meant to be!

zh: 你瞅我嘎哈!
en: Whatcha lookin' at me for?!

zh: 算了,你瞅就瞅吧!
en: Fine, look all you want!

zh: 眼神对上了就来对战吧!
en: Our eyes met, so it's time to battle!

zh:
输给你了,你问我是谁?
我只是个路过的训练家罢了...
en: You beat me... Who am I, you ask? Just a Trainer passing through...

zh:
你看见一只死狗没,
纯黑的那种!
en: Have you seen a dead dog around? A jet-black one!

zh:
别打了别打了,
我只是来找狗的!
en: Stop, stop! I'm only here looking for a dog!

zh:
你看见我男朋友了吗,
我在找他试吃用精力剂煮的甲鱼汤!
en: Have you seen my boyfriend? I want him to taste-test my turtle soup made with Energy Root!

zh:
岁在甲子天下大吉,
苍天已死黄天当立,\p很快我就是下一个神奥冠军了!
en: In this year of jiazi, fortune smiles on all under heaven! The Azure Sky is dead—the Yellow Sky shall rise! Soon I'll be the next Sinnoh Champion!

zh: 黄天也死了...
en: The Yellow Sky has perished too...

zh: 可恶,背水阵!
en: Curses! Backs to the water!

zh: 只有我一个人也算是“阵”吗……
en: Can it really be called a "formation" with just me...

zh:
你长的好像我以前认识的那个人,
啊,不知道你们之间谁更强呢...
en: You look just like someone I used to know. Ah—I wonder which of you is stronger...

zh:
我早就该明白,
那个人已经不会再回来了...
en: I should have known long ago... That person is never coming back...

zh:
你都这么大了还这么闲的吗
找小孩子对战什么的...
en: Aren't you a bit old to have this much free time? Picking battles with kids and all...

zh:
哇,你欺负小朋友!
我要找老师来帮我们!
en: Waah, you're picking on little kids! I'm getting the teacher to help us!

zh: 战胜你我就有零用钱了对不对?
en: If I beat you, I get allowance money, right?

zh: 我只想要赚点零用钱...呜呜
en: I just wanted to earn a little pocket money... Sob...

zh:
山谷间,傲世间,
有我在此便是天
en: Amid the valleys, scorning the world--where I stand is heaven itself!

zh: 俞陀救我
en: Yutuo, save me!

zh:
哼哼,空中的天气、
大地的安定、人类的气质,\p全都在我手掌之上!
en: Heh heh. The weather in the sky, the stability of the land, the temper of humanity—all of it rests in the palm of my hand!

zh: 乐不可极,暇不可溃啊……
en: Never indulge to excess, never let leisure make you lazy...

zh:
黑夜骑士驾到!
统统闪开!\p说的是你啊!
en: The Dark Knight has arrived! Everyone, out of the way!\pYes, you!

zh: 陨落于阿卡汉姆...
en: Fallen in Arkham…

zh: 来吧,骑乘动作决斗!
en: Come on, it's a riding-stunt duel!

zh:
呜哇哇我要摔下去了!
番茄救我!
en: Waaah, I'm gonna fall! Tomato, save me!

zh:
阿特拉斯:王只有一个,
那就是我!
en: Atlas: There is only one king—and that's me!

zh: 啊!!!(被甩下车)
en: Aaah!!! (Thrown off the ride)

zh:
彩羽:我是从别的地区过来的,
请问您知道我的妹妹去哪了吗?
en: Caiyu: I came here from another region. Do you know where my little sister went?

zh:
战士的最高境界,
就是不拿盾牌也能够开盾墙!
en: The pinnacle of a warrior: forming a shield wall without even holding a shield!

zh: 把我血加住,我有盾墙!
en: Keep my HP topped up! I've got my shield wall!

zh:
什么?
要来一场紧张刺激的宝可梦对战?\p你要是哝这个,
我可不困了啊。
en: What? You want a thrilling Pokémon battle? Well, if that's the offer, I'm suddenly wide awake.

zh:
我好兴奋啊!
我好兴奋啊!
en: I'm so excited! I'm so excited!

zh:
你好强啊,
这么受的我果然不是你的对手。
en: You're really strong. I guess someone like me was never a match for you.

zh:
你为什么要被我看到?
人家不想战斗的啊
en: Why did you let me see you? I didn't even want to battle...

zh:
人的欲望,
就如同高山滚石一般,\p一旦开始,
就再也停不下来了。\p除非这些石头
原本就在山谷的底部。
en: Human desire is like a boulder rolling down a mountainside.\pOnce it begins, it can never be stopped—\punless the stones were already at the valley's bottom.

zh:
你可以杀死我,
却杀不死我强者的信念!
en: You can kill me, but you'll never kill my conviction as one of the strong!

zh:
来战斗吗?打赢我的话
可以给你点特殊奖励哦!
en: Want to battle? Beat me and I'll give you a special reward!

zh: 好久没打的这么痛快了[F9D3]!
en: It's been ages since I had such a thrilling battle[F9D3]!

zh:
在我面前,
敌人不是逃之丨丨就是一败涂地!
en: Before me, foes either turn tail or fall in utter defeat!

zh: 逃跑有理穿越无罪!
en: Fleeing is justified! Time travel is no crime!

zh: 又有一条鱼上钩了吗?
en: Another fish on the hook?

zh:
我本来以为是条大鱼,
没想到只是一罐可乐!
en: I thought I'd hooked a huge fish, but it was just a can of soda!

zh: 吃我一击吧!
en: Take this!

zh: 你赢了,我还得多锻炼!
en: You win. I need to train more!

zh:
女苑:哎呀,你要给我钱啊,
多谢——!
en: Joon: Oh my, you're giving me money? Many thanks!

zh:
紫苑:施舍点啥呓——
我好饿哦——
en: Shion: Spare me a little something... I'm so hungry...

zh:
吾自东土而来,
只为除此塔也,\l汝可视之乎?
en: I have come from the lands of the east, solely to destroy this tower. Dost thou see?

zh:
吾遍历四方,
除阴寒,扫恶鬼,\p此地已无祸世幽髋,
吾可动身前去他地也
en: I have wandered the four corners, dispelling gloom and sweeping away evil spirits. No baleful ghosts remain in this land. I may now set forth for other places.

zh:
男:说半天了我真不叫反复,
你认错人了
en: Man: I keep telling you, my name isn't Fanfu. You've got the wrong person.

zh: 龙之箱庭就在前方...
en: The Dragon's Garden lies just ahead...

zh:
没想到你年纪轻轻
却不讲武德!
en: So young, and yet you show no martial virtue!

zh:
敢动一动我就射击了!
不对,敢射击就要动了!
en: Move an inch and I'll shoot! No, wait--shoot and I'll move!

zh:
真是畅快的对战啊!
游戏不是别人来让自己高兴,\l而要自己感到高兴!
en: What a refreshing battle! A game isn't about others making you happy--you have to find the joy yourself!

zh:
怎么会。。。
出拳的速度还是不够快吗
en: How...? Are my punches still not fast enough?

zh: 要来看看我养的鸟吗?
en: Want to see the birds I raise?

zh: 我的鸟已经两分钟没吃饭了!
en: My bird hasn't eaten in two whole minutes!

zh: 要加入我们三人野战吗?
en: Want to join our three-way wilderness battle?

zh:
黑椰:没想到你居然这么强!
白菇:要不要和他分手呢[F9D3]
en: Heiye: I never thought you'd be this strong! Baigu: Should I break up with him[F9D3]

zh:
登山休息途中
要来一场紧张刺激的对战吗?
en: How about a thrilling battle to break up the climb?

zh: 加油,我觉得你能爬到山顶!
en: Keep going! I know you can reach the summit!

zh: 请和我来一场宝可梦对战吧!
en: Have a Pokémon battle with me!

zh: 太强了,没想到根本就打不过!
en: Too strong! I never stood a chance!

zh:
可恶!不能找女仆宣泄了!
我只能找你了!
en: Darn it! I can't vent to the maid anymore! You'll have to do!

zh: 啊... 斯哈[F9D3][F9D3]斯哈[F9D3][F9D3]
en: Ahh... Hff-hah[F9D3][F9D3] Hff-hah[F9D3][F9D3]

zh:
据说这里附近有可疑人士!
是你吗!
en: They say there's someone suspicious around here! Is it you?!

zh:
啊呀...啊呀... 冒犯了...! 
竟然是丰缘冠军?!
en: Oh my... oh my... Pardon me...! The Champion of Hoenn?!

zh: 发现可疑人员!
en: Suspicious individual spotted!

zh: 我可是,正义的伙伴啊!
en: I am an ally of justice!

zh: 哦呀,有兴趣来我的花田里做客吗?
en: Oh my, care to visit my flower garden?

zh: 就和那些经常来捣乱的妖精一样烦人……
en: As annoying as those fairies that always come around causing trouble...

zh:
好大的豪宅!
里面一定有稀有的宝可梦!
en: What a huge mansion! There must be rare Pokémon inside!

zh: 还想着能偷偷潜入豪宅一探究竟的呢
en: And here I was hoping to sneak into the mansion and look around...

zh: 你是谁?不要靠近!
en: Who are you? Stay back!

zh: 不能变身了……
en: I can't transform anymore...

zh: 你是谁?这里是哪里?
en: Who are you? Where am I?

zh: 呜,太强了……
en: Ugh, so strong...

zh:
你有没有在附近看到一把紫色的刀?
那是我的先祖留下来的
en: Have you seen a purple blade around here? It's something my ancestors left behind.

zh: 这战斗风格……真像他啊
en: That battle style... It's just like his.

zh: 这里应该看不到那些奇怪的虫子了
en: We shouldn't see any of those strange bugs around here.

zh: 我可是要成为星之勇者的男人啊!
en: I'm the man who's going to become the Hero of the Stars!

zh: 我和我最重要的妹妹走散了
en: I got separated from my dear little sister.

zh: 为了我的妹妹,我不惜一切!
en: For my little sister, I'll do whatever it takes!

zh:
你该不会想去家缘市吧? 
如果我赢了你要帮我\l把一个选美美女带来给我!
en: Don't tell me you're off to Hearthome City? If I win, you have to bring one of those Contest beauties back for me!

zh: 抱歉...我就是LSP...你满意了吧...
en: Sorry... I'm just a hopeless perv... Satisfied now...?

zh: 只要打赢你,就能换一套新渔具了
en: If I beat you, I'll be able to get a new set of fishing gear!

zh: 看来又让一条大鱼逃走了
en: Looks like another big one got away.

zh:
嗬?你也是准备
去湿原市见那位大人的吗
en: Oh? Are you also headed to Pastoria City to see that great personage?

zh:
看来我太累了,
居然连一个孩子都打不过
en: I must be really tired... I can't even beat a kid.

zh:
天哪..
这鬼地方让我的风湿病犯了
en: Good grief... This awful place is making my rheumatism flare up.

zh: 闪到腰了
en: I threw out my back

zh:
就算是危险的沼泽区也阻止不了
决胜的心意!沼泽决战开始!
en: Not even this dangerous marshland can stop my will to win! Let the marsh showdown begin!

zh: 是我败北了...!
en: I have been defeated...!

zh: 嘿!要来大鱼了!张开你的后槽牙
en: Hey! A big one's coming! Open wide and get those choppers ready!

zh:
钩没挂到正口啊,又让鱼跑了
刚刚那条起码十斤大鲤鱼!
en: The hook didn't set right, and the fish got away again! That was a ten-pound carp at least!

zh:
这么高级的钓点,
我总是想着能出更高级的货色,\p可是你看...这一条鱼都没有啊...!!! \l气死我了!
en: At a first-class fishing spot like this, I keep expecting first-class catches.\pBut look... not a single fish...!!! It makes me furious!

zh:
啊!你怎么这么不解风情啊...! 
都不懂的让大叔宣泄一下\l那积满了白色的愤怒吗...!
en: Ah! How can you be such a killjoy...! Won't you even let an old fella vent all that pent-up white rage...?!

zh:
嘿,听说了吗,
湖畔宾馆大亨的儿子\l是个失智巨婴的事情... \p想了解更多吗? 来一泡吧!
en: Hey, did you hear? The son of the lakeside hotel tycoon is a brainless man-child...\pWant to hear more? Come have a soak!

zh:
啊[F9D3]嘶[F9D3]太舒服了,
我们之间两个人的战斗,\l这水上嫱戏还真不错,\p这一泡,非常舒服[F9D3]
en: Ahh[F9D3]sss[F9D3] This feels amazing. A battle between just the two of us--this water play isn't bad at all.\pThis soak feels wonderful[F9D3]

zh:
言乱语,\l你可要小心了...\p还有请别举报了他这可怜人,
警察都来这里几次了...\p因为他骚扰了这里度假的客人...
唉真是可怜这宾馆主人的家庭了...
en: ...talking nonsense, so you'd better be careful...\pAnd please don't report the poor man. The police have already been here several times...\pHe's been harassing the guests vacationing here... Ah, I really pity the hotel owner's family...

zh: 哟[F9D3]陪姐姐玩一玩[F9D3]?
en: Hey there[F9D3] Come play with your big sis[F9D3]?

zh: 噌[F9D3]玩的太乱暴了[F9D3][F9D3]!
en: Ooh[F9D3] You play way too rough[F9D3][F9D3]!

zh:
听说了吗,银河团被联盟冠军剿灭了,
我对此表示很失望,\p我有个更好的计划,你必须听一听,
首先我将在湖畔宾馆设置炸弹,\p然后挟持里面的人员,
通过广播和神奥联盟直接进行谈判,\p只要他们愿意
把联盟冠军希罗娜的肉体交出来,\p我们就释放宾馆里的人质,
最后当我们完事后,\l就全员携带人体炸弹,\p出来完成我们伟大的真祖复兴,
完成了理想的烈士,光荣陨落...! \p什么?你想干嘛?
en: Have you heard? Team Galactic was wiped out by the League Champion. I must say I'm disappointed.\pI have a better plan--you simply must hear it. First, I'll plant a bomb in the lakeside hotel.\pThen I'll take everyone inside hostage and negotiate directly with the Sinnoh League over the radio.\pIf they agree to hand over the body of League Champion Cynthia,\pwe'll release the hostages. And at the very end, once our work is done, we'll all strap on bombs ourselves\pand march out to complete the glorious revival of the True Ancestor--martyrs to the ideal, falling in glory...!\pWhat? What do you want?

zh: 哟呼[F9D3]你想往哪里跑[F9D3]别想逃开哟[F9D3]
en: Yoo-hoo[F9D3] Where do you think you're going[F9D3] Don't even think about running away[F9D3]

zh: 给我老实一点...!
en: Settle down, will you...!

zh: 为什么我要在这种地方穿比基尼?
en: Why am I wearing a bikini in a place like this?

zh: 差点走光了啊
en: I was almost exposed there!

zh: 你也是准备去帔幕市的吗?
en: Are you headed for Veilstone City too?

zh:
天哪,你的实力毫不逊色于
帔幕市的道馆馆主
en: My word, your skill is every bit a match for Veilstone City's Gym Leader!

zh:
我因为帔幕游戏厅倾家荡产了...! 
结果现在这期间游戏厅竟然停业啦啊啊,\l你特么给我把钱交出来!
en: The Game Corner bankrupted me...! And NOW it goes and closes down?! Aaargh—give me my money back, you hear me?!

zh: 愿赌服输...这钱给你...别举报我啊...
en: A bet's a bet... The money's yours... Just don't report me...

zh:
我要在这里给我的宝可梦
吃超多的能力强化道具,\l这样就能直接击败馆主了!
en: I'm going to feed my Pokémon heaps of stat-boosting items right here—then I can take down the Gym Leader in one go!

zh:
可恶啊,我之前不是使用了
很多能力强化道具吗?
en: Darn it! Didn't I use all those stat-boosting items earlier?

zh: 来和二虎流切磋看看吧!凭神!
en: Come test your skills against the Twin Tiger style! By the gods!

zh: 你...! 你使用的该不会是二虎流的...!
en: You...! Don't tell me that's the Twin Tiger style...!

zh:
同为格斗家,
为什么我比不过帔幕市那个小个子!
en: We're both Fighting-type experts, so why can't I beat that little one from Veilstone City?!

zh: 我的实力原来只有这么点吗……
en: Is this really all the strength I have...

zh: 来见识一下我的鲤鱼王吧!
en: Come behold my Magikarp!

zh: 等我哦!鲤鱼王!
en: Wait for me, Magikarp!

zh: 这附近有雪童子的居住地吗?
en: Is there a place where Snorunt live around here?

zh:
为了把雪童子送回它的家,
我和朋友们从遥远的地方来到了这里.\l真是一次好玩的风雪暑期啊!
en: My friends and I came from far away to bring this Snorunt back to its home. What a fun, snow-swept summer vacation!

zh:
见鬼!我的雪中寻宝装置出问题了, 
毫无疑问是因为你\l经过的时候突然中断的...!
en: Blast it! My snow treasure-hunting device is acting up—no doubt it cut out the moment you walked past...!

zh:
哼哼...很不错的战斗数据...
战斗力竟然超过5!
en: Heh heh... Excellent battle data... A power level of over 5!

zh: 我和我的霸道熊猫,可是要成为英雄的!
en: Me and my Pangoro are going to be heroes!

zh: 英雄可不会因为一次挫折而放弃!
en: A hero never gives up over a single setback!

zh:
这里可真冷啊,
真想念爷爷家温暖的熔岩虫小屋……\p啊!该让熔岩虫出来暖和暖和了!
en: It's so cold here—how I miss the warm Slugma hut at Grandpa's house...\pAh! Time to let my Slugma out to warm us up!

zh: 呜哇!我的宝贝熔岩虫!
en: Waah! My precious Slugma!

zh: 来者何人!报上姓名!
en: Who goes there?! State your name!

zh: 我的剑……也断了
en: My sword... it broke too

zh: 这里又是哪?!
en: Where am I this time?!

zh:
我只是因为迷路而晕头转向
才发挥不佳输掉了!
en: I only lost because I got lost and dizzy and couldn't battle at my best!

zh: 啊!终于看到人了!
en: Ah! Finally, another person!

zh: 呜呜,这里好冷!
en: Brr, it's so cold here!

zh: 呼呼呼[F9D3]让我给你暖暖身子
en: Heh heh heh[F9D3] Let me warm you right up.

zh:
燃起来了!
这比之前看的某动画要燃多了!
en: I'm all fired up! This is way more thrilling than that anime I watched!

zh:
水脉市真好啊,有大型图书馆和地区船坞,
还有大吊桥,太先进了!
en: Canalave City is wonderful—a huge library, a regional shipyard, and that great drawbridge. So advanced!

zh:
真希望我的家乡浅葱市
也能建设得那么好啊
en: I wish my hometown of Olivine City could be built up that nicely, too.

zh: 呜哇!好厉害!
en: Whoa! Amazing!

zh: 我好怕我们走丢啊……
en: I'm so scared we'll get lost...

zh: 哔!不要过来!
en: Beep! Stay back!

zh: 吾乃时之魔导师,艾尔露卡!
en: I am Elluka, the Mage of Time!

zh: 唑呜呜呜我要掉水里了!
en: Waaah, I'm gonna fall in the water!

zh: 来,跳支舞吧
en: Come, let's dance!

zh:
这么多的泳装美女,
可真难克制住自己啊
en: So many swimsuit beauties... It's so hard to restrain myself!

zh:
铃木:怎么办怎么办,
在宝可梦对战中出的话,\l训练师生涯就结束了nari.
en: Suzuki: What do I do, what do I do? If I lose a Pokémon battle here, my Trainer career is over, nari.

zh:
糟,输了怎么办怎么办……
对了,就用大声咆哮掩盖过去罢.
en: Oh no, what do I do if I lose, what do I do... I know--I'll just roar really loud and cover it up.

zh: 来,睡一觉吧
en: Come on, get some sleep.

zh: 这是给你的GIFT,收下吧……
en: This is a GIFT for you. Take it...

zh:
阿库姒:呜哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊!
我我我我是……嗬!\p我可是perfect海之女仆,
宝可梦对战自然不在话下!
en: Akusi: Uwaaaaaah! I-I-I-I'm… hmph!\pI'm the perfect maid of the sea. Pokémon battles are nothing to me!

zh: 这里……这里,应该已经远离那个塔了
en: Here... Here, we should be far enough from that tower now.

zh:
即使同盟国只剩下我一个人,
我作为一名光荣的情报员\l也要继续战斗!
en: Even if I'm the last of the Allies remaining, I will fight on as a proud intelligence agent!

zh: 别眨眼,这就是阿罗拉的至高之术!
en: Don't blink! This is Alola's supreme technique!

zh: 我听见了,故土的潮声
en: I hear it... the tide of my homeland.

zh: 来,开始裁缝的工作吧
en: Now, let's get to the tailoring work.

zh:
那个男人……
为什么又和别的女人在一起?!
en: That man... Why is he with another woman again?!

zh: 哦哦哦哦要来了要来了,大的要来了!
en: Ohhh, here it comes, here it comes! A big one's coming!

zh: 看我用科技的力量化解你的攻击!
en: Watch me neutralize your attacks with the power of technology!

zh: 可恶啊,装置又双失败了!
en: Curses! The device failed yet again!

zh:
啊[F9D3]好无聊啊[F9D3] 
钓鱼才能缓解这无聊的人生啊[F9D3]\l你也想来纥解我的无聊吗?
en: Ah[F9D3] I'm so bored[F9D3] Only fishing can soothe this dull life of mine[F9D3] Care to help ease my boredom too?

zh: 恩...比起战斗也许你更适合钓鱼一些
en: Hmm... You might be better suited to fishing than battling.

zh:
我就是一个臭钓鱼的,
怎么,要来打一架吗?
en: I'm just a lousy angler. What, you wanna fight about it?

zh: 现在的年轻人,一点都不知道尊老爱幼
en: Young folks these days—no respect for their elders at all!

zh:
你听说过吗,湖中传说的故事,
很久很久以前..\l有个训练家的宝可梦沉没于湖中...\p哇!你怎么掏出宝可梦球!
en: Have you heard the legend of the lake? Long, long ago... a Trainer's Pokémon sank beneath its waters...\pWhoa! Why are you pulling out a Poké Ball?!

zh: 真是的!竟然没等我把故事说完!
en: Honestly! You didn't even let me finish my story!

zh:
这片水域受到立志湖的某种影响,
鱼群特别精神,对于我们这些\l渔夫来说是正适合,只要靠近立志湖 ,\p不管是什么都会精神受到鼓动!
不多说了,来和我战斗一场!
en: Some influence from Lake Acuity makes the fish here extra lively--perfect for us fishermen. Get close to Lake Acuity,\pand anything's spirit gets stirred up! Enough talk--battle me!

zh: 我还是继续钓鱼好了...
en: I'll just keep on fishing...

zh: 要和大姐姐来一局紧张刺激的对战吗
en: Want a thrilling, heart-pounding battle with your big sis?

zh: 你问我宝可梦的球都放在哪了?你猜啊.
en: You're asking where I keep my Poké Balls? Take a guess.

zh:
嘿!这个方向...
你该不会是想挑战宝可梦联盟!?
en: Hey! Going that way... Don't tell me you're planning to challenge the Pokémon League!?

zh:
这里聚集了不少外国友人,
还有很多美少女!\l是我大展身手的时候了
en: There are lots of foreign visitors here, and plenty of pretty girls! It's my time to shine!

zh: 我又吃灰了!!!
en: I've been left in the dust again!!!

zh:
平安名:诨诨诨?难道是星探吗?
不不对,星探哪有你这么小的,\p哦我知道了,看你这一身行头,
是宝可梦训练师吧.\p那今天只能委屈你成为
我在大明星之路上的一记战功碑了!
en: Henna: Huh? Are you a talent scout? No, no, scouts aren't as small as you.\pOh, I get it. Judging by that outfit, you're a Pokémon Trainer.\pThen today you'll just have to be another trophy on my road to stardom!

zh: 嘿!又发现一个住民!
en: Hey! Found another resident!

zh: 比附近的住民强得多啊
en: You're way stronger than the locals around here.

zh:
哇啊啊!
 野生的战斗暴龙兽跳出来啦!
en: Waaah! A wild WarGreymon jumped out!

zh:
没吃过东西了!
来,全都吃完不准剩下!
en: ...haven't eaten anything! Here, eat it all up--no leftovers allowed!

zh: 我是因为太久没吃东西饿了才输的
en: I only lost because I hadn't eaten in ages and was starving!

zh:
你知道化石宝可梦吗?
人类从远古化石中提取出\l宝可梦的基因,利用现代科技将其复原
en: Do you know about Fossil Pokémon? Humans extract Pokémon genes from ancient Fossils and use modern science to restore them.

zh:
海东:寻找宝物是我最大的兴趣,
但我并不是你想的那种猎人或大盗啊.
en: Haidong: Treasure hunting is my greatest passion, but I'm not the kind of hunter or thief you're thinking of.

zh: 宝物或许也不在这里
en: The treasure might not be here, either.

zh:
我听说十六年前这里有很多绿毛虫,
我在神奥这么久还没见过绿毛虫呢,\l怎么,你也是来跟我抢绿毛虫的吗
en: I heard there were lots of Caterpie here sixteen years ago. I've been in Sinnoh all this time and never seen one. What, are you here to fight me for the Caterpie too?

zh: 你听见了吗……这森林的歌声
en: Can you hear it? The song of this forest...

zh:
复仇的火焰终将吞噬
这片森林,这片大地……
en: The flames of vengeance shall consume this forest, this land...

zh:
什么嘛,我的战斗还挺像模像样的嘛
不要停下来啊我的宝可梦们!
en: What do you know--my battling isn't half bad! Don't stop now, my Pokémon!

zh:
友奈:哦!我是勇者部的成员友奈,
我会完成大家的委托的!
en: Yuna: Oh! I'm Yuna of the Hero Club. I'll complete everyone's requests!

zh:
哇,接下了我们的勇者拳,
你果然很厉害啊!
en: Whoa, you took our hero punch head-on. You really are amazing!

zh:
阿伟:哇等等一下我在抓利欧路……
我淞,跑了啦.\l都你害的,拜托!
en: Awei: Whoa, wait a sec, I'm catching a Riolu… Aw man, it ran off. That's your fault, come on!

zh: 你赔我刚才的3V利欧路!!!
en: You owe me for that 3-IV Riolu!!!

zh: 这是全面战争咝
en: This is all-out war, sss!

zh:
在没有足够的决心和准备时,
就鲁莽地想和贼人交手,\l所以事情才会变成这样.
en: Rushing to take on brigands without enough resolve or preparation—that's exactly why things ended up like this.

zh: 哎原来是我太逊了……
en: Ah, so I was just too weak...

zh:
无论过了多久,我都会梦到
那天晚上在学校里探险的那一幕
en: No matter how much time passes, I still dream of that night we went exploring in the school.

zh: 我变成耿鬼了?
en: I turned into a Gengar?

zh:
我能感觉得到,现在,
我的手中抓住了未来!
en: I can feel it! Right now, I'm holding the future in my hands!

zh:
是我还没能和
我的宝可梦们相互理解吗?
en: Is it that my Pokémon and I still don't truly understand each other?

zh:
传闻钢铁岛有异常强大的气息,
不是你能接近的,来,让\l我看看你钢铁般的意志吧
en: They say an unnaturally powerful presence looms over Iron Island—nothing you could handle. Come, show me that iron will of yours!

zh: 传说落幕已浸染,漫霞无话未能愿
en: The legend's curtain falls, steeped in twilight; the drifting glow leaves its wish unspoken.

zh:
田所浩二:听到这里有两位
百战之勇者到来,\p我立马就从下北泽赶过来了.
我一定要亲眼见证他们的英姿.
en: Tadokoro Koji: I heard two battle-hardened heroes had arrived here,\pso I rushed over from Shimokitazawa. I have to see their valor with my own eyes.

zh:
无型...我的武都不如你的境界吗...
这就是究极的境地吗....
en: Formless... Does even my martial art fall short of your level...? Is this the ultimate state...?

zh:
哼,这种程度的战斗,
对我来说根本不值一提
en: Hmph. A battle of this level isn't even worth my time.

zh: 你!你竟敢!
en: You! How dare you!

zh: 我要保护姐姐!
en: I'll protect my sister!

zh: 哞!姐姐!
en: Moo! Sis!

zh: 何等……无礼之徒!
en: What... insolence!

zh:
又一个猎物登上门来……
让我来给你断罪吧!
en: Another prey comes knocking... Allow me to deliver your judgment!

zh: 切,你想从我这里拿走什么?
en: Tch. What are you trying to take from me?

zh:
我将参加炼狱淘汰赛...! 
以此为目标在不断的修炼着,\l你来做我的陪练对手吧...!
en: I'm going to enter the Inferno Knockout Tournament...! I've been training nonstop with that goal in mind. Be my sparring partner...!

zh:
我的波导之力不足以
领导我击败你吗... ...
en: Is the power of my Aura not enough to lead me to victory over you...?

zh:
呵呵!继续前进吧...
如果是你的话,也许能挑战成功也说不定...\l那两为传说中的百战勇者...
en: Heh heh! Keep going... If it's you, you just might succeed in the challenge... Those two legendary battle-hardened heroes...

zh:
总之你想要挑战钢铁岛双雄,
必须先通过我!
en: If you want to challenge the two heroes of Iron Island, you'll have to beat me first!

zh:
樵:站住!
神奥冠军的宝座是我的猎物咝!
en: Qiao: Halt! The Sinnoh Champion's throne is my prey, hiss!

zh: 无论结果如何,我都会和它一起走下去.
en: Whatever the outcome, I'll keep walking forward with my partner.

zh:
这里是哪里.......
为什么听见有人喊爸爸妈妈
en: Where is this place...? Why do I hear someone calling for their mom and dad?

zh: 不知道那个小姑娘怎么样了
en: I wonder how that little girl is doing.

zh:
睦月:看好了,这就是
最强宝可梦训练师的战斗方式.
en: Mutsuki: Watch closely. This is how the strongest Pokémon Trainer battles.

zh: 哦累哇,赛Q咝!!
en: I'm the strongest there is, sss!!

zh:
髅芽:啊你好,别看我这样,
我可是育有两个孩子的38岁单亲妈妈.
en: Louya: Oh, hello. I may not look it, but I'm a 38-year-old single mom raising two kids.

zh: 我不管,我很可爱,请奎我钱!
en: I don't care, I'm cute, so give me money!

zh:
澌人:你知道吗,
你正在向地上最强的\l宝可梦训练师发起挑战!
en: Siren: You know what? You're challenging the strongest Pokémon Trainer on earth!

zh:
你好我叫星空读作NASA,
是比光还快的男人.\p这位是我非常非常可爱的老婆小司,
她可是拥有来自月亮的力量
en: Hello! My name is written "Starry Sky" but read "NASA"—the man faster than light.\pAnd this is my very, very adorable wife, Tsukasa. She wields the power of the moon, you know.

zh: 唉,失败了啊.
en: Ah, I failed.

zh:
你好我是司,拥有来自月亮的力量.
这位是我的老公星空,\p是比光还快的男人哦[F9D3]
啊我不是说那方面啦[F9D3]
en: Hi, I'm Tsukasa. I have power from the moon. This is my husband, Hoshizora--\pa man faster than light[F9D3] Ah, I don't mean it THAT way[F9D3]

zh:
没事的老公,
看到你对战中拼尽全力的样子,\l我就很开心了
en: It's all right, dear. Just seeing you give it your all in battle makes me happy.

zh:
司:如果你只有一只宝可梦,
那我们不能跟你战斗,\p那样太欺负人了.
en: Si: If you only have one Pokémon, we can't battle you.\pThat would just be bullying.

zh: 你们都是我的翅膀啊
en: You are all my wings.

zh:
我不会是全天下唯一一个
对两个女人心动的男人吧?
en: I can't be the only man in the world whose heart races for two women... right?

zh:
剑南春:如果你只有一只宝可梦,
那我们不能跟你战斗,\p那样太欺负人了.
en: Jiannanchun: If you only have one Pokémon, we can't battle you.\pThat would just be bullying.

zh:
雪碧:为什么会变成这样呢……
第一次有了喜欢的人.\l有了能做一辈子朋友的人.\p两件快乐事情重合在一起.
而这两份快乐,\l又给我带来更多的快乐.\p得到的,本该是像
梦境一般无与伦比幸福的时间……\p但是,为什么,
会变成这样呢……
