en: Sprite: Why did it turn out like this… For the first time, I had someone I liked. Someone who could be a friend for life.\pTwo happy things overlapped. And those two joys brought me even more joy.\pWhat I should have gotten was a time of happiness beyond compare, like a dream…\pBut why… why did it turn out like this…

zh:
雪碧:为什么你会这么熟练啊!
你和她亲过多少次了啊!?\p你到底要把我甩开多远你才甘心啊!?
是我,是我先,\l明明都是我先来的……\p接吻也好,拥抱也好,
还是喜欢上那家伙也好.
en: Sprite: Why are you so good at this?! How many times have you kissed her?!\pHow far do you have to leave me behind before you're satisfied?! It was me, I was here first… I was always first…\pThe kisses, the hugs, even falling for that guy…

zh:
感受到了...我感受到了!
是他们的亡魂!!\p是这铁工厂流水线上
日夜工作的996工人的亡魂啊!\p我能感受到,他们即将苏醒
并向万恶的资本主义复仇!
en: I feel it... I feel it! Their departed souls!!\pThe souls of the 996 workers who toiled day and night on this ironworks assembly line!\pI can feel it--they're about to awaken and take revenge on wicked capitalism!

zh: 我能感到,他们正在苏醒……
en: I can feel it... They are awakening...

zh:
我的宝可梦很喜欢
到处都是钢铁的环境\l所以我常带他们来玩
en: My Pokémon love places filled with steel, so I often bring them here to play.

zh: 可多拉你怎么啦!又饿了嘛?
en: Lairon, what's wrong? Hungry again?

zh:
寻宝就像玩抽卡游戏一样,
看我单抽一发出货,\l十连遍地金光!
en: Treasure hunting is just like a gacha game! Watch me hit the jackpot on a single pull—and strike gold across a whole ten-pull!

zh: 我的欧气,都去哪了?!
en: Where did all my luck go?!

zh:
梦起的名字
是他们的詈绊与记忆的证明\p如果可以的话,也为你的宝可梦起名吧
en: The names they were given are proof of their bonds and memories.\pIf you can, give your Pokémon a nickname too.

zh:
望能对你有帮助.\p好啦这下子索兰斯那家伙用不着
整天愁眉苦脸的了,真是谢谢你啦!
en: ...hope it serves you well.\pNow that Solans fellow won't have to mope around all day. Thanks so much!

zh:
当时小智喊我过去组队
也并非偶然一样,\l同时也能够,嗬,\l让宝可梦突破这个世界的既定规则,\l比如说让宝可梦自由使用自己\l学不会的招式。
en: Just like it was no coincidence that Ash called me over to team up. We can also, heh, let Pokémon break this world's set rules--say, letting a Pokémon freely use moves it could never learn.

zh:
袱5果然他们已经知道了啊。\p嗬嗬,有什么问题吗?\p哎呀,失礼了……
有问题的人是小生我啊。\p但在此之前,
还是先彼此确认一下吧。\p就用……宝可梦对战!\p宝可梦驯化师,望罗,

en: ...so they already know.\pHeh heh. Is something the matter?\pAh, how rude of me... The one with the problem is I myself.\pBut before that, let us take each other's measure first.\pWith... a Pokémon battle!\pPokémon Wielder Volo--pardon the intrusion!

zh: 不……还没有结束!!
en: No... It's not over yet!!

en: I want the almighty Sinnoh to hear my voice!

zh: 这就是……神奥大尊的力量吗……
en: So this is... the power of the almighty Sinnoh...

zh:
我已经很久没有见到过他了。\p不知道是从什么时候开始,
他就消失在了大家的生活中。\p加上洗翠各地都出现的异常时空歪曲,
我们也无暇顾及他的去向。\l也不知道金刚队的伙伴们怎么样了……\p要是我再强一点,
那时就不会受这样的伤了。\l金刚队世代相传的秘宝也不会被……\p可恶……金刚队的大家,
再给我点时间……\p啊抱歉,我失态了……\p你腰间挂着的是……精灵球?
你也是宝可梦驯化师吗?\p从你身上,
我感受到了一丝奇怪的感觉。\l就像是一种……很悠远的力量。\p之前去天冠山麓也有过同样的感觉。
也许这能成为帮助你的线索。
en: I haven't seen him in a long time.\pAt some point, he simply vanished from everyone's lives.\pWith these strange space-time distortions appearing all over Hisui, we've had no time to look into his whereabouts. I wonder how my Diamond Clan comrades are doing...\pIf I were just a little stronger, I wouldn't have been wounded like this. And the treasure passed down through the Diamond Clan wouldn't have been...\pCurses... Everyone of the Diamond Clan, give me a little more time...\pAh, forgive me. I lost my composure...\pIs that a... Poké Ball at your waist? Are you a Pokémon wielder too?\pI sense something strange about you. Like a power that is... very distant and ancient.\pI felt the same thing at the Coronet Highlands. Perhaps that could be a clue to help you.

zh:
经过了漫长的休养,
我想试试我能不能继续战斗,\l取得神奥大尊的认可!
en: After a long convalescence, I want to see if I can still battle—and earn the recognition of almighty Sinnoh!

zh:
切……还是有点勉强吗……
刚才给叶伊布下命令时都异常迟钝……

热血沸腾的宝可梦对决!\p哞……
动作太大,手又疼了……\p珠贝:你这家伙,

有缘再会了……

Will you come back to see us?\pOnce things settle down, let's go to the hot springs together!\pAdaman: When the Crimson Mirelands recover, I'll take you to my beloved hills behind the Diamond Settlement for a view over all of Hisui!\pAnd then we'll have a blood-pumping Pokémon showdown!\pOw...
